zsb-english:1:quiz:0.title: 名词 Nouns
zsb-english:1:quiz:0.stem: He gave us ____ on how to keep fit.
zsb-english:1:quiz:0.explanation: advice 是不可数名词，无复数形式，也不加冠词。

zsb-english:1:quiz:1.title: 名词 Nouns
zsb-english:1:quiz:1.explanation: 不可数名词用"容器 of"量化：glass 可数需复数，milk 不变。

zsb-english:1:quiz:2.title: 名词 Nouns
zsb-english:1:quiz:2.stem: Some ____ came to our school for a visit that day.
zsb-english:1:quiz:2.explanation: "某国人"复数口诀：其余 s 加后面——German → Germans。

zsb-english:1:quiz:3.title: 名词 Nouns
zsb-english:1:quiz:3.explanation: 物质名词表材料用原形 wood；woods 意为"树林"；wooden 是形容词。

zsb-english:1:quiz:4.title: 名词 Nouns
zsb-english:1:quiz:4.stem: There are sixty-seven ____ in our school.
zsb-english:1:quiz:4.explanation: man/woman 修饰名词时前后两个词都要变复数：women teachers。

zsb-english:1:quiz:5.title: 名词 Nouns
zsb-english:1:quiz:5.stem:
—Is the broom under ____ desk?
—No, it’s under ____.
zsb-english:1:quiz:5.explanation: 特指"老师的桌子"用所有格 the teacher’s；"我的（桌子）"用名词性物主代词 mine。（名词性物主代词详见第 3 课）

zsb-english:1:quiz:6.title: 名词 Nouns
zsb-english:1:quiz:6.stem: The dog runs fast. —— 句中加粗的名词充当什么成分？
zsb-english:1:quiz:6.explanation: dog 是动作 runs 的发出者，作主语。原题型：判断画线成分；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充。

zsb-english:1:quiz:7.title: 名词 Nouns
zsb-english:1:quiz:7.stem: Teenagers today are facing lots of pressure. —— 句中加粗的名词充当什么成分？
zsb-english:1:quiz:7.explanation: pressure 作 facing 的动词宾语。原题型：判断画线成分；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充。

zsb-english:1:quiz:8.title: 名词 Nouns
zsb-english:1:quiz:8.stem: You are supposed to focus your attention on your own work. —— 句中加粗的名词充当什么成分？
zsb-english:1:quiz:8.explanation: work 作介词 on 的宾语。原题型：判断画线成分；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充。

zsb-english:1:quiz:9.title: 名词 Nouns
zsb-english:1:quiz:9.stem: He is reading a history book. —— 句中加粗的名词充当什么成分？
zsb-english:1:quiz:9.explanation: history 修饰 book，表分类，作定语。

zsb-english:1:quiz:10.title: 名词 Nouns
zsb-english:1:quiz:10.stem: The city, Beijing, is the capital of China. —— 句中加粗的名词充当什么成分？
zsb-english:1:quiz:10.explanation: Beijing 对 the city 解释说明，作同位语。

zsb-english:1:quiz:11.title: 名词 Nouns
zsb-english:1:quiz:11.stem: We’re sparing no effort to make our county a developed country. —— 句中加粗的名词充当什么成分？
zsb-english:1:quiz:11.explanation: a developed country 补充说明宾语 our county，作宾语补足语。原题型：判断画线成分；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充。

zsb-english:1:quiz:12.title: 名词 Nouns
zsb-english:1:quiz:12.stem: Charlie Chaplin is considered a great actor, director and editor. —— 句中加粗的名词充当什么成分？
zsb-english:1:quiz:12.explanation: actor, director and editor 补充说明主语 Charlie Chaplin，作主语补足语。原题型：判断画线成分；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充。

zsb-english:2:quiz:0.title: 冠词 Articles
zsb-english:2:quiz:0.stem:
—Do you know ____ man standing under the tree?
—He’s ____ university teacher.
zsb-english:2:quiz:0.explanation: 特指"站在树下的那个男人"用 the；university 发 /ju:/ 辅音音素，用 a。

zsb-english:2:quiz:1.title: 冠词 Articles
zsb-english:2:quiz:1.stem: After watching ____ TV, she played ____ violin for an hour.
zsb-english:2:quiz:1.explanation: watch TV（看电视）零冠词；play the violin 乐器前加 the。

zsb-english:2:quiz:2.title: 冠词 Articles
zsb-english:2:quiz:2.stem: ____ Browns were having dinner when the telephone rang.
zsb-english:2:quiz:2.explanation: the + 姓氏复数，表示"布朗一家人"。

zsb-english:2:quiz:3.title: 冠词 Articles
zsb-english:2:quiz:3.stem: To some degree, being ____ honest person all one’s life isn’t easy.
zsb-english:2:quiz:3.explanation: honest 的 h 不发音，以元音音素开头，用 an。

zsb-english:2:quiz:4.title: 冠词 Articles
zsb-english:2:quiz:4.stem: People like to walk by ____ sea in ____ June and July.
zsb-english:2:quiz:4.explanation: by the sea 在海边（地点）；月份前零冠词。

zsb-english:2:quiz:6.title: 冠词 Articles
zsb-english:2:quiz:6.explanation: 乐器前加 the（口诀：钢琴）。

zsb-english:3:quiz:0.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:0.stem: I like playing this kind of computer game, but I don’t want to play ____ now.
zsb-english:3:quiz:0.explanation: 指前面提到的"这种电脑游戏"，同类同物，用 it。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:1.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:1.stem: The books on the table are better than ____ in the bag.
zsb-english:3:quiz:1.explanation: 比较对象 books 为复数，同类异物用 those。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:2.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:2.stem: Mr. Rod prefers a restaurant in a small town to ____ in a large city as Beijing.
zsb-english:3:quiz:2.explanation: 比较对象 a restaurant 单数，同类异物特指，后有大城市修饰，用 that。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:3.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:3.stem: I have two pens. One is blue, and ____ is black.
zsb-english:3:quiz:3.explanation: 两支笔中"另一个"用 the other。（课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:4.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:4.stem: Some students are playing football, and ____ are watching TV.
zsb-english:3:quiz:4.explanation: some... others...：一些……另一些（泛指）。（课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:5.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:5.stem: One of these boys is my brother, and ____ are my friends.
zsb-english:3:quiz:5.explanation: 剩下的男孩全部是我的朋友，用 the others。（课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:6.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:6.stem: I have already read this book. Can you give me ____ to read?
zsb-english:3:quiz:6.explanation: 再给我一本（泛指三者以上中另一个），用 another。（课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:7.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:7.stem: This cake is delicious! Can I have ____ piece, please?
zsb-english:3:quiz:7.explanation: 再来一块（蛋糕有多个），another + 单数名词。（课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:8.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:8.stem: The supermarket is on ____ side of the street.
zsb-english:3:quiz:8.explanation: 街道只有两侧，"另一侧"用 the other side。（课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:9.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:9.explanation: each of + n. 搭配；every 后不可加 of。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:10.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:10.explanation: every + n.，直接修饰名词。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:11.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:11.stem: ____ child has a shining point. 每名孩子都有自己的闪光点。
zsb-english:3:quiz:11.explanation: 强调个体闪光点，用 Each（each 强调个体）。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:12.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:12.stem: Almost ____ person is here. 几乎所有人都在这儿。
zsb-english:3:quiz:12.explanation: almost 只与 every 连用，each 不可以。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:13.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:13.stem: Not ____ girl likes dresses. 并不是所有女孩都喜欢裙子。
zsb-english:3:quiz:13.explanation: not 只与 every 连用。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:14.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:14.stem: ____ of us has a book like this. 我们每个人都有一本这样的书。
zsb-english:3:quiz:14.explanation: 接 of 只能用 each：each of + n.；every 不可接 of。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:15.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:15.stem: No one ____ going to my party tomorrow.
zsb-english:3:quiz:15.explanation: no one 作主语时谓语动词只用单数。（原题型：随堂填空）

zsb-english:3:quiz:16.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:16.explanation: none 可接 of，指人或物（需明确范围），谓语可单可复；no one / nothing 不接 of。（原题型：随堂填空）

zsb-english:3:quiz:17.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:17.stem: ____ the stories are instructive in this book. 这本书中所有的故事都有教育意义。
zsb-english:3:quiz:17.explanation: 三者以上"都"用 All（all the + 复数名词）。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:18.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:18.stem: ____ of the stories is/are instructive in this book. 这本书中没有一个故事有教育意义。
zsb-english:3:quiz:18.explanation: "没有一个"用 None，是 all 的反义词；none 可接 of，谓语可单可复。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:19.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:19.stem: They have ____ been living in Hainan for 20 years. 他们两个都在海南生活二十年了。
zsb-english:3:quiz:19.explanation: "两者都"用 both。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:20.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:20.stem: ____ of the two boys is clever. 两个男孩都不聪明。
zsb-english:3:quiz:20.explanation: "两者都不"用 Neither（both 的反义词）；neither of + 复数作主语，谓语常用单数 is。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:21.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:21.stem: ____ are present and all goes well. 所有人都到场了而且一切进展顺利。
zsb-english:3:quiz:21.explanation: all 指人作主语时谓语用复数；"所有人都到了"用 All。（原题型：填空；课件未附答案，解析为整理时补充）

zsb-english:3:quiz:22.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:22.stem:
—Which of the two T-shirts would you like to choose?
—____. I don’t like their styles.
zsb-english:3:quiz:22.explanation: 两件 T 恤都不喜欢用 Neither（两者都不）；None 需三者以上。

zsb-english:3:quiz:23.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:23.stem:
—Have you got ____ ready for the sports meeting?
—Not yet. We still have ____ to do.
zsb-english:3:quiz:23.explanation: "一切"都准备好了吗用 everything；还没好，"还有一些事要做"用 something。

zsb-english:3:quiz:24.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:24.stem: Is ____ necessary to take off our shoes when we enter the lab?
zsb-english:3:quiz:24.explanation: it 作形式主语，真正主语是 to take off our shoes。

zsb-english:3:quiz:25.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:25.stem: His camera is more expensive than ____.
zsb-english:3:quiz:25.explanation: 与 his camera 比较，用名词性物主代词 hers（= her camera）。

zsb-english:3:quiz:26.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:26.stem: Although he’s wealthy, he spends ____ on clothes.
zsb-english:3:quiz:26.explanation: Although 转折：有钱但花得"少"表否定；money 不可数用 little。

zsb-english:3:quiz:27.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:27.stem:
—Which jacket do you prefer, the black one or the brown one?
—I like ____. They are both too expensive.
zsb-english:3:quiz:27.explanation: 两件都太贵 → 两件都不喜欢，neither。

zsb-english:3:quiz:28.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:28.stem: I don’t like this shirt. Can you show me ____?
zsb-english:3:quiz:28.explanation: 不喜欢这件，再随便看一件（泛指三者以上中另一个），another。

zsb-english:3:quiz:29.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:29.stem:
—How many students passed the exam?
—____ of them. Everyone failed.
zsb-english:3:quiz:29.explanation: How many 提问 + of them 用 None；No one 不接 of。

zsb-english:3:quiz:30.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:30.stem: I have two brothers. ____ is a teacher, and the other is a doctor.
zsb-english:3:quiz:30.explanation: 两者：One is..., and the other is...。

zsb-english:3:quiz:31.title: 代词 Pronouns
zsb-english:3:quiz:31.stem: The weather in Beijing is colder than ____ in Guangzhou in winter.
zsb-english:3:quiz:31.explanation: 比较对象 weather 单数、同类不同物，用 that。

zsb-english:4:quiz:0.title: 介词 Prepositions
zsb-english:4:quiz:0.stem: What do you usually do ____ Sunday?

zsb-english:4:quiz:2.title: 介词 Prepositions
zsb-english:4:quiz:2.explanation: 固定搭配 be good at doing。

zsb-english:4:quiz:3.title: 介词 Prepositions
zsb-english:4:quiz:3.stem: Mike does his exercises ______ seven ______ the evening.
zsb-english:4:quiz:3.explanation: 具体时刻 at seven；in the evening（三长之一）。

zsb-english:4:quiz:4.title: 介词 Prepositions
zsb-english:4:quiz:4.stem: There is a cat ______ the tree.
zsb-english:4:quiz:4.explanation: 猫不是长在树上的，"落在树上"用 in the tree。

zsb-english:4:quiz:5.title: 介词 Prepositions
zsb-english:4:quiz:5.stem: The bank is ______ the post office. They’re next to each other.
zsb-english:4:quiz:5.explanation: next to each other（相邻）→ beside 在旁边。

zsb-english:4:quiz:6.title: 介词 Prepositions
zsb-english:4:quiz:6.stem: There is a bridge ______ the river.
zsb-english:4:quiz:6.explanation: 桥横跨在河的正上方用 over（above 不强调跨越，across 是表面穿过）。

zsb-english:4:quiz:7.title: 介词 Prepositions
zsb-english:4:quiz:7.stem: The car is parked ______ the house.
zsb-english:4:quiz:7.explanation: 车停在房子外面的前面，范围外用 in front of；in the front of 指范围内部的前部。

zsb-english:5:quiz:0.title: 数词和连词 Numerals & Conjunctions
zsb-english:5:quiz:0.stem:
—How many people will come to Beijing for the Olympic Games?
—It’s hard to say. ____ people, I think.
zsb-english:5:quiz:0.explanation: 不确切数量：复数 + of，前面不能有具体数词。

zsb-english:5:quiz:1.title: 数词和连词 Numerals & Conjunctions
zsb-english:5:quiz:1.stem: September is the ____ month of a year.
zsb-english:5:quiz:1.explanation: nine 变序数词去 e 加 th：ninth（不是 nineth）。

zsb-english:5:quiz:2.title: 数词和连词 Numerals & Conjunctions
zsb-english:5:quiz:2.stem: It was my grandfather’s ____ birthday. We enjoyed ourselves.
zsb-english:5:quiz:2.explanation: "第 70 个生日"用序数词 seventieth；前有名词所有格 grandfather’s，不再加 the。

zsb-english:5:quiz:3.title: 数词和连词 Numerals & Conjunctions
zsb-english:5:quiz:3.stem: She didn’t study hard, ______ she failed the test.
zsb-english:5:quiz:3.explanation: 前因后果：没努力学习，所以挂科了。

zsb-english:5:quiz:4.title: 数词和连词 Numerals & Conjunctions
zsb-english:5:quiz:4.stem: You can either stay at home ______ go out with us.

zsb-english:5:quiz:5.title: 数词和连词 Numerals & Conjunctions
zsb-english:5:quiz:5.stem: Neither he ______ his brother likes swimming.

zsb-english:5:quiz:6.title: 数词和连词 Numerals & Conjunctions
zsb-english:5:quiz:6.stem: She was tired, ______ she kept working.
zsb-english:5:quiz:6.explanation: 前后转折：累但是继续工作。

zsb-english:5:quiz:7.title: 数词和连词 Numerals & Conjunctions
zsb-english:5:quiz:7.stem: Both Tom ______ Lily like playing basketball.
zsb-english:5:quiz:7.explanation: both...and... 固定搭配，谓语用复数。

zsb-english:6:quiz:0.title: 形容词和副词 Adjectives & Adverbs

options.text: A. beautiful little old black his
B. black his little old beautiful

zsb-english:6:quiz:0.explanation: 原题为教材 P31 随堂练习（课件未附答案，笔记补充解析）：限定词 his 最前；再按“美小圆旧黄”排序：beautiful（美）→ little（小）→ black（黄/颜色）。

zsb-english:6:quiz:1.title: 形容词和副词 Adjectives & Adverbs
zsb-english:6:quiz:1.stem: They bought their daughter ____ handbags as her birthday present.

options.text: A. two Shanghai leather small black
B. two leather small black Shanghai
C. two small black Shanghai leather
D. two black small Shanghai leather

zsb-english:6:quiz:1.explanation: 原题为教材 P31 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）：数词 two → 大小 small → 颜色 black → 产地 Shanghai → 材料 leather。

zsb-english:6:quiz:2.title: 形容词和副词 Adjectives & Adverbs
zsb-english:6:quiz:2.stem: We were all ____ when we heard the ____ news that the rescue team found another survivor.
zsb-english:6:quiz:2.explanation: 原题为教材 P33 随堂练习：-ed 修饰人“感到”——we were excited；-ing 修饰物“令人”——exciting news。

zsb-english:6:quiz:3.title: 形容词和副词 Adjectives & Adverbs
zsb-english:6:quiz:3.stem: This book is ____ more interesting than that one.
zsb-english:6:quiz:3.explanation: 原题为笔记“课后加餐”。much 修饰比较级 more interesting，表程度“大得多”；very/so/quite 只修饰形容词原形。可修饰比较级的词还有 a lot / far / even / slightly。

zsb-english:6:quiz:4.title: 形容词和副词 Adjectives & Adverbs
zsb-english:6:quiz:4.stem: She ____ arrives late, but today she’s early.
zsb-english:6:quiz:4.explanation: 原题为笔记“课后加餐”。频度副词 usually 修饰实义动词 arrives，放在动词前。

zsb-english:6:quiz:5.title: 形容词和副词 Adjectives & Adverbs
zsb-english:6:quiz:5.explanation: 原题为笔记“课后加餐”（原题仅两个选项，保持原数）。人“感到”有趣用 interested；故事“令人”有趣用 interesting——物令人 -ing，人感到 -ed。

zsb-english:6:quiz:6.title: 形容词和副词 Adjectives & Adverbs
zsb-english:6:quiz:6.stem: The box is ____ heavy for him ____ carry.
zsb-english:6:quiz:6.explanation: 原题为笔记“课后加餐”。too...to 表示“太……而不能”，后接动词原形。

zsb-english:6:quiz:7.title: 形容词和副词 Adjectives & Adverbs
zsb-english:6:quiz:7.stem: The weather today is as ____ as yesterday.
zsb-english:6:quiz:7.explanation: 原题为笔记“课后加餐”。as...as 中间用形容词原级 warm，表示“和……一样温暖”。

zsb-english:7:quiz:0.title: 动词 Verbs
zsb-english:7:quiz:0.stem: 变否定句：I should run fast. → ____

options.text: B. I should not run fast.
C. I am not run fast.
D. I not should run fast.

zsb-english:7:quiz:0.explanation: 原题为教材 P46 助动词否定句练习（课件未附答案，笔记补充解析）：陈述句中有情态动词 should，直接在其后加 not。

zsb-english:7:quiz:1.title: 动词 Verbs
zsb-english:7:quiz:1.stem: 变否定句：I am a student. → ____

options.text: B. I am not a student.
C. I am no a student.
D. I not am a student.

zsb-english:7:quiz:1.explanation: 原题为教材 P46 助动词否定句练习（笔记补充解析）：句中有 be 动词 am，直接在 be 后加 not。

zsb-english:7:quiz:2.title: 动词 Verbs
zsb-english:7:quiz:2.stem: My textbook has disappeared. Who ____ have taken it?
zsb-english:7:quiz:2.explanation: 原题为教材 P54 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）：对过去事情的推测用“情态动词 + have done”；疑问句用 could（谁可能拿走了它）。

zsb-english:7:quiz:3.title: 动词 Verbs
zsb-english:7:quiz:3.stem: Under the regulations, all the passengers ____ remain in their seats until the plane lands safely.
zsb-english:7:quiz:3.explanation: 原题为教材 P54 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）：regulations（规章）中表义务、规定，用 shall（对应 shall 用法第 4 条）。（已校对课件原文 lands safety 的笔误）

zsb-english:7:quiz:4.title: 动词 Verbs
zsb-english:7:quiz:4.stem: The music ____ so wonderful that everyone stopped to listen.
zsb-english:7:quiz:4.explanation: 原题为笔记“课后加餐”。音乐“听起来”美妙，sound 为感官系动词。

zsb-english:7:quiz:5.title: 动词 Verbs
zsb-english:7:quiz:5.stem: You ____ finish the work today; tomorrow is also OK.
zsb-english:7:quiz:5.explanation: 原题为笔记“课后加餐”。“明天也可以”说明“不必”今天完成，用 needn’t（不必）；mustn’t 是“禁止”。

zsb-english:7:quiz:6.title: 动词 Verbs
zsb-english:7:quiz:6.stem: The light in his room is on. He ____ be studying now.
zsb-english:7:quiz:6.explanation: 原题为笔记“课后加餐”。房间灯亮着，非常肯定地推测“一定正在学习”，must be doing；对现在的推测中 must 可能性最大。

zsb-english:7:quiz:7.title: 动词 Verbs
zsb-english:7:quiz:7.stem: The sun ____ in the east every day, and we should ____ our hands when we have questions.
zsb-english:7:quiz:7.explanation: 原题为笔记“课后加餐”。rise 不及物（太阳自己升起）；raise 及物（举起某物 raise our hands）。

zsb-english:7:quiz:8.title: 动词 Verbs
zsb-english:7:quiz:8.stem: We should ____ quiet in the library to respect others.
zsb-english:7:quiz:8.explanation: 原题为笔记“课后加餐”。keep/stay/remain 都可作系动词表“保持安静”。

zsb-english:8:quiz:0.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz:0.stem:
找出下面句子的主干（原题为连线题，主干选项 5 个）：
I like cakes.
zsb-english:8:quiz:0.explanation: 前置讲义 P20 连线题。like 是及物动词，cakes 是宾语 → 主谓宾。

zsb-english:8:quiz:1.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz:1.stem:
找出下面句子的主干（原题为连线题）：
He left the door open.
zsb-english:8:quiz:1.explanation: 前置讲义 P20 连线题。open 补充说明宾语 the door 的状态，是宾语补足语 → 主谓宾补。

zsb-english:8:quiz:2.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz:2.stem:
找出下面句子的主干（原题为连线题）：
You are a good teacher.
zsb-english:8:quiz:2.explanation: 前置讲义 P20 连线题。are 是系动词，a good teacher 是表语 → 主系表。

zsb-english:8:quiz:3.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz:3.stem:
找出下面句子的主干（原题为连线题）：
She bought me a book.
zsb-english:8:quiz:3.explanation: 前置讲义 P20 连线题。me 是间接宾语，a book 是直接宾语，双宾语 → 主谓宾宾。

zsb-english:8:quiz:4.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz:4.stem:
找出下面句子的主干（原题为连线题）：
They will leave.
zsb-english:8:quiz:4.explanation: 前置讲义 P20 连线题。will leave 只有谓语动词，没有宾语 → 主谓。

zsb-english:8:quiz:5.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz:5.stem:
判断句子成分（前置讲义 P22 原题）：
Google, a famous Internet company, earns billions of dollars every year.
句中 a famous Internet company 作什么成分？
zsb-english:8:quiz:5.explanation: 课件原题已给答案：a famous Internet company 对主语 Google 补充说明、语法地位相同 → 同位语。

zsb-english:8:quiz:6.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz:6.stem:
判断句子成分（前置讲义 P22 原题）：
I bought a new English book at the bookstore yesterday.
句中 at the bookstore 作什么成分？
zsb-english:8:quiz:6.explanation: 课件原题已给答案：介词短语表示动作发生的地点，修饰 bought → 地点状语。

zsb-english:8:quiz:7.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz:7.stem:
He knows that she likes playing football.
划线部分在句中作什么成分？
zsb-english:8:quiz:7.explanation: 笔记例 1：该从句整体作 knows 的宾语。区分主从句的方法：找连词，连词后面的那句话就是从句。

zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:0.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:0.stem:
原句 1：
Google, a famous Internet company, earns billions of dollars every year.
句中加粗的 Google 作什么成分？

zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:1.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:1.stem:
原句 1：
Google, a famous Internet company, earns billions of dollars every year.
句中加粗的 a famous Internet company 作什么成分？
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:1.explanation: 课件原答案：a famous Internet company（同位语）。

zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:2.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:2.stem:
原句 1：
Google, a famous Internet company, earns billions of dollars every year.
句中加粗的 earns 作什么成分？

zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:3.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:3.stem:
原句 1：
Google, a famous Internet company, earns billions of dollars every year.
句中加粗的 billions of 作什么成分？

zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:4.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:4.stem:
原句 1：
Google, a famous Internet company, earns billions of dollars every year.
句中加粗的 dollars 作什么成分？

zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:5.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:5.stem:
原句 1：
Google, a famous Internet company, earns billions of dollars every year.
句中加粗的 every year 作什么成分？
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:5.explanation: 课件原答案：every year（时间状语）。

zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:6.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:6.stem:
原句 2：
I bought a new English book at the bookstore yesterday.
句中加粗的 I 作什么成分？

zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:7.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:7.stem:
原句 2：
I bought a new English book at the bookstore yesterday.
句中加粗的 bought 作什么成分？

zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:8.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:8.stem:
原句 2：
I bought a new English book at the bookstore yesterday.
句中三个加粗的划线词 a / new / English 共同作什么成分？
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:8.explanation: 课件原答案：a / new / English（定语）。

zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:9.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:9.stem:
原句 2：
I bought a new English book at the bookstore yesterday.
句中加粗的 book 作什么成分？

zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:10.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:10.stem:
原句 2：
I bought a new English book at the bookstore yesterday.
句中加粗的 at the bookstore 作什么成分？
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:10.explanation: 课件原答案：at the bookstore（地点状语）。

zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:11.title: 句法 Syntax
zsb-english:8:quiz-p22:11.stem:
原句 2：
I bought a new English book at the bookstore yesterday.
句中加粗的 yesterday 作什么成分？

zsb-english:9:quiz:0.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:0.stem: John ____ an English passage every day, so he has a wide vocabulary.
zsb-english:9:quiz:0.explanation: 原题为教材 P84-85 随堂练习（课件未附答案，笔记补充解析）：every day 习惯性动作用一般现在时，John 三单加 s。

zsb-english:9:quiz:1.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:1.stem:
—____ your sister ____ English every day?
—Yes, she does.
zsb-english:9:quiz:1.explanation: 原题为教材 P84-85 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）：疑问句助动词 Does 提前（三单），后面接动词原形 study。

zsb-english:9:quiz:2.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:2.stem: They will hold a party if they ____ the project on time.
zsb-english:9:quiz:2.explanation: 原题为教材 P84-85 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）：主将从现——if 条件状语从句用一般现在时。

zsb-english:9:quiz:3.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:3.stem: 【24湖南真题】The plane ______ on time yesterday, but traffic was awful.
zsb-english:9:quiz:3.explanation: yesterday 是一般过去时标志词。

zsb-english:9:quiz:4.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:4.stem: He ____ by his sister at that moment.

options.text: C. was happened to be seen

zsb-english:9:quiz:4.explanation: 原题为教材 P86 补充练习（笔记补充解析）：happen 是不及物动词，没有被动语态（排除 B/C）；"他碰巧被姐姐看到"用 happen to be seen；at that moment 过去时 → happened。

zsb-english:9:quiz:5.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:5.stem: I ____ to the park yesterday and ____ a lot of beautiful flowers.
zsb-english:9:quiz:5.explanation: 原题为教材 P86 补充练习（笔记补充解析）：yesterday 用一般过去时 went; saw。

zsb-english:9:quiz:6.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:6.stem: ____ you ____ to the party last weekend?
zsb-english:9:quiz:6.explanation: 原题为教材 P86 补充练习组（笔记补充解析）：Did 后接动词原形 go。

zsb-english:9:quiz:7.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:7.stem: He ____ very happy when he received the gift.
zsb-english:9:quiz:7.explanation: 原题为教材 P86 补充练习组（笔记补充解析）：he 单数、when he received 过去背景 → was。

zsb-english:9:quiz:8.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:8.stem: 【25湖南真题】The city ______ a bridge across the river next year.
zsb-english:9:quiz:8.explanation: next year 是一般将来时标志词。

zsb-english:9:quiz:9.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:9.stem: 练1：Hurry up, children! The school bus ____ for us.
zsb-english:9:quiz:9.explanation: 原题为教材 P88 练习题（笔记补充解析）：Hurry up 提示此刻正在等 → 现在进行时 is waiting。

zsb-english:9:quiz:10.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:10.stem: 练2：Look! The children ____ in the park.
zsb-english:9:quiz:10.explanation: 原题为教材 P88 练习题（笔记补充解析）：Look! 提示正在进行。

zsb-english:9:quiz:11.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:11.explanation: 原题为教材 P88 练习题（笔记补充解析）：now 提示现在进行时 Are; cooking。

zsb-english:9:quiz:12.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:12.stem: 练4：He ____ for the test these days.
zsb-english:9:quiz:12.explanation: 原题为教材 P88 练习题（笔记补充解析）：these days 表示现阶段进行之中的动作。

zsb-english:9:quiz:13.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:13.stem: 练习1：At 8 o’clock yesterday, she ____ a shower.
zsb-english:9:quiz:13.explanation: 原题为教材 P89 练习题（笔记补充解析）：过去某时刻正在发生 → 过去进行时。

zsb-english:9:quiz:14.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:14.stem: 练习2：____ they ____ TV when I called?
zsb-english:9:quiz:14.explanation: 原题为教材 P89 练习题（笔记补充解析）：when I called 为过去背景，"正在看电视"用过去进行时。

zsb-english:9:quiz:15.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:15.stem: 练习3：We ____ football on the playground at that time.
zsb-english:9:quiz:15.explanation: 原题为教材 P89 练习题（笔记补充解析）：at that time 过去某段时间正在进行。

zsb-english:9:quiz:16.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:16.stem: At this time next week, we ____ the matter with our friends.
zsb-english:9:quiz:16.explanation: 课件附解析：at this time 提示用进行时，next week 提示将来时 → 将来进行时。本句意为：下周的这个时候，我们将与我们的朋友讨论这个问题。

zsb-english:9:quiz:17.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:17.explanation: 课件附答案解析："次数"（three times）是现在完成时典型用法，强调"累计经历"。

zsb-english:9:quiz:18.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:18.explanation: 课件附答案解析："since + 时间点"是现在完成时标志。

zsb-english:9:quiz:19.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:19.explanation: 课件附答案解析："ever"是现在完成时标志词，强调"经历"。

zsb-english:9:quiz:20.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:20.stem: We ____ finished our assignment when the teacher came to the classroom.
zsb-english:9:quiz:20.explanation: 原题为教材 P96 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）："老师来教室"是过去，"完成作业"在其之前 → 过去的过去，had just finished。

zsb-english:9:quiz:21.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:21.stem: By the time I got to the station, the train ____.
zsb-english:9:quiz:21.explanation: 原题为教材 P96 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）：By the time + 过去时，主句用过去完成时。

zsb-english:9:quiz:22.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:22.stem: She said that she ____ the book twice.
zsb-english:9:quiz:22.explanation: 原题为教材 P96 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）：宾语从句中主句 said 是过去，"读两次"发生在"说"之前 → 过去完成时。

zsb-english:9:quiz:23.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:23.stem: 填空转选择（笔记补充练习）：When I came into the classroom, my dear students ______ (begin) reading.
zsb-english:9:quiz:23.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 had begun：无时间状语时，两个过去动作中先发生的用过去完成时（"过去的过去"）。

zsb-english:9:quiz:24.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:24.stem: By the time you get to New York, I ____ for London.
zsb-english:9:quiz:24.explanation: 课件附答案 D：by the time + 将来语境 → 将来完成时。

zsb-english:9:quiz:25.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:25.stem: 【22重庆真题改编（假设说话时点为2021年）】They got married in 1992 and ____ for 30 years by 2022.
zsb-english:9:quiz:25.explanation: 本题为真题改编，明确将说话时点设为2021年；by 2022 表示将来完成时点，故用 will have been married。若改成当前回顾语境，应改为 had been married，不能沿用原答案。

zsb-english:9:quiz:26.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:26.stem: 时态随堂填空转选择（课件附答案）：By the time I walked into the classroom, the teacher ______ (start) teaching.
zsb-english:9:quiz:26.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 had started：By the time + 过去时 → 主句过去完成时。

zsb-english:9:quiz:27.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:27.stem: 时态随堂填空转选择（课件附答案）：What ______ his mother ______ (do) when he opened the door?
zsb-english:9:quiz:27.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 was doing：open the door 过去时刻正在进行的动作 → 过去进行时。

zsb-english:9:quiz:28.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:28.stem: 时态随堂填空转选择（课件附答案）：Tom ______ (work) there since two years ago.
zsb-english:9:quiz:28.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 has worked / has been working：since two years ago 现在完成（进行）时，选项 B 正确。

zsb-english:9:quiz:29.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:29.stem: 时态随堂填空转选择（课件附答案）：We ______ (learn) 5000 words by the end of last month.
zsb-english:9:quiz:29.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 had learned：by the end of last month 过去时间点之前完成 → 过去完成时。

zsb-english:9:quiz:30.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:30.stem: 时态随堂填空转选择（课件附答案）：The song ______ (sing) for two hours.
zsb-english:9:quiz:30.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 has been sung：被动 + 完成（进行）意味，for two hours 完成时标志。

zsb-english:9:quiz:31.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:31.stem: 时态随堂填空转选择（课件附答案）：The children learned that autumn ______ (be) the season of falling leaves.
zsb-english:9:quiz:31.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 is：客观真理不受主句时态影响。

zsb-english:9:quiz:32.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:32.stem: 语态随堂练习（教材 P100，笔记补充解析）：The new bridge ____ last month.
zsb-english:9:quiz:32.explanation: last month 过去时间 + 桥"被"建 → 一般过去时被动 was built。

zsb-english:9:quiz:33.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:33.stem:
语态随堂练习（教材 P100，笔记补充解析）：—What happened to Billy?
—He ____ because of his drink-driving.
zsb-english:9:quiz:33.explanation: 他"被"抓，且问句 happened 提示过去 → was caught。

zsb-english:9:quiz:34.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:34.stem: 语态随堂练习（教材 P103，笔记补充解析）：The cloth ____ very soft and comfortable.
zsb-english:9:quiz:34.explanation: feel 是系动词，主动表被动；描述面料特性用一般现在时。

zsb-english:9:quiz:35.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:35.stem: 语态随堂练习（教材 P103，笔记补充解析）：The books sold well and ____ out last week.
zsb-english:9:quiz:35.explanation: 与 sold well 并列，sell 主动表被动（描绘事物特性）；last week 过去时 → sold。

zsb-english:9:quiz:36.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:36.stem: 语态随堂练习（教材 P103，笔记补充解析）：The pen ____ smoothly.
zsb-english:9:quiz:36.explanation: write 主动表被动，描绘笔"写起来流畅"的特性。

zsb-english:9:quiz:37.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:37.stem: 语态随堂练习（教材 P103，笔记补充解析）：The problem ____ difficult to solve.
zsb-english:9:quiz:37.explanation: seem 是系动词，没有被动语态（is seemed ✘）；描述一般情况用一般现在时。

zsb-english:9:quiz:38.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:38.stem: 语态练习 1：The new library ____ last month.
zsb-english:9:quiz:38.explanation: 笔记补充解析：last month 过去时 + 图书馆"被"建 → was built。

zsb-english:9:quiz:39.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:39.stem: 语态练习 2：These books ____ to the library tomorrow.
zsb-english:9:quiz:39.explanation: 笔记补充解析：书"被"还，情态动词 + be done → must be returned。

zsb-english:9:quiz:40.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:40.stem: 语态练习 3：The project ____ by the end of next year.
zsb-english:9:quiz:40.explanation: 笔记补充解析：by the end of next year 将来时间 + 被完成 → 将来被动 will be completed。

zsb-english:9:quiz:41.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:41.stem: 语态练习 4：A new song ____ on the radio right now.
zsb-english:9:quiz:41.explanation: 笔记补充解析：right now 进行中 + 歌曲"被"播放 → 进行被动 is being played。

zsb-english:9:quiz:42.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:42.stem: 语态练习 5：The meeting ____ because of the heavy rain.
zsb-english:9:quiz:42.explanation: 笔记补充解析：会议"被"取消，过去事实 → was canceled。

zsb-english:9:quiz:43.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:43.stem: 语态练习 6：Every year, a large number of books ____ in this publishing house.
zsb-english:9:quiz:43.explanation: 笔记补充解析：every year 一般现在被动；a large number of 修饰复数 → are published。

zsb-english:9:quiz:44.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:44.stem: 语态练习 7：The old bridge ____ by the workers last month.
zsb-english:9:quiz:44.explanation: 笔记补充解析：last month 过去 + by the workers 被动 → was repaired。

zsb-english:9:quiz:45.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:45.stem: 语态练习 8：The new hospital ____ in two years.
zsb-english:9:quiz:45.explanation: 笔记补充解析：in two years 将来时间 + 医院"被"建 → will be built。

zsb-english:9:quiz:46.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:46.stem: 语态练习 9：These beautiful pictures ____ by my sister since last week.
zsb-english:9:quiz:46.explanation: 笔记补充解析：since last week 完成时 + by my sister 被动 → have been drawn。

zsb-english:9:quiz:47.title: 时态和语态 Tenses & Voice
zsb-english:9:quiz:47.stem: 语态练习 10：Look! The room ____ by the cleaner now.
zsb-english:9:quiz:47.explanation: 笔记补充解析：Look!...now 提示正在进行 + 被动 → is being cleaned。

zsb-english:10:quiz:0.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:0.explanation: 开篇易错题（课件已给答案）：主语 fruit（不可数）决定谓语用单数 is；表语 apples 复数不影响谓语。

zsb-english:10:quiz:1.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:1.stem: Her family ____ much larger than mine. Her family ____ singing and dancing when I called on her last night.
zsb-english:10:quiz:1.explanation: 原题为教材 P205 补充练习（笔记补充解析）：第一空强调整体（家庭）→ is；第二空强调家庭成员个体在唱歌跳舞（last night 过去进行）→ were。

zsb-english:10:quiz:2.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:2.stem: The government ____ announced new policies to improve public transportation.
zsb-english:10:quiz:2.explanation: 原题为教材 P205 补充练习（笔记补充解析）：government 强调整体，现在完成时 has announced。

zsb-english:10:quiz:3.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:3.stem: One hundred and twenty kilometers per hour ____ usually the speed limit for cars on the freeway.
zsb-english:10:quiz:3.explanation: 原题为教材 P206 补充练习（笔记补充解析）：速度被看作一个整体，用单数（表述一般事实用一般现在时）。

zsb-english:10:quiz:4.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:4.stem: Economics mainly ____ the study of how a society organizes its money, trade and industry.
zsb-english:10:quiz:4.explanation: 原题为教材 P206 补充练习（笔记补充解析）：经济学是学科名词用单数；固定搭配 refer to。

zsb-english:10:quiz:5.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:5.stem: There are nearly 7000 local languages in the world, but only 7% of them ____ in published online material.
zsb-english:10:quiz:5.explanation: 课件附解析：分数/百分数+of+名词/代词作主语，谓语与 of 后面的名词或代词的数保持一致 → them 复数 → are。译：世界上有近 7000 种地方语言，但只有 7% 出现在网上发布的材料中。

zsb-english:10:quiz:6.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:6.stem: About 60 percent of the students ____ from the south; the rest of them ____ from the north and foreign countries.
zsb-english:10:quiz:6.explanation: 原题为教材 P206 补充练习（笔记补充解析）：60 percent of the students 复数 → are；the rest of them 复数 → are。

zsb-english:10:quiz:7.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:7.stem: In many developed countries, the rich ____ richer, the poor poorer, which ____ a social problem.
zsb-english:10:quiz:7.explanation: 原题为教材 P207 练习（笔记补充解析）：the rich/the poor 表一类人 → 复数 are becoming；which 指代前面整个现象 → 单数 is。

zsb-english:10:quiz:8.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:8.stem: What the boy wants ____ a model aeroplane, and what his younger sister wants ____ science books.
zsb-english:10:quiz:8.explanation: 原题为教材 P207 练习（笔记补充解析）：主系表结构看表语：a model aeroplane 单数 → is；science books 复数 → are。

zsb-english:10:quiz:9.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:9.stem: The number of primary schools in the rural areas ____ doubled in the past 50 years.
zsb-english:10:quiz:9.explanation: 原题为教材 P207 练习（笔记补充解析）：the number 单数；in the past 50 years 与完成时连用 → has doubled。

zsb-english:10:quiz:10.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:10.stem: The number of people who were invited to the party ____ fifty, but a number of them ____ absent for different reasons.
zsb-english:10:quiz:10.explanation: 原题为教材 P207 练习（笔记补充解析）：the number of people → was；a number of them → were。

zsb-english:10:quiz:11.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:11.stem: 填空转选择（教材 P208，笔记补充解析）：Physics ________ (be) not easy to understand.
zsb-english:10:quiz:11.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 is：-ics 结尾学科名词作主语用单数。

zsb-english:10:quiz:12.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:12.stem: 填空转选择（教材 P208，笔记补充解析）：Nothing ________ (be) impossible.
zsb-english:10:quiz:12.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 is：nothing 是不定代词作主语用单数。

zsb-english:10:quiz:13.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:13.stem: 填空转选择（教材 P208，笔记补充解析）：Ten pounds ________ (be) missing from the box.
zsb-english:10:quiz:13.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 is：金钱被看作一个整体用单数。

zsb-english:10:quiz:14.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:14.stem: 填空转选择（教材 P208，笔记补充解析）：The number of the students in our school ________ quite large and a number of teachers ________ hard.
zsb-english:10:quiz:14.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 is; work：the number 单数；a number of 复数。

zsb-english:10:quiz:15.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:15.stem: 填空转选择（教材 P208，笔记补充解析）：The disabled ________ well taken care of in this country.
zsb-english:10:quiz:15.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 are：the disabled 表一类人 → 复数。

zsb-english:10:quiz:16.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:16.stem: 填空转选择（教材 P208，笔记补充解析）：The new ________ certain to replace the old.
zsb-english:10:quiz:16.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 is：the + adj. 表抽象概念（"新事物必将取代旧事物"）→ 单数。

zsb-english:10:quiz:17.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:17.stem: 填空转选择（教材 P208，笔记补充解析）：The rest of the workers ________ still very tired.
zsb-english:10:quiz:17.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 are：the rest of + 复数名词 → 复数。

zsb-english:10:quiz:18.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:18.stem: 填空转选择（教材 P208，笔记补充解析）：His family ________ all sitting in the sofa watching TV.
zsb-english:10:quiz:18.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 are：family 此处强调成员，有 all 提示 → 复数。

zsb-english:10:quiz:19.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:19.stem: Each of the students ____ responsible for finishing the project in time.
zsb-english:10:quiz:19.explanation: 原题为教材 P209-210 练习（笔记补充解析）：each of + 复数名词 → 谓语单数；此处需 be 动词 is。

zsb-english:10:quiz:20.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:20.stem: Each child and adult ____ some kind of trouble in their lives.
zsb-english:10:quiz:20.explanation: 原题为教材 P209-210 练习（笔记补充解析）：each...and each... 结构 → 单数；have 为实义动词。

zsb-english:10:quiz:21.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:21.stem: We each ____ strong points and each of us, on the other hand, ____ weak points.
zsb-english:10:quiz:21.explanation: 课件附解析：第一个空前的 each 作同位语，主语是 we，第一个空用复数；后半句 each of + 名词复数作主语，谓语用单数。

zsb-english:10:quiz:22.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:22.stem: Many a student in this college ____ a walk on campus after dinner. But many students in my elder brother’s school ____ computer games in the dormitory.
zsb-english:10:quiz:22.explanation: 原题为教材 P209-210 练习（笔记补充解析）：many a + 单数名词 → takes；many students 复数 → play。

zsb-english:10:quiz:23.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:23.stem: 填空转选择（教材 P210，笔记补充解析）：What surprised me most ________ (be) his attitude towards his study.
zsb-english:10:quiz:23.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 was：主语从句表单一事件，主句过去时。

zsb-english:10:quiz:24.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:24.stem: 填空转选择（教材 P210，笔记补充解析）：War and peace ________ (be) a constant theme in history.
zsb-english:10:quiz:24.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 is：War and peace 战争与和平为整体抽象概念。

zsb-english:10:quiz:25.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:25.stem: 填空转选择（教材 P210，笔记补充解析）：This pair of glasses ________ (be) very expensive.
zsb-english:10:quiz:25.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 is：a pair of 类量词，this pair 单数。

zsb-english:10:quiz:26.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:26.stem: 填空转选择（教材 P210，笔记补充解析）：Two series of new stamps ________ (have) been ordered.
zsb-english:10:quiz:26.explanation: 原题为填空题，笔记答案 have：two series 复数量词 → 复数谓语。

zsb-english:10:quiz:27.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:27.stem: There ____ pen, a few envelopes and some paper on the desk.
zsb-english:10:quiz:27.explanation: 原题为教材 P211 练习（笔记补充解析）：就近原则看 pen（单数）→ is；there be 句型不能选 have。

zsb-english:10:quiz:28.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:28.stem: Either my parents or my elder brother ____ going to water the garden.
zsb-english:10:quiz:28.explanation: 原题为教材 P211 练习（笔记补充解析）：either...or 就近 my elder brother 单数 → is。

zsb-english:10:quiz:29.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:29.stem: Not only I but also Jenny and Rose ____ fond of swimming and fishing.
zsb-english:10:quiz:29.explanation: 原题为教材 P211 练习（笔记补充解析）：not only...but also 就近 Jenny and Rose 复数 → are。

zsb-english:10:quiz:30.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:30.stem: Neither Mike nor I ____ able to persuade his grandfather to attend the wedding.
zsb-english:10:quiz:30.explanation: 原题为教材 P211 练习（笔记补充解析）：neither...nor 就近 I → am。

zsb-english:10:quiz:31.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:31.stem: Mary as well as her friends ____ in the park when her mom called her.
zsb-english:10:quiz:31.explanation: 原题为教材 P211 练习（笔记补充解析）：as well as 就远，主语 Mary 单数；when her mom called 过去背景 → 过去进行 was walking。

zsb-english:10:quiz:32.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:32.stem: Everyone in this town, including children and old people, ____ in for Tai Chi.（go in for: 对……感兴趣）
zsb-english:10:quiz:32.explanation: 原题为教材 P211 练习（笔记补充解析）：including 就远，主语 everyone 单数；表述一般习惯用一般现在时 → goes。

zsb-english:10:quiz:33.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:33.stem: Mike, together with his team members, ____ to take part in the next Olympic Games.
zsb-english:10:quiz:33.explanation: 原题为教材 P211 练习（笔记补充解析）：together with 就远，Mike 单数 → is。

zsb-english:10:quiz:34.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:34.stem: Nobody but Smith and John ____ in the lab yesterday afternoon.
zsb-english:10:quiz:34.explanation: 原题为教材 P211 练习（笔记补充解析）：but 就远，nobody 单数；yesterday afternoon 过去时 → was。

zsb-english:10:quiz:35.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:35.stem: 【24重庆真题】Susan and Jean like humor, but the humor they like ____ different.
zsb-english:10:quiz:35.explanation: 笔记补充解析：humor 不可数单数；一般现在时表客观 → is。

zsb-english:10:quiz:36.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:36.stem: 【24湖南真题】It is widely believed that a life lived for others ____ a life worthwhile.（人们普遍认为，为他人而活的人生是有价值的人生。）
zsb-english:10:quiz:36.explanation: 笔记补充解析：主语 a life 单数 → is。

zsb-english:10:quiz:37.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:37.stem: 综合练习 1：Jack is one of the foreign experts who ____ in China now.
zsb-english:10:quiz:37.explanation: 课件附解析：one of + 复数名词 + 定语从句结构中，从句谓语用复数形式（若 the only one of + 复数名词 + 定语从句，从句谓语用单数）；now 提示进行时。

zsb-english:10:quiz:38.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:38.stem: 综合练习 2：Whether I will go or stay ____ on the evaluation of my mother’s health condition by the doctor.
zsb-english:10:quiz:38.explanation: 原题为主谓一致综合练习（笔记补充解析）：whether 主语从句 → 单数；depend on 固定搭配。

zsb-english:10:quiz:39.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:39.stem: 综合练习 3：I don’t know what you think, but three weeks ____ already enough for me to finish the work.
zsb-english:10:quiz:39.explanation: 原题为主谓一致综合练习（笔记补充解析）：three weeks 时间整体 → 单数。

zsb-english:10:quiz:40.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:40.stem: 综合练习 4：As a result of the serious flood, ____ of the buildings in the area ____ repairing.
zsb-english:10:quiz:40.explanation: 原题为主谓一致综合练习（笔记补充解析）：分数表达 two-thirds 分子>1 分母加 s；of the buildings 复数 → need。

zsb-english:10:quiz:41.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:41.stem: 综合练习 5：So far, a large number of forests ____ because of air pollution and water pollution.
zsb-english:10:quiz:41.explanation: 原题为主谓一致综合练习（笔记补充解析）：a number of 复数 + so far 完成时 + 森林被毁被动 → have been destroyed。

zsb-english:10:quiz:42.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:42.stem: 综合练习 6：The feedback from the customers together with opinions of your manager ____ you what to purchase next.
zsb-english:10:quiz:42.explanation: 原题为主谓一致综合练习（笔记补充解析）：together with 就远，主语 feedback 不可数单数 → tells。

zsb-english:10:quiz:43.title: 主谓一致 Subject-Verb Agreement
zsb-english:10:quiz:43.stem: 综合练习 7：Neither Jenny’s two brothers nor Tim ____ to visit the art exhibition next Friday because all of them will be busy with their classes then.
zsb-english:10:quiz:43.explanation: 原题为主谓一致综合练习（笔记补充解析）：neither...nor 就近 Tim 三单 → decides。

zsb-english:11:quiz-0:0.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-0:0.stem:
She got off the bus, but ____ her handbag on her seat.
（她下了公交车，却把手提包落在座位上。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-0:0.explanation: 原为填空题（教材 P140，笔记补充解析）。but 连接两个谓语，第二空用一般过去时 left，不作非谓语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-0:1.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-0:1.stem:
She got off the bus, ____ her handbag on her seat.
（她下了公交车，把手提包落在座位上。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-0:1.explanation: 原为填空题（教材 P140，笔记补充解析）。没有连词，leave 要非谓语化；she 与 leave 主动，且动作伴随发生 → leaving。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:0.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:0.stem:
It’s our duty ____ the old.
（帮助老人是我们的责任。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:0.explanation: 原为填空题（笔记补充解析）。it 作形式主语，真正主语是 to help the old：It + 谓语 + to do。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:1.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:1.stem:
It is easy ____ me to finish this work before ten.
（我十点前完成这项工作很容易。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:1.explanation: 原为填空题（笔记补充解析）。easy 描述事情的难易等特征 → for；of 前的形容词评价人的性格或品质。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:2.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:2.stem:
It is very kind ____ you to give me some advice.
（你给我一些建议，真是太好了。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:2.explanation: 原为填空题（笔记补充解析）。kind 评价人的品质 → of。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:3.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:3.stem:
I think ____ difficult to deal with such a problem.
（我认为处理这样的问题很难。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:3.explanation: 原为填空题（笔记补充解析）。真正宾语是后面的 to deal with...，用 it 作形式宾语：think + it + adj. + to do。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:4.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:4.stem:
There is a man at the reception desk who seems very angry and I think he means ____ trouble.
（接待处有个男人看起来很生气，我想他打算制造麻烦。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:4.explanation: 教材 P142 随堂练习。mean to do 表“打算做”。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:5.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:5.stem:
He promised ____ on time.
（他答应准时到达。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:5.explanation: 教材 P142 随堂练习。promise to do，接不定式作宾语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:6.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:6.explanation: 教材 P142 随堂练习。desire to do，“想要/希望”类动词接不定式。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:7.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:7.stem:
They are going to have the serviceman ____ an electric fan in the office tomorrow.
（他们明天要让维修人员在办公室安装一台电风扇。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:7.explanation: 教材 P144 随堂练习。have sb. do：使役动词后接省 to 的不定式。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:8.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:8.stem:
The coach persuaded us ____ more practice.
（教练说服我们多练习。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:8.explanation: 教材 P144 随堂练习。persuade sb. to do。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:9.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:9.stem:
The girl was made ____ her room.
（这个女孩被要求打扫她的房间。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:9.explanation: 教材 P144 随堂练习。make 的被动式要还原 to：be made to do。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:10.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:10.stem:
My dream is ____ a famous writer.
（我的梦想是成为著名作家。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:10.explanation: 教材 P146 随堂练习。be + to do 作表语，主语是 dream。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:11.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:11.stem:
Our task is ____ this project on time.
（我们的任务是按时完成这个项目。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:11.explanation: 教材 P146 随堂练习。be + to do 作表语，主语是 task。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:12.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:12.stem:
Could you find someone ____?
（你能找个人陪我打网球吗？）

options.text: A. for me to play tennis with
B. for me to play tennis

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:12.explanation: 教材 P146 随堂练习。someone 是 play with 的逻辑对象，作定语的不定式里介词 with 不能漏。

zsb-english:11:quiz-1:13.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:13.stem:
The problem is too difficult for me ____.
（这个问题太难了，我解决不了。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-1:13.explanation: 教材 P146 随堂练习。too...to do 结果句型：太难而无法解决。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:0.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:0.stem: The thief is said ____.（据说小偷已经逃走了。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:0.explanation: 原为填空题 escape（笔记补充解析）。escape 先于 is said → to have done 完成式。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:1.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:1.stem: He seems ____.（他似乎正在说什么。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:1.explanation: 原为填空题 say（笔记补充解析）。与 seems 同时进行 → to be doing 进行式。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:2.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:2.stem:
Many new houses ____ in this area in the coming year.
（来年这个地区将建许多新房。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:2.explanation: 教材 P149 综合练习。空格处是句子谓语（不是非谓语题）；in the coming year 表将来，房子“被建” → 一般将来时被动。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:3.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:3.stem:
Many new houses ____ in this area is a sign of the rapid development of the region.
（在这个地区建许多新房是该地区快速发展的标志。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:3.explanation: 教材 P149 综合练习。句子谓语是 is，整个“建房”作主语；houses 与 build 被动 → to be built 作真正主语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:4.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:4.stem:
The problem ____ at the meeting tomorrow is very serious.
（明天会上要讨论的问题非常严重。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:4.explanation: 教材 P149 综合练习。tomorrow 将来、problem 被讨论 → to be done 作后置定语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:5.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:5.stem:
The ancient Egyptians are supposed ____ rockets to the moon.
（据推测，古埃及人曾向月球发射过火箭。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:5.explanation: 教材 P149 综合练习。“发射”发生在 are supposed 之前 → to have done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:6.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:6.stem:
She met Amy yesterday, and she is glad ____ her old friend again.
（她昨天遇到艾米，很高兴又见到老朋友。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:6.explanation: 教材 P149 综合练习。“见到老朋友”先于 is glad → to have seen。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:7.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:7.stem:
The novel is very popular and is said ____ into several languages last year.
（这部小说很受欢迎，据说去年已被译成多种语言。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:7.explanation: 教材 P149 综合练习。last year 先发生，novel 被翻译 → to have been done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:8.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:8.stem:
He seems ____ something to his friend.
（他似乎正在对朋友说些什么。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:8.explanation: 教材 P149 综合练习。“正在说” → to be doing。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:9.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:9.stem:
He is supposed ____ hard for the exam now.
（他现在应该正在为考试努力学习。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:9.explanation: 教材 P149 综合练习。now 正在进行 → to be doing。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:10.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:10.stem:
The director doesn’t like ____ while he is talking.
（主任不喜欢自己说话时被打断。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:10.explanation: 教材 P149 综合练习。主任自己说话时“被打断”，被动 → to be done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:11.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:11.stem:
____ weight, those girls work out every morning and eat little.
（为了减肥，那些女孩每天早晨锻炼并且吃得很少。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:11.explanation: 教材 P149 综合练习。“为了减肥”表目的 → to do 作目的状语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:12.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:12.stem:
I returned to the cinema to look for my keys, only ____ it closed.
（我回电影院找钥匙，结果却发现它已经关门了。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:12.explanation: 教材 P149 综合练习。only to do 表出乎意料的结果。

zsb-english:11:quiz-2:13.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:13.stem:
Though I didn’t like the man, I had no desire ____ him make a fool of himself.
（虽然我不喜欢这个人，但我并不想看到他出丑。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-2:13.explanation: 教材 P149 综合练习。desire 后接不定式：have no desire to do。

zsb-english:11:quiz-3:0.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:0.stem:
____ is a good form of exercise for both young and old.
（散步对年轻人和老年人都是很好的锻炼方式。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:0.explanation: 教材 P152–153 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。动名词作主语表泛指的锻炼方式。

zsb-english:11:quiz-3:1.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:1.stem:
____ English articles is a good way to improve English.
（阅读英语文章是提高英语的好方法。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:1.explanation: 教材 P152–153 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。动名词作主语，表泛指行为。

zsb-english:11:quiz-3:2.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:2.stem:
It’s no good ____ too much junk food.
（吃太多垃圾食品没有好处。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:2.explanation: 教材 P152–153 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。It is no good doing 固定句型。

zsb-english:11:quiz-3:3.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:3.stem:
People appreciate ____ with him because he has a good sense of humor.
（人们喜欢和他一起工作，因为他很有幽默感。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:3.explanation: 教材 P152–153 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。appreciate 接 doing 作宾语；无明显先后，不用完成式。

zsb-english:11:quiz-3:4.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:4.stem:
The match was cancelled because most of the members ____ a match without a standard court.
（比赛被取消了，因为大多数成员反对在没有标准球场的情况下比赛。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:4.explanation: 教材 P152–153 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。object to 中 to 是介词，后接 doing。

zsb-english:11:quiz-3:5.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:5.stem:
The traditional approach ____ with complex problems is to break them down into smaller, more easily managed problems.
（处理复杂问题的传统方法是把它们拆成更小、更易处理的问题。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:5.explanation: 教材 P152–153 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。approach to 中 to 是介词 → to dealing。

zsb-english:11:quiz-3:6.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:6.stem:
Jean did not have time to go to the concert last night because she was busy ____ for her examination.
（琼昨晚没时间去音乐会，因为她正忙着准备考试。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-3:6.explanation: 教材 P152–153 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。be busy (in) doing 固定搭配。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:0.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:0.stem:
Tom was very unhappy for ____ to the party.
（汤姆因为没有被邀请参加聚会而很不高兴。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:0.explanation: Tom 是被邀请的一方，故需要被动形式。not having been invited 表示此前没有受到邀请，B 符合；A、D 是主动形式，C 不能在 of 后单独充当动名词短语。注意：not being invited 本身也合语法，不应把完成式当作唯一被动表达。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:1.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:1.stem:
The problem needs ____ carefully.
（这个问题需要认真考虑。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:1.explanation: 教材 P157 综合练习。need doing 主动形式表被动意义（= needs to be considered）。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:2.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:2.stem:
He doesn’t like ____ interrupted when he is working.
（他不喜欢工作时被打断。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:2.explanation: like 后可接动名词。句意是他工作时不喜欢被打断，being interrupted 表示被动，A 符合；having interrupted 是主动形式。完成被动式 having been interrupted 在回顾已发生的打断时也可能成立。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:3.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:3.stem:
He was proud of ____ by the teacher.
（他为受到老师表扬而自豪。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:3.explanation: 教材 P157 综合练习。表扬先发生且 he 被表扬 → having been done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:4.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:4.stem:
He is looking forward to ____ to the party.
（他期待被邀请参加聚会。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:4.explanation: 教材 P157 综合练习。look forward to 中 to 是介词，后接 doing；“被邀请” → being done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:5.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:5.stem:
He complained about ____ unfairly.
（他抱怨自己受到了不公平对待。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:5.explanation: 教材 P157 综合练习。抱怨的事先发生且被动 → having been done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:6.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:6.stem:
He used to ____ up late, but now he is used to ____ up early.
（他过去常常晚起，但现在习惯早起。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:6.explanation: 教材 P157 综合练习。used to do 过去常做；be used to doing 习惯做（to 是介词）。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:7.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:7.stem:
Nowadays, it seems that no one can avoid ____ the Internet.
（如今似乎没有人能避免使用互联网。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:7.explanation: 教材 P157 综合练习。avoid 接 doing，主动使用。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:8.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:8.stem:
A philosopher once told us that ____ with wise men improves our mind.
（一位哲学家曾告诉我们，与智者交谈能提升心智。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:8.explanation: 教材 P157 综合练习。动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 improves。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:9.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:9.stem: The pair of shoes that my mother bought for me has been worn out—they need ____.（妈妈给我买的那双鞋已经穿坏了，需要修补。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:9.explanation: 教材 P157 综合练习。need doing 主动表被动（= need to be mended）。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:10.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:10.stem:
We’ve been advised not to risk ____ in such bad weather.
（有人建议我们不要冒险在这样的坏天气外出。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:10.explanation: 教材 P157 综合练习。risk 接 doing。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:11.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:11.stem:
____ into the famous university made him the pride of his family.
（被这所著名大学录取使他成为家人的骄傲。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:11.explanation: 教材 P157 综合练习。主语“他”是被录取 → 动名词被动 being done 作主语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:12.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:12.stem:
—Father is scolding somebody again. —I’m getting tired of ____ aloud in the room. Couldn’t he be a little gentle?
（——爸爸又在训人了。——我受够了他在房间里大声说话；他不能温和一点吗？）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:12.explanation: 教材 P157 综合练习。his 是 talking 的逻辑主语（动名词复合结构），指“他大声说话”。

zsb-english:11:quiz-4:13.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:13.stem:
____ different types of pianos, the craftsman invited a famous pianist to test them.
（制作出不同类型的钢琴后，这位工匠邀请了一位著名钢琴家来试琴。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-4:13.explanation: 主句的主语 craftsman 是制造动作的执行者；制造完成后发出邀请，用 having produced 表示主动且先于主句的动作，选 D。Produces 是有限动词，不能在该位置充当非谓语状语；B、C 是被动形式。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:0.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:0.stem:
The movie ____ by many people is very interesting.
（许多人看过的这部电影很有趣。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:0.explanation: 教材 P159–160 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。movie 被看且已完成 → done 作后置定语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:1.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:1.stem:
The problem ____ at the meeting now is very important.
（现在会上正在讨论的问题很重要。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:1.explanation: 教材 P159–160 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。now 正在被讨论 → being done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:2.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:2.stem: The performance was ____. We were all ____.（表演很令人兴奋，我们都很兴奋。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:2.explanation: 教材 P159–160 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。-ing 修饰事物（表演令人兴奋），-ed 修饰人的感受（我们感到兴奋）。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:3.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:3.stem: She told us an ____ story. We were all ____.（她给我们讲了一个令人惊讶的故事，我们都很惊讶。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:3.explanation: 教材 P159–160 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。-ing 修饰事物（story），-ed 修饰人（we）。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:4.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:4.stem:
The teacher made him ____ his homework again.
（老师让他重做作业。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:4.explanation: 教材 P161 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。make sb. do：使役动词后接省 to 的不定式。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:5.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:5.stem:
I saw him ____ basketball on the playground. You can go and find him.
（我看见他正在操场打篮球，你可以去找他。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:5.explanation: see sb. doing 表示看到动作正在进行，选 B playing。see sb. do 也可用，但侧重动作整体；plays 是有限动词，不能用于 see him plays 这一结构。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:6.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:6.stem:
We found the house ____ by the fire.
（我们发现房屋被大火毁坏了。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:6.explanation: 教材 P161 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。house 与 damage 是被动关系 → done 作宾补。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:7.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:7.stem:
The children ran out of the room, ____ and laughing.
（孩子们又唱又笑地跑出房间。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:7.explanation: 教材 P163–166 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。伴随状语，children 主动唱 → doing。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:8.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:8.stem:
____ his homework, he went out to play.
（做完作业后，他出去玩了。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:8.explanation: 教材 P163–166 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。he 主动完成作业，且先于 went out → having done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:9.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:9.stem:
The fire lasted for a whole night, ____ a lot of damage.
（大火持续了一整夜，造成了很大损失。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:9.explanation: 教材 P163–166 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。结果状语，fire 主动造成 → doing。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:10.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:10.stem:
He sat there, ____ in deep thought.
（他坐在那里，陷入沉思。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:10.explanation: 教材 P163–166 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。be lost in deep thought 陷入沉思，可看作 being lost 省略 being → done 表状态。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:11.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:11.stem:
He stood there, ____ at the beautiful scenery.
（他站在那里看着美景。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:11.explanation: 教材 P163–166 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。伴随状语，he 主动看 → doing。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:12.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:12.stem:
____ caught in the rain, he got a cold.
（因为淋雨，他感冒了。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:12.explanation: 教材 P163–166 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。原因状语，he 被淋 → being done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:13.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:13.stem:
Articles used by patients must be disinfected before ____ others.
（病人用过的物品在被他人使用前必须消毒。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:13.explanation: 教材 P163–166 随堂练习（笔记补充解析）。before 是介词，后接 doing；articles“被使用” → being done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:14.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:14.stem:
After ____ to the college, he began to work to earn tuition fees.
（被大学录取后，他开始工作赚学费。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:14.explanation: After 后接动名词，he 是被录取的一方，用 having been admitted 表示录取先于 began，选 D。注意：after being admitted 也能表达“被录取之后”，不能仅凭动作有先后就排除一般式。

zsb-english:11:quiz-5:15.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:15.stem:
将 Though he was tired 改写为“连词 + 形容词”的省略结构：Though ____, he still went on working.
（尽管很累，他仍继续工作。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-5:15.explanation: 本题要求“连词 + 形容词”的省略结构：从 Though he was tired 中省去与主句相同的主语 he 和 be 动词 was，保留 Though tired，选 B。Though being tired 本身并非语法错误，但不是本题指定的简化形式。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:0.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:0.stem:
The students ____ in the classroom are listening to the teacher carefully.
（坐在教室里的学生正在认真听老师讲课。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:0.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。students 主动“坐着”且正在 → doing 作后置定语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:1.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:1.stem:
The work ____ at present needs more people.
（目前正在进行的工作需要更多人手。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:1.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。at present 正在进行且 work 被做 → being done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:2.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:2.stem:
The man ____ to the manager now is our leader.
（现在正在和经理谈话的那个人是我们的领导。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:2.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。man 主动谈话且 now 正在进行 → doing 作定语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:3.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:3.stem:
The girl ____ in the park is my sister.
（正在公园玩耍的女孩是我妹妹。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:3.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。girl 主动玩耍且正在 → doing 作定语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:4.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:4.stem:
The boy sat by the window, ____ a book.
（男孩坐在窗边看书。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:4.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。伴随状语 → doing。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:5.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:5.stem:
The food ____ now smells delicious.
（现在正在烹饪的食物闻起来很香。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:5.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。now 正在被烹饪 → being done 作定语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:6.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:6.stem:
____ the news yesterday, she is very happy now.
（昨天得知这个消息后，她现在非常高兴。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:6.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。“被告知”先于现在且 she 被动 → having been done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:7.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:7.stem:
____ by the teacher, she decided to study harder.
（受到老师批评后，她决定更加努力学习。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:7.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。批评先发生且她被批评 → having been done 作原因状语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:8.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:8.stem:
____ his homework, he went out to play.
（做完作业后，他出去玩了。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:8.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。he 主动完成且先于 went out → having done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:9.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:9.stem:
The book ____ by him last year is very popular.
（他去年写的那本书很受欢迎。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:9.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。last year 已写完且书被写 → done 作后置定语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:10.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:10.stem:
The letter ____ yesterday has been sent.
（昨天写的信已经寄出。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:10.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。yesterday 已写完且信被写 → done 作定语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:11.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:11.stem:
After ____ for the job, you will be required to take a skill test.
（参加工作面试后，你将被要求参加技能测试。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:11.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。After 介词后接 doing；you 被面试 → being done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:12.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:12.stem:
It is no use ____ to him. He is always indifferent to others’ matters.
（向他求助没用；他总是对别人的事漠不关心。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:12.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。It is no use doing 固定句型。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:13.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:13.stem:
Because they have difficulty ____ the stress, some students choose to do exercise to relax themselves.
（因为难以应对压力，一些学生选择锻炼来放松。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:13.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。have difficulty (in) doing 固定搭配。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:14.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:14.stem:
As a teacher, I always can’t help ____ about how to help my students improve their grades.
（作为老师，我总忍不住思考怎样帮助学生提高成绩。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:14.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。can’t help doing 禁不住做某事。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:15.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:15.stem:
____ of danger in the street at night, she had to go home with a friend ____ her.
（因为被警告夜间街上有危险，她只好由一位朋友陪同回家。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:15.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。she“被警告”先发生 → having been done；friend 主动陪同 → accompanying。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:16.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:16.stem:
When it comes to ____ in public, no one can match the young man.
（说到公开演讲，没人比得上这个年轻人。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:16.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。when it comes to 中 to 是介词 → doing。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:17.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:17.stem:
____ the news, everyone was very ____. We couldn’t believe it was true.
（听到这个消息，大家都很失望；我们无法相信这是真的。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:17.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。everyone 主动“听到” → doing 作状语；人感到失望 → -ed（disappointed）。

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:18.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-6:18.stem: On the night when we arrived in New York, I suggested ____ at the hotel but my wife was eager ____.（抵达纽约当晚，我建议留在酒店，但妻子急着去购物。）

options.text: B. to stay; to go shopping

zsb-english:11:quiz-6:18.explanation: 教材 P169 非谓语综合。suggest 接 doing；be eager to do 接不定式。

zsb-english:11:quiz-7:0.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:0.stem:
After the Arab states won independence, great emphasis was laid on expanding education, with girls as well as boys ____ to go to school.
（阿拉伯国家独立后，教育扩展受到高度重视，男孩和女孩都受到鼓励去上学。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:0.explanation: 教材 P173 独立主格练习（笔记补充解析）。with 复合结构中 girls/boys 与 encourage 被动，语境表进行状态 → being done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-7:1.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:1.stem:
With so many beautiful dresses ____, the little girl didn’t know which one to buy.
（有这么多漂亮裙子可供选择，小女孩不知道买哪一件。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:1.explanation: 教材 P173 独立主格练习（笔记补充解析）。尚待选择，to do 表将来；from 不能漏（choose from the dresses）。

zsb-english:11:quiz-7:2.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:2.stem:
With the door ____, he couldn’t get in.
（门锁着，他进不去。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:2.explanation: 教材 P173 独立主格练习（笔记补充解析）。door 被锁 → done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-7:3.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:3.stem:
With the plan ____ well, they are sure to succeed.
（如果计划执行得好，他们一定会成功。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:3.explanation: 教材 P173 独立主格练习（笔记补充解析）。plan 与 carry out 被动 → done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-7:4.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:4.stem:
With the baby ____, the mother had a short rest.
（婴儿睡着时，母亲短暂休息了一会儿。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:4.explanation: 教材 P173 独立主格练习（笔记补充解析）。baby 主动睡觉 → doing。

zsb-english:11:quiz-7:5.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:5.stem:
【24 重庆】If you quote an article in your essay, you must acknowledge your source, ____ details of author and title.
（如果在文章中引用他人的文章，必须注明来源，并给出作者和标题的详细信息。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:5.explanation: 课件末页真题（笔记补充解析）。giving 与 acknowledge 的主语相同，作伴随状语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-7:6.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:6.stem:
【24 重庆】____ no reports of adverse reaction, the drug is allowed to be produced by FAD.
（由于没有不良反应报告，该药获准由 FAD 生产。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:6.explanation: 课件末页真题（笔记补充解析）。There being no reports... 是独立主格结构作原因状语。

zsb-english:11:quiz-7:7.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:7.stem:
【22 重庆】The zoo is getting ready ____ by an animal welfare organization.
（该动物园正准备接受一家动物福利组织的检查。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:7.explanation: 课件末页真题（笔记补充解析）。get ready to do；zoo 与 inspect 是被动 → to be done。

zsb-english:11:quiz-7:8.title: 非谓语动词 Non-finite Verbs
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:8.stem:
【22 重庆】____ their loss, you have to do something to prevent it.
（为了弥补他们的损失，你必须采取措施阻止这种情况。）
zsb-english:11:quiz-7:8.explanation: 课件末页真题（笔记补充解析）。“为了弥补”表目的 → to do。

zsb-english:12:quiz:0.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:0.stem:
（原题：找出下列句子的先行词和关系词）
He is a teacher who likes playing football.

options.text: A. 先行词 teacher / 关系词 who
B. 先行词 He / 关系词 who
C. 先行词 teacher / 关系词 likes
D. 先行词 playing / 关系词 who

zsb-english:12:quiz:0.explanation: 笔记原「找出先行词和关系词」题：先行词 teacher，关系词 who。

zsb-english:12:quiz:1.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:1.stem:
（原题：找出下列句子的先行词和关系词）
There were buildings which had been destroyed by the earthquake.

options.text: A. 先行词 buildings / 关系词 which
B. 先行词 earthquake / 关系词 which
C. 先行词 buildings / 关系词 had
D. 先行词 There / 关系词 which

zsb-english:12:quiz:1.explanation: 笔记原「找出先行词和关系词」题：先行词 buildings，关系词 which。

zsb-english:12:quiz:2.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:2.stem:
（原题：找出下列句子的先行词和关系词）
The gold medal which she won has been given to her school.

options.text: A. 先行词 school / 关系词 which
B. 先行词 the gold medal / 关系词 which
C. 先行词 medal / 关系词 she
D. 先行词 won / 关系词 which

zsb-english:12:quiz:2.explanation: 笔记原「找出先行词和关系词」题：先行词 the gold medal，关系词 which。

zsb-english:12:quiz:3.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:3.stem: This is the oldest church ____ I have known in England.
zsb-english:12:quiz:3.explanation: 先行词被最高级修饰 → 只能用 that。

zsb-english:12:quiz:4.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:4.stem: London, ____ is a very beautiful city, attracts a lot of tourists every year.
zsb-english:12:quiz:4.explanation: 非限制性定语从句、先行词指物（London）→ which；that 不能引导非限。

zsb-english:12:quiz:5.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:5.stem: My friend Tom lives near the shopping mall ____ was built two years ago.
zsb-english:12:quiz:5.explanation: 从句缺主语、先行词指物 → 关系代词 that。

zsb-english:12:quiz:6.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:6.stem: He is the man ____ cellphone was stolen in the street yesterday.

zsb-english:12:quiz:7.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:7.stem: The nurse ____ is answering the patient’s questions is Miss Lee.
zsb-english:12:quiz:7.explanation: 从句缺主语、先行词指人 → who。

zsb-english:12:quiz:8.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:8.stem: He has done everything ____ he can do for you.
zsb-english:12:quiz:8.explanation: 先行词 everything 是不定代词 → 只能用 that。

zsb-english:12:quiz:9.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:9.stem: This is the best hotel in the city ____ I have known.
zsb-english:12:quiz:9.explanation: 先行词被最高级修饰 → 只能用 that。

zsb-english:12:quiz:10.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:10.stem: We supply different telephone communication products, some of ____ are particularly useful for small businesses.
zsb-english:12:quiz:10.explanation: some of + which 指物（products）；指人才用 whom。

zsb-english:12:quiz:11.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:11.stem: He talked a lot about the people and things ____ he remembered in the school.
zsb-english:12:quiz:11.explanation: 先行词既有人也有物 → 只能用 that。

zsb-english:12:quiz:12.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:12.stem: We should learn from those ____ are always ready to help others.
zsb-english:12:quiz:12.explanation: those who... 固定结构（指人的不定代词 those 用 who）。

zsb-english:12:quiz:13.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:13.stem: I wonder how humans can live on another planet ____ there is no life.
zsb-english:12:quiz:13.explanation: live on the planet 的介词 on 提前 → on which；where 前不能加介词。

zsb-english:12:quiz:14.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:14.stem: （原填空题）Tell us all things ____ you know.
zsb-english:12:quiz:14.explanation: 笔记原填空题，答案 that：all 修饰先行词 things → 只能用 that。

zsb-english:12:quiz:15.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:15.stem: （原填空题）There is no obstacle ____ you can’t overcome.
zsb-english:12:quiz:15.explanation: 笔记原填空题，答案 that：否定先行词 obstacle 按 no 修饰处理 → 只能用 that。

zsb-english:12:quiz:16.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:16.stem: （原填空题）The only thing ____ you should do in this period is to know yourself.
zsb-english:12:quiz:16.explanation: 笔记原填空题，答案 that：the only 修饰先行词 → 只能用 that。

zsb-english:12:quiz:17.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:17.stem: （原填空题）He is the very person ____ I want to find.
zsb-english:12:quiz:17.explanation: 笔记原填空题，答案 that：the very 修饰先行词 → 只能用 that。

zsb-english:12:quiz:18.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:18.stem: （原填空题）I became a millionaire overnight, ____ I never expected before.
zsb-english:12:quiz:18.explanation: 笔记原填空题，答案 which：非限制性定语从句指代整句话 → which（that 不能引导非限）。

zsb-english:12:quiz:19.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:19.stem: I’ll never forget the day ____ I became a doctor.
zsb-english:12:quiz:19.explanation: 先行词 the day 表时间，从句不缺成分 → when。

zsb-english:12:quiz:20.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:20.stem: The farm ____ we learned to feed cattle ten years ago has changed a lot.
zsb-english:12:quiz:20.explanation: 先行词 the farm 表地点，从句不缺成分 → where。

zsb-english:12:quiz:21.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:21.stem: Now Dr. Ross is explaining the reason ____ so many people request medical reform.

zsb-english:12:quiz:22.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:22.stem: （原填空题）I still remember the year ____ I started to learn painting.
zsb-english:12:quiz:22.explanation: 笔记原填空题，答案 when：时间先行词，从句不缺成分 → when。

zsb-english:12:quiz:23.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:23.stem: （原填空题）The books ____ I borrowed from the library were really interesting.
zsb-english:12:quiz:23.explanation: 笔记原填空题，答案 that/which：borrowed 缺宾语 → 关系代词。

zsb-english:12:quiz:24.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:24.stem: （原填空题）Do you know the reason ____ he was absent from school yesterday?
zsb-english:12:quiz:24.explanation: 笔记原填空题，答案 why：reason 作先行词。

zsb-english:12:quiz:25.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:25.stem: （原填空题）This is the photo ____ reminds me of my childhood.
zsb-english:12:quiz:25.explanation: 笔记原填空题，答案 that/which：reminds 缺主语 → 关系代词。

zsb-english:12:quiz:26.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:26.stem: （原填空题）The park ____ we often take a walk is very beautiful.
zsb-english:12:quiz:26.explanation: 笔记原填空题，答案 where：park 地点、从句不缺成分 → where。

zsb-english:12:quiz:27.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:27.stem: （原填空题）This is the museum ____ we visited last Sunday.
zsb-english:12:quiz:27.explanation: 笔记原填空题，答案 that/which：visited 缺宾语 → 关系代词（不缺成分才用 where）。

zsb-english:12:quiz:28.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:28.stem: 【24重庆真题改编】Alex is the only one of the students who ____ a scholarship winner for three years.
zsb-english:12:quiz:28.explanation: the only one of... → 从句谓语用单数；for three years 与完成时连用 → has been。

zsb-english:12:quiz:29.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:29.stem: （原填空题）Students at university can learn and make friends ____ will last a lifetime.
zsb-english:12:quiz:29.explanation: 笔记原填空题，答案 that/which：friends 后定语从句缺主语 → 关系代词。

zsb-english:12:quiz:30.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:30.stem: The reason ____ he rejected our plan is that he had no faith in us.
zsb-english:12:quiz:30.explanation: the reason + 从句不缺成分 → why。

zsb-english:12:quiz:31.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:31.stem: Mr. Herpin is one of the foreign experts who ____ in China.
zsb-english:12:quiz:31.explanation: one of + 复数名词 + 定从 → 从句谓语用复数。

zsb-english:12:quiz:32.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:32.stem: We should learn from those ____ are always ready to help others.

zsb-english:12:quiz:33.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:33.stem: The new policy, ____ is about the tax reduction, is to be carried out next month.
zsb-english:12:quiz:33.explanation: 非限制性定语从句指物 → which；that 不能引导非限。

zsb-english:12:quiz:34.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:34.stem: All ____ you can do to comfort her is to listen to her story patiently.

zsb-english:12:quiz:35.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:35.stem: We are living in an age ____ many things are done on the computer.
zsb-english:12:quiz:35.explanation: age 是时间先行词，从句不缺成分 → when。

zsb-english:12:quiz:36.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:36.stem: I shall never forget the days ____ we worked on the farm to experience life.
zsb-english:12:quiz:36.explanation: the days 表时间、从句不缺成分 → when；on that 介词错误。

zsb-english:12:quiz:37.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:37.stem: Our new car, ____ we bought last month, seats five people.
zsb-english:12:quiz:37.explanation: 非限制性定语从句指物 → which。

zsb-english:12:quiz:38.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:38.stem: Jack did not pass the driving test, ____ we had expected.
zsb-english:12:quiz:38.explanation: as 指代整句话，"正如我们所预料的"；as 的非限从句可放句首/句尾。

zsb-english:12:quiz:39.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:39.stem: 【25湖南真题】I would like to travel to an island ____ there is plenty of sunshine.
zsb-english:12:quiz:39.explanation: an island 地点先行词，从句不缺成分 → where。

zsb-english:12:quiz:40.title: 定语从句 Attributive Clauses
zsb-english:12:quiz:40.stem: 【22重庆真题】Mary was much kinder to her youngest child than she was to the others, ____, of course, made the others jealous.
zsb-english:12:quiz:40.explanation: which 指代前面整件事（非限指句），"这当然让其他孩子嫉妒"。

zsb-english:13:quiz:0.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:0.stem: Excuse me, can you show me ____ you operate the machine?
zsb-english:13:quiz:0.explanation: 从句不缺主要成分，删掉引导词含义不完整（"如何操作"）→ 用有含义的 how。

zsb-english:13:quiz:1.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:1.stem: The news ____ our athletes won another gold medal was reported in yesterday’s newspaper.
zsb-english:13:quiz:1.explanation: 同位语从句：从句不缺成分、无含义 → that（if 不能引导同位语从句）。

zsb-english:13:quiz:2.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:2.stem: ____ surprised all of us was that he canceled the meeting.

zsb-english:13:quiz:3.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:3.stem: 【22重庆真题改编】____ makes me feel surprised is that he made such a success.
zsb-english:13:quiz:3.explanation: 主语从句缺主语（makes 前没有主语）→ What；That 不作成分但需从句完整。

zsb-english:13:quiz:4.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:4.stem: 【22重庆】____ I can’t understand is ____ he wants to change his mind.
zsb-english:13:quiz:4.explanation: 第一空 understand 缺宾语 → What；第二空从句完整 → that。

zsb-english:13:quiz:5.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:5.stem: ____ the team will win the championship depends on their performance in the final.
zsb-english:13:quiz:5.explanation: 主语从句表"是否"用 Whether；if 不能引导主语从句。

zsb-english:13:quiz:6.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:6.stem: ____ surprised us most was his sudden decision to quit the job.

zsb-english:13:quiz:7.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:7.stem: ____ is important that we should protect the environment.
zsb-english:13:quiz:7.explanation: It 作形式主语（It is important that...）。

zsb-english:13:quiz:8.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:8.stem: ____ we can solve the problem efficiently requires careful discussion.
zsb-english:13:quiz:8.explanation: 从句不缺主要成分，"如何高效解决"有含义 → How。

zsb-english:13:quiz:9.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:9.stem: ____ he often forgot their wedding anniversary greatly annoyed his wife.
zsb-english:13:quiz:9.explanation: 从句完整、引导词无含义 → That。

zsb-english:13:quiz:10.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:10.stem: ____ I am trying to do is to persuade my elder brother to give up smoking.

zsb-english:13:quiz:11.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:11.stem: ____ we can succeed or not depends on how well we cooperate with others.
zsb-english:13:quiz:11.explanation: Whether...or not 引导主语从句。

zsb-english:13:quiz:12.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:12.stem: They are talking about ____ they should accept the offer.

zsb-english:13:quiz:13.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:13.stem: I find ____ necessary that we practice English every day.
zsb-english:13:quiz:13.explanation: it 作形式宾语（find it necessary that...）。

zsb-english:13:quiz:14.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:14.stem: He asked me ____ would attend the party with him.
zsb-english:13:quiz:14.explanation: 从句缺主语且指人 → who。

zsb-english:13:quiz:15.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
