zsb-english:13:quiz:15.stem: She said she ____ visit her grandparents the next week.
zsb-english:13:quiz:15.explanation: 主句 said 是过去时，the next week 提示过去将来时 → would。

zsb-english:13:quiz:16.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:16.stem: This story is about ____ a boy managed to save a little girl in the earthquake.

zsb-english:13:quiz:17.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:17.stem: I wonder ____ Mary has kept her figure over the years.

zsb-english:13:quiz:18.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:18.stem: You might keep those old jam bottles. You never know ____ you might need them.
zsb-english:13:quiz:18.explanation: "不知道什么时候会用到" → when。

zsb-english:13:quiz:19.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:19.stem:
Could you please tell me ____?
—Well, I always write e-mails to my pen pals.

options.text: A. how do you learn Chinese
B. what is your pen pal’s hobby
C. what do you do after class
D. how you improve your writing

zsb-english:13:quiz:19.explanation: 宾语从句用陈述语序排除 A/B/C；答语"总是写邮件" → 怎么提高写作。

zsb-english:13:quiz:20.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:20.stem: The reason for his absence is ____ he missed the early bus.
zsb-english:13:quiz:20.explanation: reason 作主语 → 表语从句用 that，不用 because。

zsb-english:13:quiz:21.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:21.stem: The problem is ____ he said at the meeting yesterday.

zsb-english:13:quiz:22.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:22.stem: The reason why I didn’t attend the lecture that day was simply ____ I got a bad cold.
zsb-english:13:quiz:22.explanation: reason 作主语 → 表语从句用 that。

zsb-english:13:quiz:23.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:23.stem: The most important thing is not ____ you do, but ____ you do it.
zsb-english:13:quiz:23.explanation: 做"什么"用 what；"怎么"做用 how。

zsb-english:13:quiz:24.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:24.stem: My happiest moment is ____ I attended my best friend’s wedding.
zsb-english:13:quiz:24.explanation: 时刻是"我参加婚礼的时候" → when。

zsb-english:13:quiz:25.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:25.stem: Please put the glass on the top shelf. It’s ____ the glass is beyond the reach of our children.
zsb-english:13:quiz:25.explanation: 表语从句：放在架子顶层，"那里"孩子够不着 → where。（beyond the reach of：超出……的能力范围；够不着）

zsb-english:13:quiz:26.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:26.stem: We heard the news ____ our team had won the game.
zsb-english:13:quiz:26.explanation: news 是抽象名词，that 从句说明其内容 → 同位语从句，that 不作成分不可省略。

zsb-english:13:quiz:27.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:27.stem: This is the fact ____ he refused to accept the invitation.
zsb-english:13:quiz:27.explanation: fact 后同位语从句 → that。

zsb-english:13:quiz:28.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:28.stem: The evidence ____ too much exposure to the sun is closely linked to skin cancer is convincing.
zsb-english:13:quiz:28.explanation: evidence 是抽象名词 → 同位语从句用 that。

zsb-english:13:quiz:29.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:29.stem: The fact ____ Helen was late for the weekly meeting again made the manager very angry.
zsb-english:13:quiz:29.explanation: fact 后同位语从句 → that。

zsb-english:13:quiz:30.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:30.stem: There is an idea ____ too much stress can partly cause the disease.
zsb-english:13:quiz:30.explanation: idea 后同位语从句 → that。（partly：在一定程度上）

zsb-english:13:quiz:31.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:31.stem: Our coach told us that the key to winning is to have the belief ____ we are better than anyone else on the sports field.
zsb-english:13:quiz:31.explanation: belief 后同位语从句 → that。

zsb-english:13:quiz:32.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:32.stem: It is generally considered unwise to give a child ____ he or she wants.
zsb-english:13:quiz:32.explanation: give a child whatever he or she wants 给孩子"任何他想要的"，泛指 → whatever。

zsb-english:13:quiz:33.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:33.stem:
—Could you do me a favor?
—It depends on ____ it is.
zsb-english:13:quiz:33.explanation: depends on 后介词宾语从句缺表语 → what it is（"是什么忙"）。

zsb-english:13:quiz:34.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:34.stem: Elephants have their own way to tell the shape of an object and ____ it is rough or smooth.
zsb-english:13:quiz:34.explanation: whether...or not 表"是粗糙还是光滑"（是否）。

zsb-english:13:quiz:35.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:35.stem: I drove to Zhuhai for the air show last week. It is ____ I had a few days off.
zsb-english:13:quiz:35.explanation: "那就是为什么我有几天假"——解释原因 → why（It is why... = That is why）。

zsb-english:13:quiz:36.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:36.stem:
—Do you know ____ the meeting will start?
—At 3:00 this afternoon.
zsb-english:13:quiz:36.explanation: 答语 At 3:00 是时间 → when。

zsb-english:13:quiz:37.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:37.stem: ____ is known to us all is that the 2022 Winter Olympics will be held in Beijing.
zsb-english:13:quiz:37.explanation: 主语从句缺主语 → What；As 不能引导带谓语 is 的主语从句放句首。

zsb-english:13:quiz:38.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:38.stem: ____ is reported that the 2022 Winter Olympics will be held in Beijing.
zsb-english:13:quiz:38.explanation: It is reported that... 固定句型（It 作形式主语）。

zsb-english:13:quiz:39.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:39.stem: ____ is known to us all that the 2022 Winter Olympics will be held in Beijing.
zsb-english:13:quiz:39.explanation: It is known to us all that... 固定句型。

zsb-english:13:quiz:40.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:40.stem: Along with the letter was his promise ____ he would visit me this coming Christmas.
zsb-english:13:quiz:40.explanation: promise 后同位语从句 → that。

zsb-english:13:quiz:41.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:41.stem: Juliet has gone to Milan and I wonder ____ she can make it to（赶到）our wedding or not.
zsb-english:13:quiz:41.explanation: 与 or not 连用必须用 whether，不用 if。

zsb-english:13:quiz:42.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:42.stem: We consider ____ he should clean the room by himself every day.
zsb-english:13:quiz:42.explanation: consider + it + necessary + that：it 作形式宾语，语序为 it necessary that。

zsb-english:13:quiz:43.title: 名词性从句 Noun Clauses
zsb-english:13:quiz:43.stem: In order to search for the escaped prisoner, the police decide to question ____ comes along on this road.
zsb-english:13:quiz:43.explanation: 课件原解析：从句中 comes 为谓语，其前缺主语，排除 B/D；who 引导宾语从句通常表特指，whoever = anyone who 表泛指"无论谁"，符合"盘问所有出现在这条路上的人"。

zsb-english:14:quiz:0.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:0.stem: She was watching TV ____ I came in.
zsb-english:14:quiz:0.explanation: 从句动作 came in 短暂，主句 was watching 持续，用 when。（时间状语从句随堂练习）

zsb-english:14:quiz:1.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:1.stem: I will call you as soon as I ____ there.
zsb-english:14:quiz:1.explanation: 时间状语从句遵循“主将从现”，用一般现在时 get。

zsb-english:14:quiz:2.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:2.stem: I was about to leave the office ____ the telephone rang.
zsb-english:14:quiz:2.explanation: 固定结构 be about to do...when...，“正要做某事，这时突然……”。

zsb-english:14:quiz:3.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:3.stem: He didn’t go to bed ____ he finished his homework.

zsb-english:14:quiz:4.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:4.stem: The children ran away ____ they saw the teacher.
zsb-english:14:quiz:4.explanation: 表示“一看见老师就跑开”，用 as soon as。

zsb-english:14:quiz:5.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:5.stem: You should make it a rule to leave things ____ you can find them again easily.
zsb-english:14:quiz:5.explanation: where 引导地点状语从句：把物品放在以后容易找到的地方。（笔记标注为参考答案，课件未标）

zsb-english:14:quiz:6.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:6.stem: Medicine should not be kept ____ the children can easily reach.
zsb-english:14:quiz:6.explanation: 空处引导地点状语从句且在从句中作地点状语，应选 where；when 引导时间状语从句，which 与 that 常引导名词性从句或定语从句。句意：药品不应该放在孩子们能毫不费力够到的地方。

zsb-english:14:quiz:7.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:7.stem: I didn’t go to the party last night ____ I was very tired.
zsb-english:14:quiz:7.explanation: “很累”是昨晚没去聚会的直接原因，用 because。（笔记标注为参考答案，课件未标）

zsb-english:14:quiz:8.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:8.stem: ____ we have finished the project, why don’t you take a week off?
zsb-english:14:quiz:8.explanation: Now that 表示“既然”，引导原因状语从句；But for 表“要不是”需接名词且常用于虚拟语气；Ever since 引导时间状语从句；Even if 引导让步状语从句。

zsb-english:14:quiz:9.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:9.stem: The children were very excited these days ____ the Christmas party was to be held.
zsb-english:14:quiz:9.explanation: 圣诞聚会即将举行是孩子们兴奋的原因，用 because。（笔记补充解析）

zsb-english:14:quiz:10.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:10.stem: You need to practise talking to each other ____ you want to speak fluent English.
zsb-english:14:quiz:10.explanation: 想说流利英语是需要互相练习交谈的条件，用 if。（笔记标注为参考答案，课件未标）

zsb-english:14:quiz:11.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:11.stem: Remember my phone number ____ you need my help one day.
zsb-english:14:quiz:11.explanation: 记住电话号码是“以防”将来需要帮助，in case 符合语义。

zsb-english:14:quiz:12.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:12.stem: You can join us in this activity ____ you follow these rules strictly.
zsb-english:14:quiz:12.explanation: 严格遵守规则是参加活动的条件，on condition that 表示“条件是”。

zsb-english:14:quiz:13.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:13.stem: We have to get that car fixed ____.

options.text: A. no matter it costs how much
B. no matter how much costs it
C. no matter how much it costs
D. no matter how much does it cost

zsb-english:14:quiz:13.explanation: no matter how much 后接陈述语序 it costs。

zsb-english:14:quiz:14.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:14.stem: If you work with a strong will, you can overcome the difficulty, ____ great it is.
zsb-english:14:quiz:14.explanation: however + 形容词 + 主语 + 谓语，表示“无论多么……”。

zsb-english:14:quiz:15.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:15.stem: ____ difficulty they may come across, they’ll help one another to overcome it.
zsb-english:14:quiz:15.explanation: difficulty 是名词，用 whatever + 名词。

zsb-english:14:quiz:16.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:16.stem: ____ Cindy joined the company only one year ago, she has been promoted twice.
zsb-english:14:quiz:16.explanation: 前后是让步关系：虽然入职仅一年，却已晋升两次。

zsb-english:14:quiz:17.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:17.stem: He made ____ great progress ____ his parents were very pleased with him.
zsb-english:14:quiz:17.explanation: progress 是不可数名词，结构为 such + 形容词 + 名词 + that。（课件未附答案，笔记补充解析）

zsb-english:14:quiz:18.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:18.stem: The film was ____ boring ____ I fell asleep in the cinema.
zsb-english:14:quiz:18.explanation: boring 是形容词，结构为 so + 形容词 + that。（课件未附答案，笔记补充解析）

zsb-english:14:quiz:19.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:19.stem: It is known to all that ____ you exercise regularly, you won’t keep good health.
zsb-english:14:quiz:19.explanation: unless = if...not：除非经常锻炼，否则不能保持健康。

zsb-english:14:quiz:20.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:20.stem: ____ I can see, there is only one possible way to keep away from the danger.
zsb-english:14:quiz:20.explanation: 固定表达 as far as I can see，意为“据我所见”。

zsb-english:14:quiz:21.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:21.stem: We were about to leave ____ it began to rain.
zsb-english:14:quiz:21.explanation: be about to do...when...，正要做某事时突然……。

zsb-english:14:quiz:22.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:22.stem: The day must be breaking, ____ the birds have begun singing.
zsb-english:14:quiz:22.explanation: for 补充说明推断理由：鸟已开始鸣叫，所以天一定快亮了。

zsb-english:14:quiz:23.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:23.stem: You are free to go ____ you like.
zsb-english:14:quiz:23.explanation: wherever 表示“无论你喜欢去哪里”。

zsb-english:14:quiz:24.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:24.stem: I hurried ____ I wouldn’t be late for class.
zsb-english:14:quiz:24.explanation: 匆忙的目的是不迟到，so that 引导目的状语从句。

zsb-english:14:quiz:25.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:25.explanation: not...until... 表示“直到他来我才离开”。

zsb-english:14:quiz:26.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:26.stem: I still like the building in my village, ____ it is rather old and nearly falls down.
zsb-english:14:quiz:26.explanation: 建筑虽旧且将倒塌，我仍喜欢它，though 引导让步从句。

zsb-english:14:quiz:27.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:27.stem: ____ the government agree to give extra money, the theater will have to close next week.
zsb-english:14:quiz:27.explanation: 除非政府同意追加资金，否则剧院将关闭。

zsb-english:14:quiz:28.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:28.stem: It will be a while ____ we know the results of the experiments.
zsb-english:14:quiz:28.explanation: It will be + 一段时间 + before...：要过一段时间才……。

zsb-english:14:quiz:29.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:29.stem: Many of them turned a deaf ear to his advice, ____ they knew it was valuable.
zsb-english:14:quiz:29.explanation: 即使知道建议有价值，许多人仍置若罔闻，even though 表让步。

zsb-english:14:quiz:30.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:30.stem: ____ decision my good friend Tom makes, I will support it heart and soul.
zsb-english:14:quiz:30.explanation: decision 是名词，用 no matter what + 名词。

zsb-english:14:quiz:31.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:31.stem: They will finish the task before the deadline ____ they are given enough support.
zsb-english:14:quiz:31.explanation: 只要获得足够支持就能按时完成，as long as 表条件。

zsb-english:14:quiz:32.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:32.stem: I will pay a visit to my old friends ____ she comes back from abroad.
zsb-english:14:quiz:32.explanation: the minute 可直接作连词，表示“一……就……”。

zsb-english:14:quiz:33.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:33.stem: ____ it was, traffic in the downtown area was already building up.
zsb-english:14:quiz:33.explanation: 课件原标记为 As；笔记指出 PDF 题干疑有缺字（未显示倒装应提前的表语），按课件标记保留答案，不擅自补写。

zsb-english:14:quiz:34.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:34.stem: You’d better visit Shangri-La（香格里拉）____ the weather is at its mildest in spring or autumn.
zsb-english:14:quiz:34.explanation: when 引导时间状语从句：在春秋气候最温和时游览。

zsb-english:14:quiz:35.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:35.stem: ____ we were staying in China, we saw many interesting things.
zsb-english:14:quiz:35.explanation: while 后接完整从句，表示在中国停留期间；during 是介词，不能接句子。

zsb-english:14:quiz:36.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:36.stem: A prisoner escaped from prison last night. It wasn’t long ____ the guards discovered what had happened.
zsb-english:14:quiz:36.explanation: It wasn’t long before...：没过多久就……。

zsb-english:14:quiz:37.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:37.stem: I’d like to arrive 20 minutes earlier ____ I can have time for a cup of tea.
zsb-english:14:quiz:37.explanation: 提前到达的目的是留出喝茶时间，so that 引导目的从句。

zsb-english:14:quiz:38.title: 状语从句 Adverbial Clauses
zsb-english:14:quiz:38.stem: Peter had to work hard day and night ____ he could earn more to pay for his new house.
zsb-english:14:quiz:38.explanation: 日夜工作的目的是赚更多钱，in order that 引导目的从句。

zsb-english:15:quiz:0.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:0.stem:
The job would require that ____ at 7 o’clock every morning.
（这份工作要求他每天早上七点到工厂。）

options.text: A. he will be at the factory
B. he be at the factory
C. he was at the factory
D. he has been at the factory

zsb-english:15:quiz:0.explanation: require 后的 that 从句用 (should) be，should 可省略。（(should) be 型随堂练习）

zsb-english:15:quiz:1.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:1.stem:
Your advice that she ____ till next week is reasonable.
（你建议她等到下周，这一建议很合理。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:1.explanation: advice 后的同位语从句用 (should) wait。

zsb-english:15:quiz:2.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:2.stem:
It is necessary that a worker ____ his work on time.
（工人按时完成工作是必要的。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:2.explanation: It is necessary that... 后用 (should) accomplish。

zsb-english:15:quiz:3.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:3.stem:
The government suggests people ____ the Spring Festival at their working place this year.
（政府建议人们今年在工作地过春节。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:3.explanation: suggest 表“建议”，从句用 (should) spend。

zsb-english:15:quiz:4.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:4.stem:
The physicists propose that our attention ____ the use of special methods of thinking and acting.
（物理学家建议我们把注意力转向特殊思维和行动方法的运用。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:4.explanation: propose 表“建议”，attention 与 direct 是被动关系，用 (should) be directed。

zsb-english:15:quiz:5.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:5.stem:
The boy insisted that he ____ old enough, and ____ the right to make his own choice.
（那个男孩坚持说自己年龄已经够大，并坚持要求得到自主选择的权利。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:5.explanation: 第一个 insist 表“坚持说”，陈述事实用 was；第二个表“坚持要求”，用 (should) be given。

zsb-english:15:quiz:6.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:6.stem:
You are overweight. You’d better ____ any junk food. I suggest you ____ more vegetables.
（你超重了。你最好不要吃垃圾食品；我建议你多吃蔬菜。）

options.text: A. not to eat; to have

zsb-english:15:quiz:6.explanation: had better 后接动词原形，否定为 had better not do；suggest 从句用 (should) have。

zsb-english:15:quiz:7.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:7.stem:
I enjoyed the movie very much. I wish I ____ the book from which it was made.
（我很喜欢这部电影，真希望自己读过它所改编自的那本书。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:7.explanation: wish 针对过去未发生之事，使用 had done。（were 型随堂练习）

zsb-english:15:quiz:8.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:8.stem:
The two students talked as if they ____ friends for years.
（两名学生交谈起来，好像已经做了多年朋友。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:8.explanation: “做了多年朋友”先于 talked，用 had been。

zsb-english:15:quiz:9.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:9.stem:
If only he ____ quietly as the doctor instructed, he would not suffer so much now.
（要是他当时按医生嘱咐静静躺着就好了，他现在就不会受这么多罪。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:9.explanation: 从句与过去事实相反，主句结果落在现在，是错综时间虚拟。

zsb-english:15:quiz:10.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:10.stem:
“He will come tomorrow.” “But I’d rather he ____ the day after tomorrow.”
（“他明天会来。”“但我宁愿他后天来。”）
zsb-english:15:quiz:10.explanation: would rather 后对将来愿望用一般过去时。

zsb-english:15:quiz:11.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:11.stem:
The sun rises in the east and sets in the west, so it seems as if the sun ____ round the earth.
（太阳东升西落，因此看起来仿佛太阳在绕着地球转。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:11.explanation: as if 描述与事实相反的表象，be 用 were，动作表进行。

zsb-english:15:quiz:12.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:12.stem:
If I ____ where he lived now, I ____ a note to him.
（如果我现在知道他住在哪里，就会给他寄张便条。）

options.text: B. had known; would have sent

zsb-english:15:quiz:12.explanation: now 指向现在：if 从句用 knew，主句用 would send。（同一时空随堂练习）

zsb-english:15:quiz:13.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:13.stem:
If we ____ more time, we could do it better.
（如果给我们更多时间，我们能把它做得更好。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:13.explanation: 与现在事实相反，we 与 give 是被动关系，用 were given。

zsb-english:15:quiz:14.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:14.stem:
If I ____ a boss, I would manage a big factory.
（如果我是老板，我会管理一家大工厂。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:14.explanation: 与现在事实相反，be 一律用 were。

zsb-english:15:quiz:15.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:15.stem:
If I ____ not so busy, I ____ with you.
（如果我没这么忙，我就会和你一起去。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:15.explanation: 从句 were，主句 would go。

zsb-english:15:quiz:16.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:16.stem:
— If he ____, he ____ that food. — Luckily he was sent to the hospital immediately.
（- 如果他事先得到警告，就不会吃那种食物了。- 幸运的是，他立刻被送往医院。）

options.text: A. was warned; would not take
B. had been warned; would not have taken
C. would be warned; had not taken
D. would have been warned; had not taken

zsb-english:15:quiz:16.explanation: 对过去虚拟：had been warned / would not have taken。

zsb-english:15:quiz:17.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:17.stem:
If I ____ harder when I was young, I ____ a university and lived a different life.
（如果我年轻时更加努力，我就会考上大学，过上不同的生活。）

options.text: B. had worked; would have entered
D. have worked; will have entered

zsb-english:15:quiz:17.explanation: when I was young 指过去：had worked / would have entered。

zsb-english:15:quiz:18.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:18.stem:
Without the air to hold some of the sun’s heat, the earth at night ____ for us to live.
（如果没有空气留住太阳的部分热量，夜晚的地球对我们而言会冷得无法生存。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:18.explanation: without 引出与现在事实相反的含蓄条件，主句用 would + do；freezing cold 表“极冷”。（综合练习）

zsb-english:15:quiz:19.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:19.stem:
Without electronic computers, much of today’s advanced technology ____.
（如果没有电子计算机，当今许多先进技术就不可能实现。）

options.text: A. will not have been achieved
C. would not have been achieved

zsb-english:15:quiz:19.explanation: 技术已经实现，假设与过去事实相反，用 would not have been achieved。

zsb-english:15:quiz:20.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:20.stem:
Yesterday, the storm delayed us. ____ the storm, we would have been here in time.
（昨天暴风雨耽误了我们。要不是暴风雨，我们本来会及时到达这里。）

options.text: B. If it were not for
C. If it is not for

zsb-english:15:quiz:20.explanation: yesterday 和 would have been 表过去虚拟，But for = If it had not been for。

zsb-english:15:quiz:21.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:21.stem:
Luckily, he wasn’t driving fast at the time of the accident; otherwise, I am sure, it ____ a more serious accident.
（幸运的是，事故发生时他车开得不快；否则我敢肯定，那会成为一起更严重的事故。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:21.explanation: otherwise 指过去相反结果，用 would have been。

zsb-english:15:quiz:22.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:22.stem:
He did not regret saying what he did but felt that he ____ it differently.
（他不后悔自己说过的话，但觉得本可以换一种方式表达。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:22.explanation: 表示过去本可以换一种方式表达却没有，用 could have expressed。

zsb-english:15:quiz:23.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:23.stem:
I told your friend how to get to the hotel, but perhaps I ____ her there.
（我告诉了你的朋友怎样去酒店，但也许我本应该开车送她过去。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:23.explanation: 表示过去本应该开车送她却没有，用 should have driven。

zsb-english:15:quiz:24.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:24.stem:
【25 湖南】If I were you, I ____ for her opinion.
（如果我是你，我会征求她的意见。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:24.explanation: If I were you 表现在虚拟，主句用 would ask。（真题在线）

zsb-english:15:quiz:25.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:25.stem:
【22 重庆】An order came that all the army supply ____ to the front before daybreak.
（命令传来：所有军需品必须在天亮前送往前线。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:25.explanation: order 后同位语从句用 (should) do；supply 与 send 为被动关系，用 (should) be sent。

zsb-english:15:quiz:26.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:26.stem:
【24 重庆】If you had done your homework yesterday, you ____ how to answer the question now.
（如果你昨天做了作业，现在就会知道怎样回答这个问题。）
zsb-english:15:quiz:26.explanation: 过去条件造成现在结果：had done / would know。

zsb-english:15:quiz:27.title: 虚拟语气 Subjunctive Mood
zsb-english:15:quiz:27.stem:
【24 湖南】If you ____ him about the rainy weather, he ____ his umbrella.
（如果你当时提醒过他会下雨，他就会带伞了。）

options.text: D. had warned; would have brought

zsb-english:15:quiz:27.explanation: 与过去事实相反：had warned / would have brought。

zsb-english:16:quiz:0.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:0.stem: ____ interesting life he lives!（他过着多么有趣的生活啊！）
zsb-english:16:quiz:0.explanation: 原题：随堂选择题（教材 P189-190）。课件未附答案，笔记补充解析：划掉主谓后中心词 life 是可数名词单数，且 interesting 以元音音素开头 → What an。

zsb-english:16:quiz:1.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:1.stem: ____ amazing the tiny cells are!（这些微小的细胞多么神奇啊！）
zsb-english:16:quiz:1.explanation: 原题：随堂选择题（教材 P189-190）。课件未附答案，笔记补充解析：划掉主谓后中心词 amazing 是形容词 → How。

zsb-english:16:quiz:2.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:2.stem: It was not until she arrived home ____ she remembered her appointment with her friend.（直到到家，她才想起和朋友的约会。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:2.explanation: 课件原答案：固定结构 It was not until...that...，强调 not...until 时 that 后用肯定形式。

zsb-english:16:quiz:3.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:3.stem: It was ten years ago ____ I met him in the factory where he worked.（我正是在十年前在他工作的工厂里遇见他的。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:3.explanation: 课件原答案：删去 It was...that 后剩余部分仍为完整句，是强调句（强调时间状语 ten years ago）。

zsb-english:16:quiz:4.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:4.stem: It has been more than five years ____ they met last time in Wuhan.（自从他们上次在武汉见面，已经五年多了。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:4.explanation: 课件原答案：It is/has been + 时间段 + since + 一般过去时 句型。

zsb-english:16:quiz:5.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:5.stem: It will be a while ____ we know the results of the experiments.（还要过一段时间我们才会知道实验结果。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:5.explanation: 课件原答案：It will (not) be + 时间段 + before + 一般现在时，表"要过多久才……"。

zsb-english:16:quiz:6.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:6.stem: It isn’t the first time that I ____ myself in an embarrassing situation.（这不是我第一次发现自己处境尴尬。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:6.explanation: 课件原答案：It is/will be the first/second...time + that + 现在完成时。

zsb-english:16:quiz:7.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:7.stem: It’s high time that you ____ the seriousness of your own mistakes.（你早该认识到自己错误的严重性了。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:7.explanation: 课件原答案：It is (high) time that + 过去式，用过去式表示虚拟（也可 should do）。

zsb-english:16:quiz:8.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:8.stem: 【22 重庆】It was because of his good performance at the interview ____ he got the job with the big company.（正因为面试表现出色，他才得到那家大公司的工作。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:8.explanation: 课件原答案：强调句 It was...that...，强调原因 because of 短语。

zsb-english:16:quiz:9.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:9.stem: 【25 湖南】Not until I had read between the lines ____ the concept.（直到读懂言外之意，我才理解这个概念。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:9.explanation: 课件原答案：Not until 置于句首，主句部分倒装——"前不倒、后倒"。

zsb-english:16:quiz:10.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:10.stem: 【24 重庆】No sooner had he sat down ____ somebody knocked on the door.（他刚坐下就有人敲门。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:10.explanation: 课件原答案：No sooner...than...（一……就……）；hardly/scarcely 才配 when。

zsb-english:16:quiz:11.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:11.stem: Only under special circumstances ____ to make up tests.（只有在特殊情况下，学生才获准补考。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:11.explanation: 课件原答案（扫描页）：only + 状语（介词短语）置于句首，主句部分倒装——把 be 动词 are 提到主语 students 前，过去分词 permitted 留在主语后。

zsb-english:16:quiz:12.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:12.stem: So fast ____ that none of us could catch up with him.（他跑得如此快，我们谁也追不上。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:12.explanation: 课件原答案（扫描页）：So 位于句首，主句用部分倒装，借助动词 did 前置。

zsb-english:16:quiz:13.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:13.stem: ____, they often talk with each other by phone.（尽管他们分居两地，却经常打电话交谈。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:13.explanation: 课件原答案（扫描页）：as 让步倒装把表语 apart 提到 as 前，其余保持陈述语序。

zsb-english:16:quiz:14.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:14.stem: Hardly ____ the door when the phone rang.（我刚关门，电话就响了。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:14.explanation: 课件原答案：Hardly...when（刚……就……），Hardly 置于句首 + 过去完成时部分倒装。

zsb-english:16:quiz:15.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:15.stem: Not only ____ to the party, but she also brought a gift.（她不仅来参加聚会，还带了礼物。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:15.explanation: 课件原答案：Not only 分句倒装、but also 分句不倒（前倒后不倒）；后分句 brought 表明是过去时，前分句借 did 倒装。

zsb-english:16:quiz:16.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:16.stem: Not until she received the letter ____ know the truth.（直到收到信，她才知道真相。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:16.explanation: 课件原答案：Not until 置于句首，主句部分倒装；know 是动词原形，需借 did 前置。

zsb-english:16:quiz:17.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:17.stem: ____, she is not capable of teaching all subjects at present.（尽管她是老师，目前却不能教所有科目。）

options.text: A. As she is a teacher
C. A teacher as she is
D. The teacher as is she

zsb-english:16:quiz:17.explanation: 课件原答案：as/though 让步倒装中，单数可数名词作表语提前时省略冠词——Teacher as she is。

zsb-english:16:quiz:18.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:18.stem: Across the river ____. Many people come here to see it.（河对岸横跨着一座新建的桥，许多人来这里看它。）

options.text: A. lies a new built bridge
B. lies a newly built bridge
C. a new built bridge lies
D. a newly built bridge lies

zsb-english:16:quiz:18.explanation: 课件原答案：方位介词短语置于句首引发完全倒装；且副词 newly 修饰 built（new built 是错拼）。

zsb-english:16:quiz:19.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:19.stem: So selfish ____ that everyone avoided talking with her.（她如此自私，以至于人人都避免和她说话。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:19.explanation: 课件原答案：So 置于句首引发部分倒装，主语是 she → was she。为与过去时 was 保持一致，主句改为 everyone avoided talking with her。

zsb-english:16:quiz:20.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:20.stem: Judy hardly joins in any class activities, ____?（朱迪几乎不参加任何班级活动，是吗？）
zsb-english:16:quiz:20.explanation: 课件原答案（扫描页）：hardly 已有否定含义，附加问句用肯定式；joins 是一般现在时实义动词 → does she。

zsb-english:16:quiz:21.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:21.stem: Janet used to contribute articles to that famous magazine, ____?（珍妮特过去常给那家著名杂志投稿，不是吗？）
zsb-english:16:quiz:21.explanation: 课件原答案（扫描页）：used to 的附加问句可用 didn’t/usedn’t；选项中只有 didn’t she。

zsb-english:16:quiz:22.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:22.stem: Let’s go for a picnic tomorrow, ____?（咱们明天去野餐，好吗？）
zsb-english:16:quiz:22.explanation: 课件原答案（扫描页）：Let’s（建议，包含听话人）的附加问句用 shall we。

zsb-english:16:quiz:23.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:23.stem: Your parents don’t believe what you said, ____?（你的父母不相信你说的话，是吗？）
zsb-english:16:quiz:23.explanation: 课件原答案（扫描页）：一般主从复合句的附加问句与主句对应——Your parents don’t believe 是一般现在时否定 → do they。

zsb-english:16:quiz:24.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:24.stem: He has never been to Beijing, ____?（他从未去过北京，是吗？）
zsb-english:16:quiz:24.explanation: 课件原答案：never 是否定词，附加问句用肯定式；been 表明是完成时 → has he。

zsb-english:16:quiz:25.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:25.stem: I don’t think he can finish the work on time, ____?（我认为他不能按时完成工作，是吗？）
zsb-english:16:quiz:25.explanation: 课件原答案：第一人称态度动词发生否定前移，附加问句看宾语从句 he can，并用肯定式。

zsb-english:16:quiz:26.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:26.stem:
—Mia had a wonderful time at the party.
—____, and so did I.（——米娅在聚会上玩得很开心。——确实如此，我也一样。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:26.explanation: 课件原答案：So + 主语 + 助动词 表"确实如此"，不倒装；had a wonderful time 的 have 是实义动词，借 did → So she did。

zsb-english:16:quiz:27.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:27.stem: She hears that Tommy is going to Tokyo next month, ____?（她听说汤米下个月要去东京，是吗？）
zsb-english:16:quiz:27.explanation: 课件原答案：一般主从复合句的附加问句与主句对应——She hears 是一般现在时实义动词 → doesn’t she。

zsb-english:16:quiz:28.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:28.stem: Only when the war was over in 1945 ____ to his hometown.（直到 1945 年战争结束后，他才回到故乡。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:28.explanation: 课件原答案：only + 状语从句置于句首，主句部分倒装，借 did。

zsb-english:16:quiz:29.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:29.stem: Not only ____ her how to do this thing but he offered to help her as well.（他不仅教她怎么做，还主动提出帮助她。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:29.explanation: 课件原答案：Not only 分句部分倒装；but 分句 offered 表明是过去时，前分句借 did 倒装。

zsb-english:16:quiz:30.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:30.stem: I don’t think she has heard of the man before, ____?（我认为她以前没听说过这个人，是吗？）
zsb-english:16:quiz:30.explanation: 课件原答案：第一人称态度动词否定前移，附加问句看宾语从句 she has heard，并用肯定式 → has she。

zsb-english:16:quiz:31.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:31.stem: Go and get some water and food for these poor old people, ____?（去给这些可怜的老人拿些水和食物，好吗？）
zsb-english:16:quiz:31.explanation: 课件原答案：肯定祈使句的附加问句用 will you / won’t you。

zsb-english:16:quiz:32.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:32.stem: ____ a strange plant! I have never seen one like this before.（多么奇怪的植物啊！我以前从未见过这样的。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:32.explanation: 课件原答案：感叹句中心词 plant 是名词 → What；题中已给出 a strange，故不选 What a 形式。

zsb-english:16:quiz:33.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:33.stem: Mary ____ like surfing the Internet. She often spends hours online.（玛丽确实喜欢上网；她常常一上就是几个小时。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:33.explanation: 课件原答案：does 强调一般现在时谓语 like（"确实喜欢"），主语 Mary 用 does。

zsb-english:16:quiz:34.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:34.stem: Tom must have visited the Great Wall with his parents, ____?（汤姆一定和父母参观过长城，是吗？）
zsb-english:16:quiz:34.explanation: 课件原答案：must have done 无明确过去时间时，附加问句用 hasn’t。

zsb-english:16:quiz:35.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:35.stem: You must have been very nervous in the speech competition yesterday, ____?（你昨天参加演讲比赛时一定很紧张，不是吗？）
zsb-english:16:quiz:35.explanation: 课件原答案：有明确过去时间 yesterday，且实际谓语是 was nervous → weren’t you。

zsb-english:16:quiz:36.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:36.stem: Let’s go on a picnic this weekend, ____? —I want to relax.（我们这周末去野餐，好吗？——我想放松一下。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:36.explanation: 课件原答案：Let’s 建议句的附加问句用 shall we。

zsb-english:16:quiz:37.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:37.stem: ____ valuable book he brought! You should be grateful to him.（他带来的书多么珍贵啊！你应该感谢他。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:37.explanation: 课件原答案：感叹句中心词 book 是可数名词单数 → What a；valuable 以辅音音素开头用 a。

zsb-english:16:quiz:38.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:38.stem: It is my grandma ____ brings me up and teaches me much about life.（正是我的奶奶抚养我，并教会我许多人生道理。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:38.explanation: 课件原答案：强调句强调人时可用 that 或 who。

zsb-english:16:quiz:39.title: 特殊句式 Special Structures
zsb-english:16:quiz:39.stem: So little ____ about British history that the lecture was completely beyond me.（我对英国历史知之甚少，以至于完全听不懂这场讲座。）
zsb-english:16:quiz:39.explanation: 课件原答案：So little（半否定）置于句首引发部分倒装；主句 was beyond me 表明是过去时 → did I know。

zsb-english:17:quiz:0.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:0.stem: I lost my watch yesterday. I need to buy a new ____.（昨天我的手表丢了，我需要买一块新的。）
zsb-english:17:quiz:0.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 one——替代泛指的单数可数名词 a watch，同类异物，表示任意一块新手表。

zsb-english:17:quiz:1.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:1.stem: The air in the mountains is fresher than ____ in the city.（山里的空气比城里的空气更新鲜。）
zsb-english:17:quiz:1.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 that——比较同类异物 air；air 是不可数名词，用 that。

zsb-english:17:quiz:2.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:2.stem: These shoes are too small. Can I try the larger ____?（这双鞋太小了，我能试试大一点的吗？）
zsb-english:17:quiz:2.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 ones——替代复数名词 shoes，且带前置修饰语 larger。

zsb-english:17:quiz:3.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:3.stem: She has a blue umbrella, and I want ____ too.（她有一把蓝色雨伞，我也想要一把。）
zsb-english:17:quiz:3.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 one——替代泛指的单数名词 an umbrella，同类异物，表示任意一把伞。

zsb-english:17:quiz:4.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:4.stem: The cost of living here is higher than ____ in my hometown.（这里的生活成本比我家乡的生活成本高。）
zsb-english:17:quiz:4.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 that——比较同类异物 cost，cost 不可数，后有 of living 短语。

zsb-english:17:quiz:5.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:5.stem: I don’t like these apples. Can you give me the red ____?（我不喜欢这些苹果，你能把红色的那些给我吗？）
zsb-english:17:quiz:5.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 ones——替代复数名词 apples，且有前置修饰语 red。

zsb-english:17:quiz:6.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:6.stem: My phone is old. I need to replace ____ soon.（我的手机旧了，我需要尽快把它换掉。）
zsb-english:17:quiz:6.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 it——指代上文提到的同一部手机，属于同类同物。

zsb-english:17:quiz:7.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:7.stem: The weather in summer is hotter than ____ in winter.（夏天的天气比冬天的天气热。）
zsb-english:17:quiz:7.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 that——比较同类异物 weather；weather 是不可数名词，后有 in winter 修饰。

zsb-english:17:quiz:8.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:8.stem: This book is boring. Pass me ____ on the shelf.（这本书很无聊，把架子上的那本递给我。）
zsb-english:17:quiz:8.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 the one——替代特指的单数名词 the book，后有 on the shelf 修饰；课件解析注明此处也可用 that。

zsb-english:17:quiz:9.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:9.stem: The book on the desk is better than ____ on the shelf.（桌上的那本书比架子上的那本好。）
zsb-english:17:quiz:9.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 the one——指代特定的另一本书，即架子上的那一本。

zsb-english:17:quiz:10.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:10.stem: I prefer this black dress to ____ you wore yesterday.（比起你昨天穿的那条裙子，我更喜欢这条黑裙子。）
zsb-english:17:quiz:10.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 the one / that（课件解析两者均可，本题主选 the one）——替代特指的单数名词 the dress，后有定语从句 you wore yesterday 修饰。

zsb-english:17:quiz:11.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:11.stem: These novels are interesting, but I prefer ____ you recommended last week.（这些小说很有趣，但我更喜欢你上周推荐的那些。）
zsb-english:17:quiz:11.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 the ones——替代特指的复数名词 novels，后有 you recommended last week 修饰。

zsb-english:17:quiz:12.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:12.stem:
—“Do you have a pen?”
—“Yes, I have ____.”（你有钢笔吗？——有，我有一支。）
zsb-english:17:quiz:12.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 one——替代泛指的单数名词 a pen，同类异物，表示任意一支笔。

zsb-english:17:quiz:13.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:13.stem: These flowers are dying. We should buy some fresh ____.（这些花快枯萎了，我们应该买些新鲜的。）
zsb-english:17:quiz:13.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 ones——替代复数名词 flowers，且有前置修饰语 fresh。

zsb-english:17:quiz:14.title: 词义辨析 Word Discrimination
zsb-english:17:quiz:14.stem: The coffee here is better than ____ I drank at the other cafe.（这里的咖啡比我在另一家咖啡馆喝的咖啡好。）
zsb-english:17:quiz:14.explanation: 原题型：课件填空题。答案 that——比较同类异物 coffee；coffee 是不可数名词，用 that。

zsb-english:18:quiz-s1:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-s1:0.stem: 【原词复现】In particular, there was (and perhaps still is) a belief in fairies. Not all of these ____ are the friendly, people-loving characters that appear in Disney films.
zsb-english:18:quiz-s1:0.explanation: 上文已经出现 fairies，属于原词复现。

zsb-english:18:quiz-s1:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-s1:1.stem: 【同义词复现】Garth’s email was short, but I learned more from that ____ message than I ever did from a textbook.
zsb-english:18:quiz-s1:1.explanation: brief（简短的）与前文的 short 同义复现。

zsb-english:18:quiz-s1:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-s1:2.stem: 【反义词复现】Life is full of challenges. Sometimes we face difficulties, but we should never give up. … Giving up is easy, but ____ requires courage.
zsb-english:18:quiz-s1:2.explanation: persevering（坚持）与前面的 Giving up（放弃）构成反义复现。

zsb-english:18:quiz-s2:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-s2:0.stem: I remember that I used to ____ stories in my notebooks and show them to my parents.
zsb-english:18:quiz-s2:0.explanation: make up stories 表示「编故事」。

zsb-english:18:quiz-s2:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-s2:1.stem: But I didn’t give ____. I kept on sending my manuscripts to different publishing houses.
zsb-english:18:quiz-s2:1.explanation: give up 表示「放弃」，与 kept on sending 呼应。

zsb-english:18:quiz-s2:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-s2:2.stem: I had finally achieved my dream ____ hard work and perseverance.
zsb-english:18:quiz-s2:2.explanation: through hard work and perseverance 表示「通过努力和坚持」。

zsb-english:18:quiz-s3:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-s3:0.stem: Intrinsic motivation comes from within oneself. It’s the kind of motivation that drives a person to do something ____ they enjoy the process or find it personally fulfilling.
zsb-english:18:quiz-s3:0.explanation: 前果后因：驱使人做事的原因是享受过程、获得满足，用 because。

zsb-english:18:quiz-s3:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-s3:1.stem: Extrinsic motivation, ____, comes from external factors.
zsb-english:18:quiz-s3:1.explanation: 内在动机 vs 外在动机构成对照，用 on the other hand（另一方面）。

zsb-english:18:quiz-s3:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-s3:2.stem: A salesperson, for instance, might work hard to achieve high sales figures ____ they want to earn a big bonus.
zsb-english:18:quiz-s3:2.explanation: 前果后因：努力冲业绩的原因是想拿大额奖金，用 because。

zsb-english:18:quiz-s4:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-s4:0.stem: A pupil who can do his homework in a quiet and ____ room is in a much better position than a pupil who does his homework in a small, noisy room with the television on.
zsb-english:18:quiz-s4:0.explanation: comfortable 与 quiet 形成同向的平行描述，并与后面的 small, noisy 构成对比。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:0.stem: 【第21空】In a small town, there was a small cat that was very ____ about the outside world.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:0.explanation: 形容词辨析。后文提到小猫经常在后院 explored（探索），说明它对世界充满好奇；eager 急切的、afraid 害怕的、concerned 担忧的。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:1.stem: 【第22空】In November, the ____ fell heavily, blanketing the town in white.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:1.explanation: 名词辨析。小镇被白色覆盖且十一月寒冷，应为 snow；cloud 云、rain 雨、fog 雾。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:2.stem: 【第23空】And it ____ in the snow to find a warmer place.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:2.explanation: 动词辨析。小猫要在雪中找暖和的地方，需要 dug（挖洞）躲避寒冷。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:3.stem: 【第24空】Its owner was ____, searching everywhere but finding no sign of it.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:3.explanation: 形容词辨析。小猫未归，主人自然是 worried（担心的）。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:4.stem: 【第25空】On one morning of April, the small cat came back, looking happy and ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:4.explanation: 形容词辨析。小猫归来时状态良好，且后文提到它冬季去南方避寒，故为 healthy。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:5.stem: 【第26空】It seemed that the small cat had never been ____ in the past months.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:5.explanation: 动词辨析。小猫其实有固定去处，并未 lost（走失）。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:6.stem: 【第27空】The small cat disappeared when the cold November arrived, and ____ next spring.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:6.explanation: 动词辨析。小猫每年冬季消失、春季 reappeared（再次出现）。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:7.stem: 【第28空】The owner was puzzled, and wanted to figure out the ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:7.explanation: 名词辨析。主人想弄清小猫消失的 mystery（谜团）。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:8.stem: 【第29空】Therefore, he decided to ____ the cat when it went out in another November.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:8.explanation: 动词辨析。主人决定 follow（跟踪）小猫以查明真相。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:9.stem: 【第30空】The couple were glad to ____ all this to the owner.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:9.explanation: 动词辨析。夫妇向主人 explain（解释）真相。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:10.stem: 【第31空】They would travel to the south every winter, and the small cat began to travel with them two ____ ago.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:10.explanation: 名词辨析。小猫已连续「两年」随夫妇去南方。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:11.stem: 【第32空】The small cat would ____ when the trip was over,
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:11.explanation: 短语辨析。旅行结束后小猫会 run away（跑开）回原主人家；take away 带走、put away 收好、give away 赠送。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:12.stem: 【第33空】The small cat would run away when the trip was over, ____ their house and returning here some day.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:12.explanation: 非谓语动词。现在分词 leaving 作伴随状语，与 returning 并列。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:13.stem: 【第34空】Hearing this, the owner realized that this small cat was ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:13.explanation: 形容词辨析。小猫主动选择避寒方式，体现 smart（聪明的）。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:14.stem: 【第35空】That’s because it was a good ____ to escape the cold weather.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p1:14.explanation: 名词辨析。避寒是一种 way（方式）。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:0.stem: Ye is a famous woodcarving（木雕）____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:0.explanation: 他在展览上谈木雕艺术，是著名木雕艺术家 artist。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:1.stem: The art has been a way to show the local culture, with its ____ covering historical legends and landscapes.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:1.explanation: 与历史传说、乡村风景画并列的是作品的「题材」themes。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:2.stem: Humans, mountains, rivers, flowers, birds and animals are commonly ____ in the artworks.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:2.explanation: 人物山水花鸟是木雕作品中常见的「形象」，即能被看见 seen。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:3.stem: We are seeing famous attractions in Shanxi on the woodcarvings ____ here, like the Yellow River, the Great Wall and the Taihang Mountains.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:3.explanation: 这里展出的木雕用 showed（展出），与 exhibition 呼应。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:4.stem: …as well as the stories and lives related to these ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:4.explanation: 黄河、长城、太行山都是「地点」places。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:5.stem: Shanxi traders are said to have controlled ____ in North China during those periods.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:5.explanation: 晋商掌控的是中国北方的「商业」business。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:6.stem: They widely used woodcarvings to decorate their houses, ____ the popularity of the art.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:6.explanation: 广泛用木雕装饰住宅，推动了这门艺术的流行 improving。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:7.stem: …a ____ house of Shanxi traders—in Qixian County.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:7.explanation: 乔家大院是著名的（famous）晋商宅院。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:8.stem: With the patterns of a moon and a rhinoceros, Ye said this should be considered among the most ____ woodcarving works in the world.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:8.explanation: 带月亮与犀牛图案的雕花镜框属于世界上最不同寻常的（uncommon）作品。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:9.stem: But nowadays, the art has gradually faded out of local life and is ____ to death.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:9.explanation: be close to death 濒临消亡，与 faded out of local life 呼应。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:10.stem: We think it necessary to protect the art and ____ it down to future generations.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:10.explanation: pass down 传给后代，固定搭配。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:11.stem: Ye started to learn the art from a master in Zhejiang Province ____ he was 16.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:11.explanation: 十六岁时开始学艺，时间状语从句用 when。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:12.stem: After finishing his three-year learning, he returned to Shanxi, continued to ____ local artists and began to practice in this trade.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:12.explanation: 回山西后继续向当地艺人「学习」learn from。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:13.stem: Because of his understanding of the art, Ye has ____ many masterpieces over the past twenty years.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:13.explanation: 凭借对艺术的理解，「创作」created 了许多杰作。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:14.stem: His works have been ____ by a number of private collectors, museums and art galleries.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p2:14.explanation: 收藏家、博物馆、美术馆「收藏」collected 了他的作品。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:0.stem: People from the capital and other places have been coming to enjoy a ____ there, as well as to pay their ____ to a hero.（本空为第 1 空）
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:0.explanation: 火锅店走红，人们到店「用餐」enjoy a meal。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:1.stem: …as well as to pay their ____ to a hero who gave his life to save others.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:1.explanation: pay respects to 向……致敬，固定搭配。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:2.stem: Luan Liuwei … ran the ____ in Beijing with his wife for many years.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:2.explanation: 与妻子经营的是那家火锅「餐馆」restaurant。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:3.stem: While visiting Gu’an County … with his daughter, Luan ____ three children from drowning in the Yongding River.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:3.explanation: save sb. from drowning 把孩子从溺水中救出。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:4.stem: When he went back into the water to save an adult …, Luan drowned because he was too ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:4.explanation: 再次下水救人后体力耗尽（too tired）而溺亡。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:5.stem: On Wednesday, Ningyang, which was Luan’s ____, awarded him the title.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:5.explanation: 宁阳是他的「家乡」hometown，故由当地追授称号。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:6.stem: …awarded him the title of “Model of the New Era in Ningyang”, even though he was already ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:6.explanation: 他为救人牺牲，虽已离世（dead）仍被追授称号。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:7.stem: Luan’s heroic act ____ moved people in Beijing and beyond.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:7.explanation: 英雄事迹「深深地」deeply 打动了人们。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:8.stem: Many people visited his restaurant to remember the hero and ____ the business.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:8.explanation: 人们来店里纪念英雄、用消费「支持」support 店铺。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:9.stem: By around 5 pm, the restaurant was already ____, and I waited for more than an hour without getting a seat.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:9.explanation: 等一个多小时没座位，说明店里已经「满座」full。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:10.stem: A customer, who had traveled from Beijing’s Tongzhou District, about 50 kilometers ____,
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:10.explanation: 50 kilometers away 表示「五十公里外」，距离用 away。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:11.stem: Even though they had to wait for a long time, the customers didn’t ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:11.explanation: don’t mind 不介意久等，与下文不想离开呼应。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:12.stem: People came here not just for the food, but also for Luan’s ____, so they didn’t want to leave.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:12.explanation: 人们不仅为食物而来，也为英雄的「事迹」story 而来。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:13.stem: The restaurant doesn’t ____ until 11 am, but there were already customers waiting, starting at 9 am.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:13.explanation: 九点就有人排队、十一点才「开门」open。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:14.stem: Some people tried to give money to the restaurant, only to have the staff members run after them for several blocks to ____ the money.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p3:14.explanation: 员工追出几个街区把钱「退还」return 给他们。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:0.stem: Children need to learn ____ to deal with problems.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:0.explanation: learn how to deal with problems 学会「如何」处理问题。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:1.stem: Problems have a way of bursting upon someone at the ____ time.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:1.explanation: 与下文 even if the time is not the best 呼应：问题总在最糟（worst）的时刻出现。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:2.stem: There are many things you can do to help a child ____ problem-solving skills.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:2.explanation: 帮助孩子「学习」learn 解决问题的技能。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:3.stem: One good way is to find out what caused the ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:3.explanation: 找出「问题」problem 的成因，全文主题即解决问题。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:4.stem: This is a skill that children ____ learn without help.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:4.explanation: 这种能力没有帮助孩子「学不会」（won’t learn），所以要大人帮忙。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:5.stem: A child ____ knock over his or her glass of milk at the dinner table,
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:5.explanation: 情态动词 may：孩子「可能」打翻牛奶。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:6.stem: …but he or she may not realize that the glass was too close to the ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:6.explanation: 杯子被碰倒是因为离桌「边」edge 太近。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:7.stem: The next step for a child is to learn how to solve the problem ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:7.explanation: 下一步是学会「独立」alone 解决问题。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:8.explanation: 与下文 afraid of being wrong 呼应：独立解决需要「勇气」courage。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:9.stem: You can help by talking about some possible ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:9.explanation: 与下文 which answer is the best 呼应：讨论几种可能的「答案」answers。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:10.explanation: let the child try it out 让孩子亲自试一试。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:11.stem: You can ____ him or her for choosing an answer.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:11.explanation: 孩子选出答案后，大人「表扬」praise 他。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:12.stem: He or she might ____ to write on the wall but the pencil always leaves a ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:12.explanation: might like to write on the wall 想「喜欢」在墙上写字，与后文铅笔留痕构成因果示例。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:13.stem: He or she might like to write on the wall but the pencil always leaves a ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:13.explanation: 铅笔总会在墙上留下「痕迹」mark。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:14.stem: Soon the child will see the link ____ cause and effect, and then he or she is on the road to growth.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p4:14.explanation: the link between A and B 之间的联系，用 between。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:0.stem: The announcement in the paper said that you could buy ____ at the theater box office in Richland Hills.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:0.explanation: 去剧院售票处买的是「票」tickets。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:1.stem: Since I work from 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., the ____ time I could go to the theater was during my 45-minute lunch break.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:1.explanation: 上班时间无法前往，午休是「唯一的」only 时间。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:2.stem: ____, the theater is on the other side of the town, and the bus ____ between my office and Richland Hills is not very good.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:2.explanation: 剧院远、公交差，是「不幸的是」Unfortunately。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:3.stem: …and the bus ____ between my office and Richland Hills is not very good.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:4.stem: ____ if you are lucky, you can make the round trip in 45 minutes.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:4.explanation: But if you are lucky 承上转折：就算运气好，45 分钟也只够往返一趟。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:5.stem: There was not enough time ____ to make the trip so I gave ____ and went back to the office.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:5.explanation: time left 剩余时间；enough time left 没剩多少时间了。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:6.stem: There was not enough time left to make the trip so I gave ____ and went back to the office.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:6.explanation: give up 放弃，固定搭配。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:7.stem: The same thing happened on Tuesday, and ____ on Wednesday.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:7.explanation: 同样的情况星期三「再次」again 发生。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:8.stem: On Thursday, my ____ changed. I got on a bus right away.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:8.explanation: 与前两天等不到车对比：星期四我的「运气」luck 变好了。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:9.stem: I got on a bus right away and arrived at the theater ____ exactly twenty minutes.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:9.explanation: 「在二十分钟后」用 in twenty minutes。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:10.stem: I heard one man say he had been waiting in line for ____ an hour.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:10.explanation: over an hour 一个多小时，固定表达。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:11.stem: ____ I would not have enough time to wait in line, I ____ the next bus and headed back across the town.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:11.explanation: 现在分词作状语：「意识到」Realizing 来不及排队。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:12.stem: Realizing I would not have enough time to wait in line, I ____ the next bus and headed back.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:12.explanation: catch the bus 赶上下一班车返回。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:13.stem: By Friday I realized my only ____ was to make the trip by taxi.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:13.explanation: 唯一的「希望」hope 是乘出租车。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:14.stem: It was ____. But I felt it would be worth it to hear the concert.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p5:14.explanation: But 表转折：虽然「贵」expensive，但为了听音乐会值得。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:0.stem: One day, a friend of mine ____ the classroom with a nice new watch.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:0.explanation: 朋友「带着」新手表「走进」entered 教室。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:1.stem: I loved it so much that I ____ it from him.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:1.explanation: 后文老师搜口袋找表，说明「我」是偷了 steal 它。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:2.stem: As soon as my friend ____ he had lost his watch, he reported it ____ to our teacher.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:2.explanation: 朋友一「发现」realized 手表丢了就报告老师。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:3.stem: As soon as my friend realized he had lost his watch, he reported it ____ to our teacher.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:3.explanation: as soon as 一发现就报告，说明「立刻」immediately。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:4.stem: Whoever has taken it, please ____ it.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:4.explanation: 老师请拿表的人把表「归还」return。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:5.stem: At that time, I was ____ to raise my hand.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:5.explanation: 偷了表不敢承认，「吓得」frightened 不敢举手。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:6.stem: Then you shut the door and told us all to get up and began to ____ our pockets one by one.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:6.explanation: 逐个「搜查」search 我们的口袋。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:7.stem: But you ____ us to close our eyes.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:7.explanation: 老师「要求」required 大家闭上眼睛，为保护拿表者尊严。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:8.stem: You went from pocket to pocket, and when my ____ came, you found the watch and took it.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:8.explanation: 「轮到」turn 我时，老师找到了表。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:9.stem: You ____ searching everyone’s pockets until you finished, you asked us to open our eyes.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:9.explanation: 找到表后仍「继续」continued 搜完，不暴露拿表的人。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:10.stem: It was the most ____ day of my life.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:10.explanation: 对偷表的「我」来说，被搜口袋是最「羞愧」shameful 的一天。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:11.stem: But this was also the day my ____ was saved.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:11.explanation: 老师闭眼搜查保住了「我」的颜面（face）。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:12.stem: You never ____ anything about the incident later.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:12.explanation: 老师后来从未「提起」mentioned 这件事。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:13.stem: …nor even gave me a right or wrong lesson, but I received your ____ clearly.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:13.explanation: 虽没批评，但「我」清楚收到了老师传递的「信息」message。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:14.stem: If an educator must make students lose the ____ of other people, he doesn’t know how to teach.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p6:14.explanation: 教育者不能让学生失去他人的「信任」trust。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:0.stem: Tony is a warm-hearted repairman, who lost his job again a few months ago. He was really ____ applying for a new job.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:0.explanation: 屡次失业后鼓起勇气才去面试，说明他「害怕」afraid of 申请新工作。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:1.stem: While waiting for a bus, he saw a man ____ kicking one tyre of his car.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:1.explanation: 车坏了，那人「愤怒地」angrily 踢轮胎。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:2.stem: Clearly, there was something wrong with the car. Tony ____ to help.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:2.explanation: offer to help 主动提出帮忙，符合热心修理工形象。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:3.stem: The man thanked him and wanted to pay for the ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:3.explanation: 想为修车的「工作」work 付钱。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:4.explanation: 「只是顺手帮忙」，即「拒绝」refused 收钱。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:5.stem: “Well, I could take you there. It’s the ____ I could do, please!” the man insisted.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:5.explanation: 开车送你是「我至少能做的」the least I could do。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:6.stem: While waiting in the long line of the applicants ____ his dirty shirt, Tony felt embarrassed and nervous.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:6.explanation: in his dirty shirt 穿着脏衬衫排队，in 表「穿着」。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:7.stem: One by one, the applicants left the interviewer’s office with ____ looks on their faces.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:7.explanation: 面试难，应聘者一个个「失望地」disappointed 走出办公室。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:8.stem: The ____ was sitting on big chair with his back towards Tony.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:8.explanation: 坐在办公室里提问的人是「面试官」interviewer。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:9.stem: “With the way I ____ now, how could I possibly ____ this interview?” he thought.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:9.explanation: 看「我」现在这副样子（脏衬衫），the way I look。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:10.stem: With the way I look now, how could I possibly ____ this interview?
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:10.explanation: 心想不可能「通过」pass 面试（后文证明想错了）。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:11.stem: Then the interviewer ____ his chair. To Tony’s surprise, it was the man he helped earlier!
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:11.explanation: 背对 Tony 的面试官「转过」turned 椅子，正是早晨被他帮助的人。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:12.stem: I was pretty sure I had made the ____ decision to have you in our company.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:12.explanation: 录用你是「正确的」right 决定。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:13.explanation: 「在你走进办公室之前」before 就确定了。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:14.stem: I just know you’d be a good worker I can ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p7:14.explanation: 你会成为值得「信赖」trust 的好员工。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:0.stem: One morning, besides his ____ lunch bag, Molly handed him a second paper bag.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:0.explanation: 除了「平常的」usual 午餐袋，又多递了一个袋子。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:1.stem: He put ____ paper bags into his briefcase, kissed Molly and rushed off.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:2.stem: The ____ father smiled, finished eating, and swept the desk clean into the wastebasket.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:2.explanation: 吃完就扫桌继续工作，是「忙碌的」busy 父亲。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:3.stem: That evening, Molly ran up to him ____ he was reading the newspaper.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:3.explanation: 「当他正在读报时」as 引导时间状语从句。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:4.explanation: leave sth. + 地点 表示把东西「落在」某处：left it at the office。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:5.stem: “I forgot to put this ____ in it,” she said.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:5.explanation: 与下文 he opened the note 呼应：忘了放「便条」note。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:6.stem: The things in the bag are the things I really like—I thought you might like to ____ with them.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:6.explanation: 七岁孩子以为爸爸会喜欢拿这些宝贝「玩」play。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:7.stem: “Oh, no. I just forgot to bring it home,” he ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:7.explanation: 其实袋子已被扔掉，父亲在「撒谎」lied。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:8.stem: Molly had given him her ____—all that a 7-year-old held.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:8.explanation: 袋中全是她的「宝贝」treasures——七岁孩子拥有的一切。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:9.stem: Love in a paper bag, and he ____ it. He had even thrown it in the wastebasket.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:9.explanation: 纸袋里装的是爱，而他竟「错过」missed 了。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:10.stem: So back he went hurriedly to the ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:10.explanation: 袋子落在「办公室」office，赶在清洁工之前回去找。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:11.stem: He found all the things back and carried the bag home ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:11.explanation: 找回爱后「小心地」carefully 带回家。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:12.stem: It ____ a long time to tell.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:12.explanation: It takes time 花时间讲，句型用 took。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:13.stem: ____ had a story or a memory.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:13.explanation: 「每一样东西」Everything 都有故事或回忆。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:14.stem: It is such a simple ____ but it is so easily forgotten.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p8:14.explanation: 与所爱之人同行才最重要——这是一个简单的「道理」truth。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:0.stem: It was a cold windy winter day … My head pointed down against the ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:0.explanation: cold windy winter day，低头迎「风」wind 走。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:1.stem: She was ____ on the sidewalk in her house slippers.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:1.explanation: 穿家居拖鞋在人行道上「走」walking。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:2.stem: As I ____ her, I saw that she was well into her 80s.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:2.explanation: 「经过」passed 她身边时才看清年纪。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:3.stem: …and she was holding some ____ in her hands.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:3.explanation: 与后文 the letters in the mailbox 呼应：手里拿着「信」letters。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:4.stem: Waiting there, I saw the mailbox ____ the street.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:4.explanation: 邮箱在街「对面」across the street。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:5.stem: In this neighborhood, even crossing with the green light was ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:5.explanation: 与下文司机乱闯红灯呼应：绿灯过马路也「危险」dangerous。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:6.stem: Drivers often drove ____ through red lights and stop signs.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:6.explanation: 司机「疯狂地」wildly 闯红灯。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:7.stem: I stayed there until she ____ me.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:7.explanation: 一直等到她「走到身边」reached me。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:8.stem: She smiled and took my hand in hers and ____ it.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:8.explanation: 她牵住我的手并「握着」held it。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:9.stem: Hand-in-hand, we were waiting for the ____ to change.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:9.explanation: 与下文 When the light turned green 呼应：等「信号灯」light 变化。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:10.stem: We walked together slowly across the street, ____ the letters in the mailbox.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:10.explanation: 现在分词表伴随：「把信投进」dropped 邮箱。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:11.stem: Then I took her ____ across the street.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:11.explanation: 邮筒在街对面，送完信再送她「返回」back。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:12.stem: I could still feel the ____ of her hand in my own.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:12.explanation: 与上文 soft and warm 呼应：手中还留着她掌心的「温暖」warmth。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:13.stem: People say the first language of all humans is ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:13.explanation: 与末句 the power of touch 呼应：人类最初的语言是「触摸」touch。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:14.stem: A caring touch helps to make a bad situation ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p9:14.explanation: 充满关爱的触碰让糟糕的处境变得「充满希望」hopeful。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:0.stem: One day last November, when Delores, the ____, returned from a market, she found Hank didn’t come in for his lunch.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:0.explanation: 后文 The poor owner 点明 Delores 是猫「主人」owner。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:1.stem: As it got ____, she began to look for him around the house.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:1.explanation: 猫没回来吃午饭，天「黑了」dark 还没回，才开始找。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:2.stem: Then she heard the meow of a cat, ____, and saw Hank in her neighbor’s tree.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:2.explanation: 猫在树上，听见叫声后「抬头看」looked up 才发现。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:3.stem: He must have climbed onto the tree while some dogs were running after ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:3.explanation: Hank 是公猫，用代词 him：狗在追「它」。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:4.stem: Delores, now very ____, called the firemen immediately.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:4.explanation: 猫被困树上五天，主人「担心」worried 得立刻打电话。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:5.stem: They didn’t have a ladder tall enough to ____ the cat.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:5.explanation: 梯子不够高，「够不到」reach 那只猫。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:6.stem: She asked a tree company for help then. ____, they failed for safety reasons.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:6.explanation: 消防员失败后换公司求助，「又一次」Again 失败。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:7.stem: The poor owner could do nothing but sit ____ the tree and call to Hank.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:7.explanation: 猫在高处，只能坐在树「下」under 呼唤。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:8.stem: A kind neighbor offered her some cat food, ____ it would make the hungry cat come down.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:8.explanation: 给猫粮是「指望」expecting 饿猫会下来。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:9.stem: Nearby dog owners took their pets for ____ instead of letting them out in their yards.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:9.explanation: take pets for walks 遛狗，避免狗在院子里吓猫。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:10.stem: …so that Hank would not climb even ____ with fear.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:10.explanation: 猫在树上，恐惧时只会爬得「更高」higher。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:11.stem: ____ Lydia, another neighbor, talked of a clever way of getting the cat down, Delores decided to ____ it at once.（本空为第 12 空）
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:11.explanation: 「当」When 邻居提出聪明办法时，她立刻决定试。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:12.stem: Delores decided to ____ it at once.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:12.explanation: 决定马上「试一试」try 这个办法。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:13.stem: They lifted a ____ with some of Hank’s favorite things up to him. Hank jumped into it.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:13.explanation: Hank 能「跳进去」的是装有它爱物的「篮子」basket。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:14.stem: I feel good living in such a ____ neighborhood. It gave me hope when Hank was in trouble.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p10:14.explanation: 邻里纷纷帮忙，是「友善的」friendly 社区。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:0.stem: Even the emperor of Lilliput wanted to give him less food to save ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:0.explanation: 减少食物供给是为了「省钱」save money，与下文 very expensive 呼应。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:1.stem: “I’m ____ to visit Blefuscu, as I promised.”
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:1.explanation: be off to 出发去某地：按承诺动身访问不来夫斯古。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:2.stem: Then he hurried down to the sea ____ Lilliput and Blefuscu.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:2.explanation: 两国「之间」的海边，用 between。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:3.stem: “Welcome!” cried the king. “Stay as ____ as you like.”
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:3.explanation: as long as you like 想住多久住多久。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:4.stem: He saw out at sea a small boat—but a full-sized one. It was ____ upside down in the water.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:4.explanation: 船底朝上「漂浮」floating 在海面上。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:5.stem: Gulliver swam out to the boat, holding ropes from each of the ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:5.explanation: 与上文 Take some ships to help you 呼应：拉着各艘「大船」ships 的绳索。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:6.stem: With the ships pulling and Gulliver ____, the boat was brought safely to shore.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:6.explanation: 大船拉、格列佛「推」pushing，小船安全靠岸。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:7.stem: “But no one at home will ____ my story.”
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:7.explanation: 小人国的经历太离奇，家乡没人会「相信」believe。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:8.stem: “I can’t possibly ____ that,” said the king.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:8.explanation: 国王不能「允许」allow 带走他的臣民。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:9.stem: “But you may take some ____ and a sheep.”
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:9.explanation: 与结尾 a couple of cows 呼应：带上几头「牛」cows 和一只羊。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:10.explanation: 理解他「为什么」why 必须回家。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:11.explanation: 道谢即是「不会忘记」forget 你们大家。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:12.stem: He shouted and waved wildly. He was ____!
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:12.explanation: 水手发现了他，「他走运了」He was in luck。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:13.stem: The ship sailed over and ____ Gulliver.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:14.stem: …and he showed the captain the ____ from the emperor.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p11:14.explanation: 国王送的礼物「presents」，包括金币和牛羊。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:0.stem: 【第6空】Green is the cool color of grass in ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:0.explanation: 草是绿色的季节是「春天」spring。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:1.stem: 【第7空】In general, people ____ two groups of colors: warm colors and cool colors.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:1.explanation: talk about 谈论（两组颜色），speak/say/tell 不接话题宾语。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:2.stem: 【第8空】The warm colors are red, orange and ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:2.explanation: 上文说 yellow 是欢快、与幸福相关的颜色，属暖色。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:3.stem: 【第9空】Where there are warm color and a lot of light, people usually want to be ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:3.explanation: 红色令人兴奋、充满活力（exciting and active），暖色环境让人想「活动」active。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:4.stem: 【第10空】Those who like to be with ____ like red.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:4.explanation: 泛指「其他人」others；the other/another 后不接零复数名词。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:5.stem: 【第11空】The cool colors are ____ and blue.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:5.explanation: 与暖色红橙黄相对，冷色是「黑色」black 和蓝色。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:6.stem: 【第12空】Some scientists say that time seems to ____ more slowly in a room with warm colors.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:6.explanation: go by （时间）流逝：暖色房间里时间似乎过得更慢。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:7.stem: 【第13空】They suggest that a warm color is a good ____ for a living room.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:7.explanation: a good way for … 是做……的好「办法/选择」。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:8.stem: 【第14空】A warm color is a good way for a living room or a ____. People who are having a rest or are eating do not want time to pass quickly.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:8.explanation: 「吃饭」的人不希望时间过得快，对应「餐厅」restaurant。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:9.stem: 【第15空】____ colors are better for some offices if the people working there want time to pass quickly.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p12:9.explanation: 想让时间过得快就用「冷色」Cool colors，与暖色房间时间变慢相反。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:0.stem: Now teleshopping is starting in Europe. In some ____ countries, people can turn on their ____ and shop.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:0.explanation: 上文说电视购物开始进入「欧洲」，故为欧洲国家。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:1.stem: In some European countries, people can turn on their ____ and shop for clothes, jewelry, food, toys.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:1.explanation: 电视购物是看电视、打电话购物，打开的是「电视」TVs。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:2.stem: …shop for clothes, jewelry, food, toys and ____ things.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:2.explanation: 「许多其他」many other + 复数名词；else 不能修饰名词。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:3.stem: Teleshopping is becoming popular in Sweden. ____, the biggest Swedish company sells different kinds of things on TV.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:3.explanation: 举瑞典公司为例，句首用 For example；such as 不单独成句。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:4.stem: There are two teleshopping channels, and the French ____ about $20 million a year in buying things.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:4.explanation: the French 法国人（复数）作主语，spend … in doing，用动词原形 spend。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:5.stem: In Germany, ____ last year teleshopping was only possible on one channel for one hour every day.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:5.explanation: 「直到去年」until last year，与后文政府放开政策呼应。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:6.stem: Other channels can ____ for telebusiness, including the largest American teleshopping company.
