zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:6.explanation: 其他频道可以「开办」open 电视商业节目。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:7.stem: German ____ are hoping these will help them sell more things.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:7.explanation: 希望多卖货的是德国「商人」businessmen。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:8.stem: Some people like teleshopping because it allows them to do their shopping without ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:8.explanation: without 是介词，接动名词 going out：不用出门。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:9.stem: But at the same time, other Europeans ____ like this new way of buying things.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:9.explanation: But 表转折：另一些欧洲人「并不」don’t 喜欢这种方式。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:10.explanation: 把「电视购物」teleshopping 称为空中垃圾。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:11.stem: Many Europeans usually worry about the quality of the things ____ on TV.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:11.explanation: 「电视上出售的」for sale 商品的质量。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:12.stem: They don’t believe they can be sure about the quality of the things ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:12.explanation: 不相信仅凭「电视」on TV 就能确定商品质量。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:13.stem: European teleshopping companies will have to be ____ the American companies.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:13.explanation: 欧洲公司须更重质量，故必须「不同于」different from 美国公司。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:14.stem: They will have to be more careful about ____ of the things they sell.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p13:14.explanation: 全文主题是质量：更谨慎地把控「质量」the quality。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:0.stem: I ____ a newspaper and some chocolate and ____ into the station coffee shop.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:0.explanation: 买完东西想休息，于是「买了」bought 报纸和巧克力。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:1.stem: I bought a newspaper and some chocolate and ____ into the station coffee shop.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:1.explanation: go into 走进车站咖啡馆。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:2.stem: It was a cheap self-service place with long tables to ____ at.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:2.explanation: sit at a table 坐在桌边；seat 是及物动词不合此处。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:3.stem: I put my heavy bag down on the floor, ____ the newspaper and the chocolate on the table and then went to get a cup of coffee.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:3.explanation: 与 put my bag down 并列：「把」报纸和巧克力「放」put 在桌上。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:4.stem: When I came back with the coffee, there was someone ____ in the next seat.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:4.explanation: 旁边座位「坐着」sitting 一个人。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:5.stem: ____ was a boy, with dark glasses and old clothes.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:5.explanation: 指代上文的 someone，用人称代词 He。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:6.stem: …with dark glasses and old clothes, and ____ bright red at the front.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:6.explanation: 头发前面「染成」colored 鲜红色。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:7.stem: I was rather uneasy about him, but I didn’t want to have any ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:7.explanation: have trouble 惹麻烦：不想与陌生男孩起冲突。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:8.stem: The boy looked at me in ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:8.explanation: 陌生女子也拿「他的」巧克力吃，男孩「惊讶」surprise 地看我。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:9.stem: Then he took a ____ piece of my chocolate.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:9.explanation: 与后文 a third piece 呼应：接着拿了「第二块」second。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:10.stem: The boy gave me a strange look, then ____ up.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:11.stem: As he left, he shouted out, “There’s something ____ with that woman!”
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:11.explanation: There’s something wrong with … 那个女人有毛病。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:12.stem: Everyone looked at me, ____ I didn’t want to quarrel with the boy, so I kept quiet.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:12.explanation: 大家看着我，「但」我不想争吵，转折用 but。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:13.stem: I did not realize that I had ____ a mistake until I finished my coffee.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:13.explanation: make a mistake 犯错误，固定搭配。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:14.stem: I did not realize that I had made a mistake until I finished my coffee and was ready to ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p14:14.explanation: 喝完咖啡准备「离开」leave 时才发现拿错了巧克力。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:0.stem: Rosa liked making up stories. She was so ____ that her classmates believed her from time to time.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:0.explanation: 同学们都信她，说明她说得「煞有介事」sure（很有把握的样子）。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:1.stem: At first she supposed it was ____.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:2.stem: Now, as she got up to ____ before the class, she knew that make-believe stories had some way of coming back.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:2.explanation: 站到全班面前「讲话」talk，谎言要被拆穿。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:3.stem: But when summer ____, she went to her father’s farm in Arizona.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:3.explanation: 夏天「到来」arrived 时去父亲的农场。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:4.stem: Rosa rode horses and ____ with some farm work.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:5.stem: Her father, however, was so ____ that he couldn’t find time to go places with her.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:5.explanation: 没时间陪她，是因为父亲太「忙」busy。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:6.stem: When she arrived each summer, her father would ____ her at the airport.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:7.stem: And the day she went back to the ____ he would always buy her a present.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:7.explanation: 与乡下农场相对，她回「城里」city 的那天父亲总买礼物。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:8.stem: When summer came to a close, Rosa ____ to her mother.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:8.explanation: 夏天结束「回到」returned 母亲身边。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:9.stem: Rosa wished she had a ____ to talk about.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:9.explanation: 朋友谈的都是家庭旅行，她也希望有个可谈的「家庭/家事」family。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:10.stem: Not long after ____ began, Rosa was looking through travel magazines in the school library.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:10.explanation: 「开学」school 不久，地点是学校图书馆。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:11.stem: They talked about many exciting ____, like England and Germany.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:11.explanation: 英国、德国是令人向往的「地方」places。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:12.stem: When Rosa’s friends asked what she had done that summer, she made up something that was not ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:12.explanation: 编造「不真实」not true 的经历。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:13.stem: She told her classmates that she and her father had gone to ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:13.explanation: 与下文全班开始学习英国、老师请她讲英国见闻呼应：去了「英国」。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:14.stem: Mr. Thomas asked Rosa to tell all the things she could ____ about her trip to England!
zsb-english:18:quiz-p15:14.explanation: 谎言的破绽：只能讲「记得」remember 的，却根本没有这趟旅行。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:0.stem: Most parents have had the experience of reading a bedtime story ____ their children.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:0.explanation: read a story to sb. 给孩子读故事。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:1.stem: They must have realized how difficult it is to write a ____ children’s book.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:1.explanation: 写一本「好的」good 儿童读物很难。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:2.stem: Either the author has aimed too ____, so that children can’t follow what is in his story,
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:2.explanation: 「立意太高」aimed too high，孩子跟不上。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:3.stem: Either the author has aimed too high …, ____ the story seems to be talking to the readers.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:4.stem: The best children’s books are ____ very difficult nor very simple.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:4.explanation: neither…nor… 既不很难也不过分简单。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:5.stem: …and satisfy the ____ who hears the story and the adult who ____ it.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:5.explanation: 听故事的是「孩子」child，与 adult 相对。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:7.stem: Unfortunately, there are in fact few books like this, ____ the problem of finding the right bedtime story is not ____ to solve.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:7.explanation: 这样的书少，「所以」so 找到合适睡前故事不容易。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:8.stem: …the problem of finding the right bedtime story is not ____ to solve.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:8.explanation: 与上文 few books like this 呼应：问题并不「容易」easy 解决。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:9.stem: Many of the books regarded as ____ of children’s literature were in fact written for ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:9.explanation: 「杰作」masterpieces 用 works（可数名词复数）；work 作作品讲不可数。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:10.stem: Many of the books regarded as works of children’s literature were in fact written for ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:10.explanation: 《爱丽丝梦游仙境》其实是为「成年人」grown-ups 写的。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:11.stem: Children, left for themselves, often ____ the worst possible interest in literature.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:11.explanation: 任其选择时，孩子「表现出」show 最糟糕的文学兴趣。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:12.stem: Just leave a child in a bookshop or a ____ and he will more willingly choose the books written in an unimaginative way.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:12.explanation: 与书店并列的选书场所：「图书馆」library。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:13.stem: Perhaps we parents should stop ____ to brainwash children into accepting our taste in literature.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:13.explanation: stop trying to do 停止「试图」给孩子洗脑。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:14.stem: After all, children and adults are so ____ that we parents should not expect that they will enjoy the same books.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p16:14.explanation: 儿童和成人「差别很大」different，不必期待喜欢同样的书。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:0.stem: Mrs. Ball had a son. His name was Mick. She ____ him very much.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:0.explanation: 总担心他生病、常带他看病，说明非常「爱」loved 他。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:1.stem: …and as he was not a ____ child, she was always ____ that he might be ill,
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:1.explanation: 总担心生病，是因为他体格不「强壮」strong。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:2.stem: …as he was not a strong child, she was always ____ that he might be ill,
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:2.explanation: be afraid that 担心他可能生病。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:3.stem: …she was always afraid that he might be ill, ____ she used to take him to see the best ____ in the town four times a year.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:3.explanation: 前因后果：担心生病，「所以」so 经常带他去看医生。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:4.stem: …she used to take him to see the best ____ in the town four times a year.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:5.stem: …to see the best doctor in the town four times a year to be looked ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:5.explanation: look over 检查身体，固定搭配。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:6.stem: During one of these ____, the doctor gave Mick all kinds of tests.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:6.explanation: 每年四次的看病，「就诊」visits 中的一次。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:7.stem: “Have you had any ____ with your nose or ears recently?”
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:7.explanation: have trouble with 有不舒服/毛病；与结尾 have trouble with them 呼应。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:8.stem: Mick ____ for a second and then answered, “Yes, I ____.”
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:8.explanation: 想了一会儿才回答：「想了想」thought。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:9.stem: Mick thought for a second and then answered, “Yes, I ____.”
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:9.explanation: 回答 Have you had …? 用 have：Yes, I have。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:10.stem: Mrs. Ball was very ____. “But I’m sure you have ____ told me that, Mick!”
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:10.explanation: 从没听儿子说过，所以非常「惊讶」surprised。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:11.stem: “But I’m sure you have ____ told me that, Mick!” she said worriedly.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:11.explanation: 「你以前从没告诉过我」never told me。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:13.stem: “I always have trouble with them when I’m ____ my sweater off.”
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:13.explanation: take off 脱掉：脱毛衣时鼻子耳朵有麻烦。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p17:14.explanation: 脱毛衣会扯到头脸，是因为「领口」collar 太紧。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:0.stem: 【第1空】It is one of the great ____ in the world in the ____ century.（本空为第 1 空）
zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:0.explanation: 计算机是二十世纪的伟大「发明」inventions；discoveries 指发现。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:1.stem: 【第2空】It is one of the great inventions in the world in the ____ century.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:1.explanation: 1946 年建成，属「二十世纪」the twentieth century。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:2.stem: 【第3空】It works for us not only at home, in the offices, in big shops, ____ at schools.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:2.explanation: not only … but also … 固定搭配。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:3.stem: 【第4空】Today it is used ____ many ways.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:3.explanation: in many ways 在许多方面。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:4.stem: 【第5空】It really ____ the world large wealth and happiness.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p18:4.explanation: bring sb. sth. 给世界「带来」brings 财富与幸福。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:0.stem: You may think there is only sand in the desert of the world, ____ it is not true.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:0.explanation: 前后转折：其实并非如此，用 but。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:1.stem: In the desert, as we know, there is a little ____, but it is not ____ for most plants.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:1.explanation: a little 修饰不可数名词，沙漠里有少量「雨水」rain。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:2.stem: There is a little rain in the desert, but it is not ____ for most plants.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:2.explanation: enough 修饰形容词时后置，not enough for most plants 不够大多数植物生长。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:3.stem: Still we can see some plants ____ in the desert.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:3.explanation: see sb./sth. do 省略 to 的不定式作宾补：see some plants live。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:4.stem: There is ____ in some places in the desert. We ____ these places oases.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:4.explanation: 绿洲 oases 的特征是有「水」water。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:5.explanation: call + 宾语 + 宾补：把这些地方「称为」call 绿洲。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:6.stem: People grow ____ kinds of crops in the fields there.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:6.explanation: 各种农作物用 all kinds of。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:7.explanation: also 位于实义动词前：绿洲「外也有人」也生活。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:8.stem: These animals depend ____ the desert plants for their food.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:8.explanation: depend on 依靠，固定搭配。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:9.stem: These animals depend on the desert plants for their food and do not need ____ water.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:9.explanation: 骆驼等耐旱，「不需要很多水」much water（water 不可数用 much）。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:10.stem: The ____ are useful to the desert people in many ways.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:10.explanation: 吃肉喝奶、骆驼运货，是「动物」animals 有用。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:11.stem: They must always look ____ grass or desert plants for their animals.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:12.stem: When there is no more food for their animals, they move to ____ place.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:13.stem: The desert people are ____. No man in the desert would ever refuse ____ the people in trouble.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:13.explanation: 绝不拒绝帮助别人，说明沙漠居民很「友善」friendly。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:14.stem: No man in the desert would ever refuse ____ the people in trouble and give them food and water.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p19:14.explanation: refuse to do sth. 拒绝做某事，接不定式。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:0.stem: He tried not only to take things to sell but also to take money to ____ things with.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:0.explanation: 带钱是为了「买」buy 东西。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:1.stem: He ____ to take ten servants with him.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:2.stem: They would ____ the things to sell and the food to ____ on their trip.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:2.explanation: 仆人「搬运」carry 货物和食物。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:3.stem: They would carry the things to sell and the food to ____ on their trip.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:4.stem: Before they started, a little boy ran up to ____ and asked to ____ with them.（本空为第 5 空）
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:4.explanation: 下文 The rich man said to the little boy 呼应：男孩跑到「富人」the rich man 面前。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:5.stem: A little boy ran up to the rich man and asked to ____ with them.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:6.explanation: 富人对男孩说话：「你」you 可以跟我们一起去。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:7.stem: ____ you are the smallest, the thinnest and the weakest of all my ____, you can’t carry a ____ load.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:7.explanation: But you are the smallest… 表转折：不过你最矮最瘦最弱。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:8.stem: But you are the smallest, the thinnest and the weakest of all my ____, you can’t carry a heavy load.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:9.explanation: 最弱的不能背「重的」heavy 担子。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:10.stem: You must ____ the lightest one to carry.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:10.explanation: 必须「挑选」choose 最轻的一担。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:11.stem: “You are ____,” said his master. “That is the biggest and the heaviest one.”
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:11.explanation: 男孩偏选最大的一担，主人说他「愚蠢」foolish。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:12.stem: The boy said ____ and lifted the load gladly.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:12.explanation: 男孩「什么也没说」said nothing，却高兴地抬起来。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:13.stem: All the servants were tired ____ the little servant.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:13.explanation: 面包被吃掉大半，所以只有小仆人不累：除他「之外」except。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:14.stem: Do you know ____? Most of the bread was eaten during the trip.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p20:14.explanation: 设问引出原因：「知道为什么吗」Do you know why。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:0.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:0.stem: When Jim Grant spotted black smoke coming out of a building, he ____ his car to call 911.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:0.explanation: 为了打电话报警，「停下」stopped 车。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:1.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:1.stem: Then he ____ a U-turn, circling back to take another look.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:1.explanation: make a U-turn 掉头，固定搭配。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:2.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:2.stem: Not seeing or hearing any fire engines ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:2.explanation: 没看见没听见消防车「赶来」approaching，于是他自己冲进去。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:3.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:3.stem: Grant rushed to a side ____ and ran up the stairs.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:3.explanation: 从「侧门」side entrance 冲进楼里跑上楼梯。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:4.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:4.stem: On the second floor, he ____ every apartment door.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:4.explanation: 与下文 He kicked it wide open 呼应：逐门「敲踢」kicked 提醒住户。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:5.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:5.stem: “Get out!” Grant shouted. No one ____ and he assumed that people had already ____.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:6.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:6.stem: No one responded and he assumed that people had already ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:6.explanation: 无人回应，他以为大家已经「逃生」escaped。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:7.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:7.stem: Reaching the end of the hallway, though, Grant ____ a half-open door.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:7.explanation: 转折 though：他「注意到」noticed 一扇半开的门。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:8.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:8.stem: He kicked it wide open, finding a ____ woman in a wheelchair with a little boy and a tiny baby.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:8.explanation: 被困火场的女子「惊恐万分」frightened。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:9.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:9.explanation: 与 Get out! 呼应：大喊「快出去」get out。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:10.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:10.stem: Grant didn’t wait, clutching the baby to his chest and ____ the boy alongside.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:10.explanation: 一手抱婴儿、一手「拖着」dragging 男孩冲下走廊。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:11.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:11.stem: When he was ____ outside, the only ____ in sight was a policeman.

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:12.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:12.stem: When he was safely outside, the only ____ in sight was a policeman.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:12.explanation: 现场唯一能「提供帮助」help 的是一名警察。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:13.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:13.stem: Grant told him about the ____ and they rushed into the smoky building.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:13.explanation: 他告诉警察「那名女子」woman 仍在楼里。

zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:14.title: 完形填空 Cloze Test
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:14.stem: Grant and the policeman were honored for their ____.
zsb-english:18:quiz-p21:14.explanation: 冲进火场救人受表彰，是因为「勇气」courage。

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:0.stem:
【无中生有】原文：Tom went to the store yesterday. He looked at various items on the shelves. After some time, he bought a bottle of milk.
题目：What did Tom do at the store?（汤姆在商店里做了什么？）

options.text: A. He bought a bottle of juice.（他买了一瓶果汁。）
B. He thought the store was too crowded and decided to buy milk quickly.（他觉得商店太拥挤，于是决定赶快买牛奶。）
C. He bought a bottle of milk.（他买了一瓶牛奶。）
D. He looked at fruits only.（他只看了水果。）

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:0.explanation: 原文直接写明 bought a bottle of milk；B 增加「商店拥挤」和「赶快买」的原因，属于无中生有。

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:1.stem:
【扩大或缩小范围】原文：Some experts believe that the new policy will have a positive impact on small- and medium-sized enterprises.
题目：Which of the following is true according to the passage?（根据文章，以下哪项正确？）

options.text: A. Experts believe that the new policy will have a positive impact on all enterprises.
B. Some experts think the new policy benefits small- and medium-sized enterprises.
C. No experts believe the new policy is good for small- and medium-sized enterprises.
D. Some experts doubt the new policy’s impact on small- and medium-sized enterprises.

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:1.explanation: Some experts、small- and medium-sized enterprises 均与原文范围一致；A 把中小企业扩大为全部企业。

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:2.stem:
【反客为主 · 课件第 53 题】原文：Bob’s wife Sandy has a full-time job, and he really prefers her bringing home extra income. Yet he also feels uneasy and troubled. “She puts me off. First she makes dinner, then the kids need something, or a friend calls her. She talks with her sister, her girlfriends, her workmates, but not with me. I sometimes do feel abandoned and annoyed.”
题目：Which of the following statements about Bob and Sandy is true?（以下关于鲍勃和桑迪的陈述，哪项正确？）

options.text: A. Bob doesn’t wish Sandy to do a full-time job.
B. Sandy is too busy to have time talking with Bob.
C. Sandy puts Bob off since there’s no common topic between them anymore.
D. Sandy feels equal to Bob now and no longer loves him as before.

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:2.explanation: 原文列举了桑迪做饭、照顾孩子、接朋友电话以及与亲友和同事交流等忙碌情形；C、D 擅自补入「没有共同话题」「不再爱他」等主观原因。

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:3.stem:
【极端错误 · 课件第 15 题】原文：Knowing the psychology of the game isn’t a sure ticket to winning. But it can help. Ken “Whitey” Watson is one of the world’s best rock, paper, scissors players. He says winning takes skill. “You have to size up your opponent.” Luck and chance play a part, but “you have to be prepared and have a strategy,” he says. “Part of my strategy is being confident.”
题目：What is Ken Watson’s view on the game?（肯·沃森对这个游戏有什么看法？）

options.text: A. Being relaxed is a sure ticket to winning.
B. Being confident can increase the chance to win.
C. Your chance of winning wholly depends on luck.
D. Your chance of winning relates to the size of your opponent.

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:3.explanation: being confident 是策略之一，能够增加获胜机会；A 的 sure、C 的 wholly 把原文的有限作用绝对化，D 把 size up（判断、估量）误解为「体型大小」。

zsb-english:19:quiz-d1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-d1:0.stem:
原文：The first study found that among more than 350 Americans, increased reading of literary fiction when growing up was connected with greater “psychological richness.” … In the second study, the researchers said that among around 2,200 university students, those who read literary fiction were less likely to simply accept authority.
题目：According to the passage, university students who read literary fiction would ______.（根据文章，阅读文学小说的大学生会怎样？）

options.text: A. not easily accept authority（不会轻易接受权威）
B. probably accept authority（可能接受权威）
C. certainly not accept authority（肯定不接受权威）
D. simply accept authority（轻易接受权威）

zsb-english:19:quiz-d1:0.explanation: 原文 were less likely to simply accept authority 与 A 同义；C 的 certainly 把「可能性较低」极端化。

zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:0.stem:
原文：The schools are reluctant to take off—even teachers with tickets for the England-Argentina game had trouble getting the day off.
题目：The underlined word “reluctant” in the passage may probably mean _____.（文中画线词 reluctant 最可能是什么意思？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:0.explanation: 破折号后的「连持票教师都很难请到假」解释了学校不愿放假。

zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:1.stem:
原文：Another popular adaptation is mimicry. Mimicry is when an animal has markings or other physical characteristics that allow it to look like some other kind of animal or plant.…
题目：Which of the following could best explain the word “mimicry” in paragraph 3?（以下哪项最能解释第 3 段中的 mimicry？）

options.text: A. An animal’s physical characteristics don’t look like some other kind of animal or plant.
B. An animal’s physical characteristics look like some other kind of animal or plant.
C. An animal’s physical characteristics look like the same kind of animal or plant.
D. A plant’s physical characteristics look like some other kind of animal or plant.

zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:1.explanation: 定义句直接说明：动物的身体特征使它看起来像另一种动物或植物。

zsb-english:19:quiz-tf1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-tf1:0.stem: Which of the following is NOT true?（以下哪项不正确？）

options.text: A. Usually wisdom teeth erupt through the gums in the corners of our mouths.（智齿通常在口腔角落穿过牙龈萌出。）
B. Our ancestors’ jaws were bigger than ours.（祖先的下颌比我们的更大。）
C. Our teeth do not need to work hard now because our jaws have become smaller.（如今牙齿不必费力，是因为我们的下颌变小了。）
D. Our ancestors needed wisdom teeth to chew hard foods.（祖先需要智齿来咀嚼坚硬食物。）

zsb-english:19:quiz-tf1:0.explanation: 如今牙齿不必费力，是因为较硬食物经过烹煮变软；下颌变小解释的是智齿萌出空间不足和疼痛。

zsb-english:19:quiz-r1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-r1:0.stem: What can be concluded from the passage?（从文章可以得出什么结论？）

options.text: A. Writers’ success depends on luck rather than on effort.
B. Genuine writers often find their work interesting and rewarding.
C. Famous writers usually live in poverty.
D. The chances for a writer to become successful are small.

zsb-english:19:quiz-r1:0.explanation: for every writer kissed by fortune there are thousands more whose longing is never rewarded，表明成功者只是极少数；A 否定努力作用，B 把低报酬说成「回报丰厚」，C 把普通未成功写作者偷换成著名作家。

zsb-english:19:quiz-m1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-m1:0.stem: What is the main idea of the text?（本文的主旨是什么？）

options.text: A. Animals adapt to their habitat in order to survive.
B. Plants adapt to their habitat in order to survive.
C. Animals and plants adapt to their habitat in order to survive.
D. Both animals and plants use camouflage to mix themselves with the environment.

zsb-english:19:quiz-m1:0.explanation: 首段总述 most animals and plants 为适应环境而发展出生存方式，后文分别说明伪装、拟态和适应新环境；A、B 以偏概全，D 将一种适应方式扩大为全部。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:0.stem: The Prince always felt regretful about stories because _____.（王子为什么总对故事感到遗憾？）

options.text: A. he had too much wealth（他太富有）
B. there was a terrible famine（发生了严重饥荒）
C. all stories have ends（所有故事都有结局）
D. there was no storyteller（没有讲故事的人）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:0.explanation: 定位 p3：regretted they had to have an end，遗憾的是故事都有结局。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:1.stem: The young man risked telling an endless story to the Prince for _____.（年轻人冒险讲无尽故事是为了什么？）

options.text: A. a great sum of money（一大笔钱）
B. the Prince’s beautiful daughter（王子美丽的女儿）
C. showing his bravery（展示勇气）
D. both A and C（A、C 两项）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:1.explanation: 定位 p4：The risk is worth your fair daughter；年轻人明确指向王子的女儿。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:2.stem: The young man would be sent to prison if he failed to tell a story without an end _____.（若失败，年轻人会被关多久？）

options.text: B. for some time（一段时间）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:2.explanation: 定位 p5：sent to prison for life，即终身监禁，等同 forever。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:3.stem: In order to prevent famine, the King asked his men to build _____.（为防饥荒，国王命人建造什么？）

options.text: A. a huge storehouse（一座巨大的粮仓）
B. a large farm（一座大农场）
C. a beautiful palace（一座美丽的宫殿）
D. a waterproof kitchen（一间防水厨房）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:3.explanation: 定位 p6：build an enormous storehouse，enormous 与 huge 同义替换。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:4.stem: The thing the King noticed first in the roof was _____.（国王最先在屋顶发现什么？）

options.text: B. a small hole（一个小洞）
C. a grain of corn（一粒玉米）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:4.explanation: 定位 p7：noticed a small hole in the roof，先看到小洞，随后才看到蝗虫和玉米粒。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:0.stem: Which of the following is NOT a function of QR codes?（以下哪项不是二维码的功能？）

options.text: B. Scanning a reader（扫描读取器）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:0.explanation: 定位 p8：二维码被读取器扫描，而不是「扫描读取器」；其余三项都有原文依据。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:1.stem: Why is the bar code mentioned in Paragraph 2?（第 2 段为什么提到条形码？）

options.text: A. To introduce the main topic（引出主题）
B. To show the author’s attitude（表明作者态度）
C. To highlight the features of QR codes（突出二维码的特点）
D. To add some background knowledge（补充背景知识）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:1.explanation: 定位 p9：用一维条形码作对比，突出二维码容量大、尺寸小、耐损坏等特点。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:2.stem: Which best explains “vulnerability” in Paragraph 4?（第 4 段的 vulnerability 最接近哪一义项？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:2.explanation: 定位 p10：后文犯罪分子可替换码盗款，语境说明其「弱点、脆弱性」。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:3.stem: How could we customize our own QR code?（怎样定制自己的二维码？）

options.text: A. By adding a special logo（添加特殊标志）
B. By changing the color（改变颜色）
C. By creating various social options（创建多种社交选项）
D. All of the above（以上都是）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:3.explanation: 定位 p11：adjust the color, add a logo, create social options 三项均出现。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:4.stem: Which is TRUE about QR codes according to the passage?（根据文章，哪项关于二维码的说法正确？）

options.text: A. They were first used in China（它们最先在中国使用）
B. The generators charge users a lot（生成器收费很高）
C. Data editing is possible in printed QR codes（打印后的二维码仍能编辑数据）
D. More scanning devices are available for reading QR codes（有更多设备可读取二维码）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:4.explanation: 定位 p12：anyone can scan … with any reader；A、B、C 均与原文相反。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:0.stem: A social media influencer is someone who _____.（社交媒体影响者是怎样的人？）

options.text: A. pays followers for new products（付钱让粉丝购买新品）
B. takes social relationship courses（学习社交关系课程）
C. specializes in social media studies（专门研究社交媒体）
D. affects the shopping decisions of followers（影响粉丝的购物决定）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:0.explanation: 定位 p13–14：influence the decisions of followers，题干换成购物决定。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:1.stem: Many companies want to use influencers to _____.（许多公司使用影响者来做什么？）

options.text: A. sell their products（销售产品）
B. develop new products（开发新品）
C. design their own websites（设计网站）
D. examine customers’ hearts（研究顾客心理）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:1.explanation: 定位 p15：公司让影响者 market their products，即帮助销售产品。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:2.stem: According to Paragraph 4, why are many people eager to be influencers?（根据第 4 段，为什么许多人渴望成为影响者？）

options.text: A. They may run their own companies（可以经营自己的公司）
B. They want to buy agricultural products（想购买农产品）
C. They want to contribute to poverty reduction（想为扶贫作贡献）
D. They want more chances to access blogs（想获得更多访问博客的机会）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:2.explanation: 定位 p16：例举扶贫直播销量，并说活动鼓励更多人成为影响者。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:3.stem: What is the best way for influencers to connect with followers?（影响者联系粉丝的最佳方式是什么？）

options.text: A. Focusing on their comments（关注评论）
B. Chatting with their best friends（与最好的朋友聊天）
C. Choosing the right online platform（选择合适的网络平台）
D. Describing their favorite things（描述其喜好）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:3.explanation: 定位 p17：The best way … is to decide which medium to use，即选对网络平台。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:4.stem: What is the main idea of this passage?（本文主旨是什么？）

options.text: A. Five methods to influence buyers（影响买家的五种方法）
B. Five tips on earning money as an influencer（影响者赚钱的五条建议）
C. Five methods to use influencers in marketing（营销中运用影响者的五种方法）
D. Five tips on becoming a social media influencer（成为社交媒体影响者的五条建议）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:4.explanation: 定位 p18：Here are five tips on how to do it，全文围绕「怎样成为影响者」。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:0.stem: What can be inferred from the first two paragraphs?（由前两段可推断什么？）

options.text: A. Usually both host and guests enjoy themselves（主人和客人通常都尽兴）
B. Good planning means overexerting the host（好计划意味着主人过度劳累）
C. The host should prepare fully to have more time to enjoy the party（主人应充分准备，以腾出时间享受聚会）
D. It is important for guests to get time to enjoy the party（重要的是让客人有时间享受聚会）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:0.explanation: 定位 p19：主人过度操劳会无暇享受，因此充分计划可为主人留出时间。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:1.stem: Which is NOT mentioned in planning a dinner party?（策划晚宴时，哪项未被提及？）

options.text: A. Informing guests of the date and time beforehand（提前通知日期和时间）
B. Listing and buying ingredients and drinks beforehand（提前列出并购买食材、饮料）
C. Practising cooking according to the menu（按菜单练习烹饪）
D. Preparing proper music（准备合适的音乐）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:1.explanation: 定位 p20：通知、采购、音乐均出现，未提「练习烹饪」。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:2.stem: Get your house in order the day before so that _____.（提前一天收拾房屋是为了什么？）

options.text: A. you may feel less stressed than necessary（减少不必要的压力）
B. you will not get up so early（不用早起）
C. you will have little time to enjoy the party（没多少时间享受聚会）
D. your guests will be much happier（客人会更开心）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:2.explanation: 定位 p21：当天才打扫会 more stressed than … need to be，提前整理可减压。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:3.stem: Which statement is NOT true?（根据文章，哪项不正确？）

options.text: A. Making lists helps（列清单有帮助）
B. A simple menu must be boring（简单菜单一定乏味）
C. Music can make the party run more smoothly（音乐可使聚会更顺畅）
D. Letting guests help themselves makes things easier（让客人自取会更轻松）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:3.explanation: 定位 p22：原文明确说 simple doesn’t mean … boring，B 与原文相反。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:4.stem: What is the passage mainly about?（本文主要讲什么？）

options.text: A. How to save time for a dinner party（如何为晚宴节省时间）
B. How to entertain guests（如何招待客人）
C. How to plan a party（如何策划聚会）
D. How to choose music（如何选音乐）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p4:4.explanation: 全文围绕成功晚宴的计划步骤展开。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:0.stem: When the author went to Howard University, her dream was to be _____.（作者入学时梦想成为什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:0.explanation: 定位 p24：dreaming of sitting on a Supreme Court bench，即想当法官。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:1.stem: Why did the author quit in her second year of college?（作者为什么在大学第二年退学？）

options.text: A. She wanted to study by herself（想自学）
B. She fell in love and got married（恋爱结婚）
C. She suffered from a serious illness（她本人重病）
D. She decided to look after her grandma（决定照顾祖母）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:1.explanation: 定位 p25：祖母患癌后，作者退学照料她。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:2.stem: What can we learn about the author from Paragraph 4?（从第 4 段可知作者怎样？）

options.text: A. She was busy yet happy with family life（家庭生活忙碌但快乐）
B. She ignored her guilty feelings for her sons（无视对儿子的愧疚）
C. She wanted to remain a full-time housewife（想一直做全职主妇）
D. She was too confused to make a correct choice（困惑得无法正确选择）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:2.explanation: 定位 p26：fully occupied 对应忙碌，a joyous zoo 对应快乐。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:3.stem: What does the author mainly tell us in the last paragraph?（末段主要告诉我们什么？）

options.text: A. Failure is the mother of success（失败是成功之母）
B. Little by little, one goes far（积少成多，行稳致远）
C. Every coin has two sides（凡事有两面）
D. Well begun is half done（好的开始是成功的一半）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:3.explanation: 定位 p27：little steps add up to big dreams 与「积少成多」相符。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:4.stem: Which can best describe the author?（哪项最能描述作者？）

options.text: A. Caring and determined（有爱心且坚定）
B. Honest and responsible（诚实且负责）
C. Ambitious and sensitive（雄心勃勃且敏感）
D. Innocent and single-minded（天真且专一）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p5:4.explanation: 照料祖母体现关爱，长期以每学期一门课追梦体现坚定。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:0.stem: We can learn from the story that _____.（从故事可知什么？）

options.text: A. only straw hats of the same style were sold（只卖同款草帽）
B. most Americans do not want to repeat the same work endlessly（多数美国人不愿无休止地重复工作）
C. straw hats were sold only in the mountain village（草帽只在山村出售）
D. buying many hats of one style makes them cheaper（同款买得多会更便宜）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:0.explanation: 定位 p29：hate repeating the same work endlessly。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:1.stem: How much did the nice hat cost?（那顶漂亮的帽子售价多少？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:1.explanation: 定位 p30：帽子 cost five dollars。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:2.stem: The shopkeeper’s answer made the tourist _____.（店主的回答让游客怎样？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:2.explanation: 定位 p31：could not understand，故感到困惑。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:3.stem: Why did the shopkeeper ask the tourist to pay double?（店主为什么要求双倍价格？）

options.text: A. He could not make two hundred hats of one style（做不了二百顶同款帽子）
B. He could not stand repeating the same work endlessly（无法忍受无休止地重复同一工作）
C. He did not want to sell so many hats（不想卖那么多帽子）
D. He did not have enough straw（没有足够的稻草）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:3.explanation: 定位 p32：二百顶同款会令店主无聊至极，呼应首段对重复劳动的厌恶。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:4.stem: “It will bore me almost to death” means _____.（这句话是什么意思？）

options.text: A. it would be too expensive for the shopkeeper（成本太贵）
B. the shopkeeper was bored and would die at once（店主无聊并会立刻死去）
C. the shopkeeper was dying（店主正在死去）
D. it would be too boring for the shopkeeper（这会让店主极其无聊）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p6:4.explanation: bore … to death 是夸张表达，意为「无聊得要命」，并非真的死亡。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:0.stem: What can we learn from the first two paragraphs?（从前两段可知什么？）

options.text: A. Releasing nuclear wastewater has aroused worldwide concern（核污染水排放引发全球关注）
B. All seafood imported from Japan will be banned（所有日本进口海鲜都将被禁）
C. Chinese consumers will avoid eating all seafood（中国消费者将不再吃任何海鲜）
D. Japan’s plan is criticized by Japanese people（该计划遭日本人批评）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:0.explanation: 定位 p34：a matter of global concern；B 把十个城市扩大为全部，C、D 无依据。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:1.stem: How often did Mr. Wang eat Japanese seafood before?（王先生以前多久吃一次日本海鲜？）

options.text: B. Once a year（每年一次）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:1.explanation: 定位 p35：used to eat Japanese food per month，即每月一次。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:2.stem: What can be inferred from Wang Qian’s words?（从王倩的话可推断什么？）

options.text: A. She will not eat seafood anymore（她再也不吃海鲜）
B. She will be more cautious about the source of seafood（她会更谨慎地关注海鲜来源）
C. She will work for human health and marine ecology（她会投身健康与海洋生态事业）
D. She is sure Japan will solve the problem（她确信日本会解决问题）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:2.explanation: 定位 p36：从「不关注来源」变为「尽量不选日本海鲜」，说明更谨慎。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:3.stem: What will be mentioned in the following passage?（下文最可能提到什么？）

options.text: A. China’s methods of dealing with nuclear wastewater（中国处理核污染水的方法）
B. The influence on Japanese cosmetic products（对日本化妆品的影响）
C. A call for Japan to make safer cosmetics（呼吁日本生产更安全的化妆品）
D. The world’s response to the release（世界对此次排放的回应）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:3.explanation: 定位 p37：末句由食品转向日本化妆品，下一段应承接该话题。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:4.stem: What is the best title?（最佳标题是什么？）

options.text: A. How to Choose Seafood（如何选择海鲜）
B. Japanese Cosmetic Products（日本化妆品）
C. The Source of Seafood（海鲜来源）
D. Japan Releasing Nuclear Wastewater into the Sea（日本向海洋排放核污染水）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p7:4.explanation: 文章围绕日本核污染水排海及消费者反应展开。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:0.stem: The text is written by _____.（本文由谁撰写？）

options.text: A. a basketball player（篮球运动员）
B. a basketball coach（篮球教练）
D. a sports reporter（体育记者）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:0.explanation: 定位 p39：After coaching him for eight seasons，叙述者是教练。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:1.stem: What is true about Michael Jordan?（关于乔丹，哪项正确？）

options.text: A. He cannot jump high（他跳不高）
B. He cannot run fast（他跑不快）
C. He can shoot well（他投篮好）
D. He often takes a day off（他经常休息一天）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:1.explanation: 定位 p40：乔丹 shoot well；其余均与原文相反。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:2.stem: What does “Playing outstanding defense didn’t come straight to him” mean?（画线句是什么意思？）

options.text: A. He was not outstanding at defense at the beginning（起初他的防守并不出色）
B. He was outstanding at defense from the beginning（他一开始防守就很出色）
C. Outstanding defense was important to him（出色防守对他很重要）
D. Outstanding defense was not important to him（出色防守对他不重要）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:2.explanation: 定位 p41：随后写他研究对手、苦练技术，说明出色防守并非一开始就有。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:3.stem: Michael Jordan was all the following EXCEPT _____.（以下哪项不属于乔丹？）

options.text: A. respecting other players（尊重其他球员）
B. helping a fallen opponent（扶起倒地的对手）
C. having a competitive spirit（有竞争精神）
D. building himself up by tearing others down（靠贬低别人抬高自己）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:3.explanation: 定位 p42：原文说他 not … build himself up by tearing someone else down。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:4.stem: Which is NOT true?（哪项不正确？）

options.text: A. The coach regarded Jordan as a friend（教练把乔丹视为朋友）
B. Seriously ill children could meet Jordan（重病儿童有机会见乔丹）
C. Jordan has influenced many players through his love for the game（乔丹已凭对篮球的热爱影响许多球员）
D. Jordan does not think talent is all a player needs（乔丹不认为天赋就是成功所需的一切）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p8:4.explanation: 定位 p43–44：教练表达的是对年轻球员「将会受到影响」的希望，C 把愿望说成既成事实。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:0.stem: Which statement is NOT TRUE?（哪项不正确？）

options.text: A. McDonald’s was founded in 1948（麦当劳创立于 1948 年）
B. It has restaurants in every city in the world（它在全世界每个城市都有门店）
C. It now has over 30,000 locations（现有三万多家门店）
D. It was very small at the beginning（起初规模很小）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:0.explanation: 定位 p45：只说 118 个国家，不能扩大为全世界每个城市。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:1.stem: “Ubiquitous” in Paragraph 2 most likely means _____.（ubiquitous 最可能是什么意思？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:1.explanation: 定位 p46：结合「全球 5800 万日顾客」和各地门店，词义为「无处不在」。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:2.stem: From Paragraph 2, we can conclude that _____.（从第 2 段可得出什么？）

options.text: A. McDonald’s designs menus to suit local people（麦当劳按当地人口味设计菜单）
B. millions got their first job there（数百万人第一份工作在麦当劳）
C. its menu sticks to old-fashioned favorites（菜单坚持传统经典款）
D. low prices bring tens of millions daily（低价每天吸引数千万人）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:2.explanation: 定位 p47：choices vary widely depending on location，并举亚洲、印度菜单为例。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:3.stem: What did José Bové and his people do in 1999?（1999 年他们如何抗议麦当劳？）

options.text: A. They organized a strike（组织罢工）
B. They protested outside a McDonald’s（在店外抗议）
C. They refused to enter a new McDonald’s（拒绝进入新店）
D. They destroyed a McDonald’s under construction（拆毁一间在建麦当劳）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:3.explanation: 定位 p48：destroyed a McDonald’s under construction。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:4.stem: In _____, an employee died in a bomb attack on a French McDonald’s.（哪一年，一名员工在法国麦当劳爆炸案中死亡？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p9:4.explanation: 定位 p49：1999 年事件的 The next year 即 2000 年。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:0.stem: Air travel has become an everyday experience because it is _____.（航空旅行为何成为日常经历？）

options.text: B. easy to get（容易获得）
D. clean and comfortable（干净舒适）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:0.explanation: 定位 p50：because it’s so fast。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:1.stem: “His brain is in one country and his body is in another” means _____.（该句是什么意思？）

options.text: A. the traveler goes mad（旅客疯了）
B. the traveler becomes foolish（旅客变笨了）
C. the traveler is not responsible for flying（旅客不负责飞行）
D. the traveler does not know where he is（旅客不知自己身在何处）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:1.explanation: 定位 p51：紧接的解释 he hardly knows where he is。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:2.stem: Doctors say air travelers should _____ after a long journey.（医生建议长途旅行后怎样？）

options.text: A. go to work immediately（立即工作）
B. exercise to relax（运动放松）
C. stay with family（陪伴家人）
D. go to bed and rest well（上床好好休息）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:2.explanation: 定位 p52：go straight to bed 且不能不休息就工作。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:3.stem: Pilots are hardly affected by frequent flying because they _____.（飞行员为何较少受频繁飞行影响？）

options.text: A. live by their own timetable（按自己的时间表生活）
C. have special training against it（受过专门抗疲劳训练）
D. are especially strong（身体特别强壮）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:3.explanation: 定位 p53：飞行员 live by their own watches，不理会当地时间。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:4.stem: What most likely happens to businessmen after a long journey EXCEPT _____.（以下哪项通常不会发生在商务人士长途飞行后？）

options.text: A. going to a meeting（去开会）
B. going home for a good rest（回家好好休息）
C. reporting to their boss（向老板汇报）
D. going to work directly（直接工作）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p10:4.explanation: 定位 p54：原文提到直接开会或向老板汇报，没有回家休息。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:0.stem: Jim Thorpe was born in _____.（索普出生在哪里？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:0.explanation: 定位 p55：出生地如今是 Oklahoma。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:1.stem: Most Native American children loved all the following EXCEPT _____.（原住民儿童喜欢以下活动，除了哪项？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:1.explanation: 定位 p56：原文列钓鱼、打猎、游泳和户外游戏，没有唱歌。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:2.stem: Jim Thorpe started to play sports _____.（索普什么时候开始运动？）

options.text: A. before he was nine（九岁前）
B. when he was sixteen（十六岁时）
C. when he was twenty-four（二十四岁时）
D. before his parents died（父母去世前）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:2.explanation: 定位 p57：十六岁失去父母后去特殊学校，There … began to play sports。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:3.stem: “Decathlon” in Paragraph 3 probably means _____.（decathlon 最可能指什么？）

options.text: B. five track-and-field events（五项田径项目）
D. ten track-and-field events（十项田径项目）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:3.explanation: 定位 p58：The decathlon has ten track and field events。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:4.stem: Which is NOT TRUE?（哪项不正确？）

options.text: A. In 1912, Thorpe returned to finish college（1912 年索普返校完成大学教育）
B. He won two gold medals at the 1912 Olympics（他在 1912 年奥运会夺得两金）
C. He once played baseball for money（他曾靠打棒球挣钱）
D. In 1950, he was named the greatest American football player（1950 年他被评为最伟大的美国橄榄球运动员）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p11:4.explanation: 定位 p59：返校完成教育发生在 1912 年奥运会之前；B、C、D 均有明示。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:0.stem: “Zaftig” in Paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to _____.（zaftig 最接近哪一含义？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:0.explanation: 定位 p60：zaftig 与上文 overweight、下文 “skinny” 构成语境对应。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:1.stem: We can infer from the first two paragraphs that _____.（由前两段可推断什么？）

options.text: A. large gym chains want members to show up often（大型连锁健身房想让会员经常来）
B. overweight people are often frustrated and pushed away by traditional gyms（传统健身业常令超重者受挫、被排斥）
C. regular gyms do not accept overweight people（普通健身房不接纳超重者）
D. overweight people must pay extra（超重者必须额外付费）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:1.explanation: 定位 p61：超重者会自我意识过强、感到孤立，传统环境有排斥感。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:2.stem: What is the training goal in gyms catering to overweight members?（这类健身房的训练目标是什么？）

options.text: A. To achieve functional fitness（实现功能性体能）
B. To build six-pack abs（练出六块腹肌）
C. To look like a fitness model（像健身模特）
D. To run long distances（长距离跑步）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:2.explanation: 定位 p62：functional fitness as a practical goal。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:3.stem: Which statement about these gyms is NOT TRUE?（关于这类健身房，哪项不正确？）

options.text: A. Machines are designed for larger people（器械为身材较大者设计）
B. Tinted windows provide privacy（有色窗保护隐私）
C. There are larger mirrors on the walls（墙上有更大的镜子）
D. Training goals are more realistic（训练目标更实际）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:3.explanation: 定位 p63：原文是 no mirrors，并非更大的镜子。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:4.stem: What is the best title?（最佳标题是什么？）

options.text: A. Improving Women’s Self-confidence Through Exercise（通过锻炼提高女性自信）
B. The Traditional Gym Industry Is Losing Customers（传统健身业正在失去顾客）
C. The Fitness Industry Is Looking for New Directions（健身业正在寻找新方向）
D. Specialized Gyms Designed for Overweight People（为超重者设计的专业健身房）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p12:4.explanation: 文章集中介绍为超重者调整空间、教练、目标和器械的专业健身房。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:0.stem: What was Fiona like?（菲奥娜是怎样的人？）

options.text: A. Humorous and friendly（幽默且友好）
B. Kind and unfriendly（善良但不友好）
C. Clever but unfriendly（聪明但不友好）
D. Friendly but not clever（友好但不聪明）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:0.explanation: 定位 p65：clever and humorous、kind and friendly。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:1.stem: “Terrible” in Paragraph 2 means “_____” in Chinese.（terrible 在文中是什么意思？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:1.explanation: 定位 p66：她没收到礼物且哭了数小时，terrible 表示感受「极坏、很糟」。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:2.stem: Why did Fiona feel terrible?（菲奥娜为什么很难过？）

options.text: A. She had no friends at school（她在学校没有朋友）
B. No one wanted to play with her（没人愿与她玩）
C. She had no money for presents（她没钱买礼物）
D. She received no present on Friendship Day（友谊日没有收到礼物）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:2.explanation: 定位 p67：她是唯一没有收到礼物的人。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension

options.text: A. Fiona never spent time with only one friend（菲奥娜从不只和一位朋友相处）
B. Fiona did not buy presents on Friendship Day（她在友谊日没买礼物）
C. Fiona had fun on Friendship Day（她在友谊日玩得开心）
D. Fiona had no true friends at last（最后她仍没有真正的朋友）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:3.explanation: 定位 p68：never spent time with only one friend；B、C、D 均与原文相反。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:4.stem: What is the best title?（最佳标题是什么？）

options.text: A. How to Make Many Friends（如何结交许多朋友）
B. How to Buy Presents（如何买礼物）
C. Make True Friends（结交真正的朋友）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p13:4.explanation: 定位 p69：结局强调 true friends，主旨是真正的友谊。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p14:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p14:0.stem: Why do companies spend money to advertise?（公司为什么花钱做广告？）

options.text: A. To sell their products（销售产品）
B. To compete with others（与他人竞争）
C. To call people’s attention（吸引人们注意）
D. To compare prices（比较价格）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p14:0.explanation: 定位 p70：广告用来 get people’s attention to sell products，题目问直接目的「吸引注意」。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p14:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p14:1.stem: What does “atypical” mean?（atypical 是什么意思？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p14:1.explanation: 定位 p71：NO-AD 避开传统方式，故 atypical 与 unusual 同义。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p14:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p14:2.stem: How does NO-AD sell its products?（NO-AD 如何销售产品？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p14:2.explanation: 定位 p72：sells its products by word of mouth。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p14:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p14:3.stem: Why is the NO-AD method successful to a degree?（NO-AD 的方式为何在一定程度上成功？）

options.text: A. Because we love products（因为我们喜爱产品）
B. Because we trust our loved ones’ words（因为我们信任亲友的话）
C. Because they show the best products（因为他们展示最好的产品）
D. Because the products are believable（因为产品本身可信）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p14:3.explanation: 定位 p73：亲友意见重要且比广告商自夸更可信。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:0.stem: “Average” in Paragraph 1 means _____.（average 在文中是什么意思？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:0.explanation: 定位 p74–75：average men and women 指一般、普通人。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:1.stem: Housewives are not as healthy as career women because _____.（家庭主妇不如职业女性健康的原因是什么？）

options.text: A. they are poorer（她们更贫穷）
B. they eat less（她们吃得更少）
C. they have more children（她们孩子更多）
D. they have fewer chances to communicate with others（她们与他人交流的机会较少）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:1.explanation: 定位 p76：工作使人忙碌并远离孤独，可推知家庭主妇交流机会较少。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:2.stem: Which statement is TRUE according to Paragraph 2?（根据第 2 段，哪项正确？）

options.text: A. Busy people have nothing to do at home（忙碌者在家无事可做）
B. There is no friendship and warmth at home（家里没有友谊与温暖）
C. High achievers do not care about families（成就高的人不关心家庭）
D. A satisfying job helps people stay healthy（令人满意的工作有助健康）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:2.explanation: 定位 p77：忙碌让人远离孤独、保持快乐，概括为满意的工作有益健康。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:3.stem: If a doctor successfully operates on a patient, he could feel _____.（医生成功完成手术后会怎样？）

options.text: D. very heady（非常兴奋到失去理智）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:3.explanation: 定位 p78：成功手术带来 a sense of fulfillment，且 happy beyond words。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:4.stem: The best title may be _____.（最佳标题可能是什么？）

options.text: A. People Should Find a Job（人们应找工作）
B. Working Is Good for Health（工作有益健康）
C. People Should Make Friends by Work（人们应通过工作交友）
D. Loss of Work Means Loss of Everything（失去工作就是失去一切）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p15:4.explanation: 首段结论和末段总结都指向「工作有益健康」。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:0.stem: What can we say the Underground Railroad is?（「地下铁路」是什么？）

options.text: A. A kind of train（一种火车）
B. A special railroad（一条特殊铁路）
C. A group of slaves（一群奴隶）
D. A secret organization（一个秘密组织）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:0.explanation: 定位 p80：它帮助奴隶逃亡，结合 through which 可知并非实体铁路，而是秘密组织网络。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:1.stem: People called Harriet “Moses” because they regarded her as _____.（人们称她「摩西」是把她视为什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:1.explanation: 定位 p81：她带领约三百名奴隶走向自由，像《圣经》中带领族人的摩西。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:2.stem: Which is true according to the text?（哪项正确？）

options.text: A. Harriet was well educated as a child（她童年受过良好教育）
B. Harriet worked for black people until the end of her life（她终生为黑人奔走）
C. Slavery ended during the Civil War（奴隶制在内战中结束）
D. The government honored her bravery during her lifetime（政府生前表彰其勇气）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:2.explanation: 定位 p82：战后仍为黑人儿童教育等事业工作直到晚年；A、C、D 无明示或表述错误。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:3.stem:
Which is the right order?（事件顺序正确的是哪项？）
a. She was called Moses　b. She spied for the North　c. She worked in the field　d. She returned to New York　e. She was honored as a hero　f. She escaped into Pennsylvania

options.text: A. c; f; a; b; d; e
B. f; b; c; d; e; a
C. f; c; b; a; d; e
D. c; f; b; a; d; e

zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:3.explanation: 按经历依次为童年下田（c）→逃往宾州（f）→被称摩西（a）→为北方侦察（b）→回纽约（d）→被誉英雄（e）。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:4.stem: What is the best title?（最佳标题是什么？）

options.text: A. Cruel American Civil War（残酷的美国内战）
B. A History of American Black Slaves（美国黑人奴隶史）
C. A Brief Introduction to Harriet Tubman（哈丽雅特·塔布曼简介）
D. Information on the Underground Railroad（地下铁路资料）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p16:4.explanation: 全文按时间介绍塔布曼的经历与贡献。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:0.stem: Which statement best summarizes the passage?（哪项最能概括全文？）

options.text: A. Children are interested in some packages（儿童对某些包装感兴趣）
B. Packaging is an important way of advertising（包装是重要广告方式）
C. People prefer products in plain containers（人们更喜欢普通容器产品）
D. Package size usually motivates a buyer（包装大小通常刺激购买）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:0.explanation: 首句即主题句，后文三个方面说明包装如何影响购买。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:1.stem: “A buyer will get something for nothing” means _____.（该短语是什么意思？）

options.text: A. a buyer gets something free of charge（买家免费得到某物）
B. a buyer gets something useless（买家得到无用之物）
C. a buyer gets something useful（买家得到有用之物）
D. nothing is worth buying（没有东西值得买）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:1.explanation: 定位 p86：消费者以为可重复容器 is free，即免费得到。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:2.stem: Which statement is NOT true?（哪项不正确？）

options.text: A. Packages sometimes motivate people（包装有时刺激购买）
B. Children may care more about package games than the product（孩子可能更在意包装游戏）
C. A reusable-container product must be cheaper than a plain one（可重复容器产品一定更便宜）
D. “Economy Size” is not always the best value（「经济装」并不总最划算）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:2.explanation: 定位 p87：普通容器中的同类产品可能更便宜，C 与原文相反。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:3.stem: What does “them” in Paragraph 1 refer to?（第 1 段 them 指代什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:3.explanation: 定位 p88：ask their parents for them，逻辑上请父母购买的是 products。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:4.stem: What does the author imply in the last paragraph?（末段暗示什么？）

options.text: A. A package is only an advertisement（包装只是广告）
B. Buyers should not trust package information too much（买家不应过度相信包装信息）
C. A package has nothing to do with the product（包装与产品毫无关系）
D. Package information always gives answers（包装信息总能给出答案）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p17:4.explanation: 定位 p89：包装是广告且 do not tell the whole story，不可尽信。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p18:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p18:0.stem: 【原题 1】What is the author’s main purpose?（作者的主要写作目的是什么？）

options.text: A. To explain the role of sport（解释体育的作用）
B. To compare Scotland with Argentina（比较苏格兰与阿根廷）
C. To show Argentina is better than all others（说明阿根廷全面优于他国）
D. To prove football is the world’s third most important sport（证明足球是世界第三重要运动）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p18:0.explanation: 课件 p90 原答案为 A；全文讨论体育从娱乐、个人卓越到国家荣誉的作用与张力。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p18:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p18:1.stem: 【原题 2】“Summit” in Paragraph 2 means _____.（summit 是什么意思？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p18:1.explanation: 定位 p91：世界杯冠军是国际体育成功的 summit，即最高点。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p18:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p18:2.stem: 【原题 4】If a sportsman thinks only about winning, he will _____.（运动员若只想着胜利，会怎样？）

options.text: A. fail to succeed（无法成功）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p18:2.explanation: 定位 p92：只想赢就不能再想着 enjoying himself，即失去乐趣。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p18:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p18:3.stem: 【原题 5】What is the author’s attitude toward international games?（作者对国际比赛持何态度？）

options.text: A. Nations meeting on the field are unlikely to meet on a battlefield（赛场相遇的国家不太会在战场相遇）
B. World Cup winners are best in all aspects（世界杯冠军各方面都最好）
C. Winners prove their country is best at least on that sports field（获胜至少证明该国在该运动上最好）
D. Countries valuing international contests become famous in many ways（重视国际比赛的国家会多方面闻名）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p18:3.explanation: 定位 p93：作者否认「一切都更好」，但肯定 in one way at least 本国最好。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:0.stem: What is unusual about The Crimea’s business plan?（该乐队商业计划有何不同寻常？）

options.text: A. Its product was given away free online（产品在网上免费提供）
B. It gave CDs away in shops（在商店免费送 CD）
C. It played free concerts（举行免费演出）
D. It charged more for CDs（提高 CD 售价）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:0.explanation: 定位 p94：乐队让人免费在线下载专辑。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:1.stem: The Crimea hopes to make money _____.（乐队希望如何赚钱？）

options.text: A. through CD sales（通过 CD 销售）
B. through concerts and merchandise（通过演出和周边商品）
C. by selling merchandise online（在网上卖周边）
D. through merchandise sales in shops（在商店卖周边）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:1.explanation: 定位 p95：主要靠演唱会与 T 恤等周边，而非音乐销售。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:2.stem: Why did it also release CDs in shops?（为什么仍在商店发行 CD？）

options.text: A. Concert-goers need them（观众需要）
B. It wanted extra money（想赚额外的钱）
C. Some people still prefer CDs to other formats（仍有人偏爱 CD 等实体形式）
D. People missing concerts need them（错过演出的人需要）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:2.explanation: 定位 p96：some people … want something they can hold，即仍偏爱实体 CD。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:3.stem: What was true about music sales over the last year?（过去一年音乐销售情况怎样？）

options.text: A. Overall sales were up（总销售上升）
B. Overall sales were down（总销售下降）
C. There was no change（没有变化）
D. It was not mentioned（文章未提）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:3.explanation: 定位 p97：数字销售上升，但 overall record company sales are down。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:4.stem: What effect has the Internet had on music piracy?（互联网怎样影响音乐盗版？）

options.text: A. It made piracy easier to fight（更容易打击盗版）
B. It increased pirate CDs（增加盗版 CD 数量）
C. It made illegal copying easier（使非法复制音乐更容易）
D. It reduced pirate CDs（减少盗版 CD）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p19:4.explanation: 定位 p98：互联网让音乐在文件共享网站更大规模地复制、传播。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:0.stem: What is a goal of a job interview for a company?（公司面试的目标是什么？）

options.text: A. To change the hiring process（改变招聘流程）
B. To discuss best practices（讨论最佳做法）
C. To find the right person for a job（找到适合岗位的人）
D. To attract industry leaders（吸引行业领袖）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:0.explanation: 定位 p99：目标是找到 the best fit for the position。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:1.stem: （源页误标 12.）What is the problem with a typical interview?（传统面试有什么问题？）

options.text: A. It is held in the company（在公司举行）
B. Employers may fail to know candidates well（雇主可能仍无法深入了解候选人）
C. Employers may ask candidates to read resumes（雇主可能让候选人读简历）
D. It is held in a conference room（在会议室举行）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:1.explanation: 定位 p100：传统面试后，雇主对候选人的了解并未明显超过简历。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:2.stem: Why do some employers create hiring teams?（为什么组建招聘团队？）

options.text: A. They have no time for interviews（雇主没时间面试）
B. They must compare candidates with current staff（必须把候选人与员工比较）
C. They want employees to form research teams（想让员工组成研究团队）
D. They want to ensure candidates can get along with employees（想确认候选人能与员工相处）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:2.explanation: 定位 p101：团队面试有助于确认新人能否与现有员工相处。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:3.stem: What does “diversity” in Paragraph 4 mean?（diversity 是什么意思？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:3.explanation: 定位 p102：后文 unique perspective 解释了观点的多样性。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:4.stem: The author mainly discusses _____.（作者主要讨论什么？）

options.text: A. new viewpoints on a company（关于公司的新观点）
B. new trends in the hiring process（招聘流程的新趋势）
C. the importance of a job interview（面试的重要性）
D. methods to get along with employers（与雇主相处的方法）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p20:4.explanation: 定位 p103：首段直接提出 new trends in the hiring process，后文逐项展开。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p21:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p21:0.stem: What is the author’s main purpose?（作者主要写作目的是什么？）

options.text: A. To tell us what the poverty line is（告知什么是贫困线）
B. To explain why some people are poor（解释一些人贫困的原因）
C. To find solutions to poverty（寻找贫困问题的解决办法）
D. To show sympathy for poor people（表达对穷人的同情）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p21:0.explanation: 文章先定义贫困线，再集中解释穷人难以就业的年龄等原因；A 只是开头信息。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p21:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p21:1.stem: How many people are considered poor in the United States?（美国约有多少人被视为贫困者？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p21:1.explanation: 定位 p105：About ten percent … are below the poverty line。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p21:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p21:2.stem: Most poor Americans are not qualified for employment because _____.（许多美国穷人不具备就业条件是因为？）

options.text: A. they lack motivation（缺乏工作动力）
B. they have little education and few skills（教育程度低、技能少）
C. they are too young or too old（年龄太小或太大）
D. they have physical and family problems（有身体和家庭问题）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p21:2.explanation: 定位 p106：40% 以上是儿童，另有大量 65 岁以上老人。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p21:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p21:3.stem: What can we infer?（可推断出什么？）

options.text: A. Better solutions to poverty have not yet been found（尚未找到更好的贫困解决办法）
B. Welfare will make people rich（福利会让人富裕）
C. Poor people will become rich if helped by the rich（有富人帮助，穷人必会富裕）
D. Employment is the best solution（就业是最佳解决办法）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p21:3.explanation: 定位 p107：经济学家仍在寻找更好办法，当前许多人仍依赖福利。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p22:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p22:0.stem: Is it wise to keep children away from computers, and why?（让孩子远离电脑明智吗？为什么？）

options.text: A. No; millions of sites are interesting and educational（不明智；数百万网站有趣且有教育意义）
B. No; children have the right to use computers（不明智；孩子有权使用电脑）
C. Yes; many rubbish sites may hurt children（明智；许多垃圾网站会伤害孩子）
D. Yes; children may become addicted to games（明智；孩子可能沉迷游戏）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p22:0.explanation: 定位 p108：有害网站只占 1%—3%，另有约 450 万个有益网站。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p22:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p22:1.stem: In the last two paragraphs, parents are advised to _____.（末两段建议父母怎样做？）

options.text: A. learn about the Internet with their children（和孩子一起学习互联网）
B. watch children while at work（孩子工作时监视他们）
C. search for information for children（替孩子搜索信息）
D. make friends with their children（和孩子交朋友）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p22:1.explanation: 定位 p109：learn about the Internet … alongside your children。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p22:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p22:2.stem: The best way to protect children while using the Internet is _____.（既保护孩子又利用互联网的最佳方式是什么？）

options.text: A. filtering programs（使用过滤程序）
B. parents’ mastery of computer skills（父母精通电脑技能）
C. supervision combined with communication（监督与沟通相结合）
D. forbidding online friends（禁止结交网友）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p22:2.explanation: 定位 p110：原文直接说监督与沟通结合是 the best way。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p22:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p22:3.stem: “Lagging behind” is closest in meaning to _____.（lagging behind 最接近哪一项？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p22:3.explanation: 定位 p111：父母的电脑技能不及较早接触技术的孩子，故指「落后」。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:0.stem: Paragraph 1 describes a person who probably _____.（第 1 段描述的人可能怎样？）

options.text: A. loves decorative objects（喜爱装饰品）
B. cannot afford essentials（买不起必需品）
C. chooses a simple life（选择简单生活）
D. loves counting clothes（热衷数衣服）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:0.explanation: 定位 p112–113：屋主并非贫穷，而是主动限制物品数量的极简主义者。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:1.stem: What does minimalism go against?（极简主义反对什么？）

options.text: B. Living a fulfilling life（过充实生活）
C. Limiting belongings（限制物品数量）
D. Buying more than necessary（购买超过需要的物品）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:1.explanation: 定位 p113：goes against consumer society，即反对超出需要的消费。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:2.stem: If people adopt minimalism, they will _____.（采用极简生活后会怎样？）

options.text: B. keep up with trends（追赶最新潮流）
C. think about what is missing（想着缺少什么）
D. have more time for meaningful things（有更多时间做有意义的事）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:2.explanation: 定位 p114：减少财物为运动、旅行、陪伴亲友等有意义之事腾出时间。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:3.stem: Mild minimalism became popular because of Kondo’s _____.（温和极简主义因近藤的什么而流行？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:3.explanation: 定位 p115：thanks to Marie Kondo’s best-selling book。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:4.stem: What is the real meaning of minimalism?（极简主义的真正含义是什么？）

options.text: A. Balancing belongings and joy（在财物与快乐间取得平衡）
B. Putting possessions before happiness（把财物置于幸福之前）
C. Throwing away as much as possible（尽可能扔掉私人物品）
D. Buying more to follow fashion（为追逐潮流而买更多东西）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p23:4.explanation: 定位 p116：striking a balance between personal joy and possessions。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:0.stem: Which statement is TRUE?（哪项正确？）

options.text: A. All three were language majors（三人都是语言专业学生）
B. Steve and Jim were more alike in character（史蒂夫与吉姆性格更相像）
C. The author did not enjoy talking with Steve（作者不喜欢与史蒂夫交谈）
D. Their living condition was rather poor（他们居住条件很差）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:0.explanation: 定位 p117：作者学英语，吉姆学法语，史蒂夫学中文，三人都在学语言。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:1.stem: What is the author’s opinion of Steve?（作者怎样看史蒂夫？）

options.text: A. He was very hardworking（他非常勤奋）
B. He enjoyed cooking Chinese food（他喜欢做中餐）
C. He enjoyed shopping more than Jim（他比吉姆更爱购物）
D. His Chinese accent was pure（他的中文口音很纯正）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:1.explanation: 定位 p118：作者被史蒂夫的 diligence 感动，说明他勤奋。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:2.stem: Which is TRUE about Jim?（关于吉姆，哪项正确？）

options.text: A. Dating girls took much of his time（与女孩约会占用他很多时间）
B. He had a French way of making friends（他以法国方式交友）
C. He learned French in order to date Paris girls（他为和巴黎女孩约会而学法语）
D. He liked doing housework（他喜欢做家务）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:2.explanation: 定位 p119：他 too busy dating … to do any shopping。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:3.stem: The last sentence of the first paragraph implies that _____.（第一段末句暗示什么？）

options.text: A. Steve did not like helping others（史蒂夫不喜欢助人）
B. Americans eat only their own food（美国人只吃本国食物）
C. Americans and Chinese differ in values（美国人与中国人的价值观不同）
D. Steve wanted Jim to shop for himself（史蒂夫想让吉姆自己购物）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:3.explanation: 定位 p120：史蒂夫虽学中文，仍坚持美国价值观；这体现中美价值观差异。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:4.stem: From the last paragraph, we learn that _____.（从末段可知什么？）

options.text: A. Jim is a very good husband（吉姆是好丈夫）
B. Steve enjoys teaching Chinese（史蒂夫喜欢教中文）
C. The author works for overseas students（作者为留学生工作）
D. The three friends still keep in touch（三位朋友仍保持联系）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p24:4.explanation: 定位 p121：末段首句直接说 The three of us still keep in touch。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:0.stem: Why cover each bite of food in space?（为什么在太空中包住每一口食物？）

options.text: A. Small pieces would fall to the floor（碎屑会落到地板）
B. Weightless pieces might travel around and cause trouble（失重碎屑会漂浮并惹麻烦）
C. There is not enough food for long trips（长途食物不足）
D. Astronauts do not want to waste food（宇航员不想浪费食物）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:0.explanation: 定位 p122：失重碎屑会漂动并进入眼睛或仪器。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:1.stem: In a spaceship, astronauts can _____.（在飞船中，宇航员可以怎样？）

options.text: A. walk as on Earth（像在地球上一样走路）
B. eat nothing because it is dangerous（因危险而什么也不吃）
C. control the ship while sleeping（睡觉时控制飞船）
D. not litter small things, or they may cause trouble（不可让小东西散落，否则会惹麻烦）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:1.explanation: 定位 p123：散落的小东西可能堵住仪器，影响安全返航。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:2.stem: How is space food packed?（太空食品如何包装？）

options.text: A. Tiny food pieces are put on the floor（小食物碎片放地板上）
B. Some food is put into tubes（部分食物装入管中）
C. Bite-sized cookies are packed in plastic（一口大小的饼干用塑料包装）
D. Both B and C（B、C 两项）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:2.explanation: 定位 p124：食物既有管装，也有塑料包装的一口饼干。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:3.stem: Why does an astronaut put his hands under the belt while sleeping?（宇航员睡觉时为什么把手放在带子下？）

options.text: A. It is comfortable（这样舒服）
B. He does not want to touch controls（不想误碰控制装置）
C. Instruments break easily（仪器容易损坏）
D. He fears the seat will move（害怕座位移动）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:3.explanation: 定位 p125：把手压在带下是为防止误碰控制装置。

zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:4.stem: What is the best title?（最佳标题是什么？）

options.text: A. Eating and Sleeping in Space（太空中的吃与睡）
B. How Astronauts Eat in Space（宇航员怎样在太空进食）
C. Food for Space（太空食品）
D. How Astronauts Sleep in Space（宇航员怎样在太空睡觉）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p25:4.explanation: 文章同时介绍太空中的食品包装与睡眠固定方式。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:0.stem:
It is so dark. I can’t find out ______ it’s a boy ______ a girl.
（天太黑了。我分辨不出这是男孩还是女孩。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:0.explanation: whether…or… 是「是……还是……」的固定搭配。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:1.stem:
Could you tell me if he ______ to Shanghai?
（你能告诉我他是否已经去上海了吗？）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:1.explanation: has gone to 表示「已经去了某地，目前尚未回来」。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:2.stem:
He told me ______ she would catch the early bus.
（他告诉我她会赶早班车。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:2.explanation: 从句成分完整且表达陈述事实，用连接词 that。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:3.stem:
Mrs. Green asked me ______ I would go with her.
（格林太太问她为什么要和她一起去。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:3.explanation: 选项中只有 why 能在从句中作原因状语。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:4.stem:
I don’t know ______ the coat ______ cheap enough.
（我不知道这件外套是否足够便宜。）
