zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:4.explanation: if 表示「是否」；主语 the coat 为单数，系动词用 is。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:5.stem:
—Linda, could you tell me something about Mo Yan?
—Sure. He is the writer ______ won the Nobel Literature Prize.
（他就是获得诺贝尔文学奖的作家。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p1:5.explanation: 先行词 the writer 指人，关系词在从句中作主语，用 who。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:0.stem:
These children are ______ this year than they were last year.
（这些孩子今年比去年高。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:0.explanation: 比较级 taller 可由 much 修饰，不能再用 more。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:1.stem:
The experiment was ______ easier than we had expected.
（这项实验比我们预想的容易得多。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:1.explanation: much 直接修饰比较级 easier。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:2.stem:
If there were no examinations, we should have ______ at school.
（如果没有考试，我们在学校会过得快乐得多。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:2.explanation: a much happier time 中，much 修饰比较级 happier。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:3.stem:
This book is ______ that one, but ______ than that one.
（这本书和那本书一样难，但比那本书更贵。）

options.text: B. as more difficult as; more expensive
C. as difficult as; more expensive
D. more difficult as; as expensive

zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:3.explanation: 同级比较用 as difficult as；第二空根据 than 用比较级 more expensive。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:4.stem:
When we arrived, we found the meeting room crowded with ______ students.
（我们到达时，发现会议室里挤满了相当多的学生。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:4.explanation: quite a few 表示「相当多的」。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:5.stem:
______ there by bike will take us half an hour.
（骑自行车到那里要花我们半个小时。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p2:5.explanation: 动名词短语 Getting there by bike 作主语。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:0.stem:
—Where is your father? I haven’t seen him for a long time.
—He ______ Shanghai on business. He will be back in a week.
zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:0.explanation: 人去了上海且尚未回来，用 has gone to。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:1.stem: My sister ______ the piano since she was five years old. Now she’s very good at it.
zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:1.explanation: since 引出的时间状语要求主句用现在完成时。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:2.stem:
—______ you ever ______ to the Great Wall?
—Yes, I have. I went there last year.
zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:2.explanation: have been to 表示「去过并已回来」。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:3.stem: I ______ my homework. I’m ready to go out and play football.
zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:3.explanation: 作业已经完成且结果影响现在，用现在完成时。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:4.stem: The famous writer ______ one new book in the past two years.
zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:4.explanation: in the past two years 常与现在完成时连用。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:5.stem:
—How long ______ you ______ this dictionary?
—For two years.
zsb-english:20:quiz-p3:5.explanation: for two years 要与延续性动词搭配，have had 表示「拥有了两年」。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:0.stem: Do you know the man ______ is standing over there?
zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:0.explanation: 先行词 the man 指人，关系词在从句中作主语，用 who。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:1.stem:
I will go to bed ______ I finish my homework.
（我一做完作业就去睡觉。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:1.explanation: as soon as 表示「一……就……」。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:2.stem:
Could you tell me ______ the nearest bank is?
（你能告诉我最近的银行在哪里吗？）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:2.explanation: 宾语从句表示地点，用 where。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:3.stem: The house ______ we bought last year is very big.
zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:3.explanation: 先行词 the house 指物，关系词在从句中作宾语，用 which。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:4.stem:
She didn’t realize her mistake ______ I told her.
（直到我告诉她，她才意识到自己的错误。）

zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:5.stem: I wonder ______ he will come to the party or not.
zsb-english:20:quiz-p4:5.explanation: 与 or not 连用时，用 whether 更规范。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:0.stem:
—______ has the 2018 World Cup been on?
—For about two weeks.
（2018 年世界杯已经举行多久了？——大约两周。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:0.explanation: for about two weeks 表示持续时长，用 How long 提问。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:1.stem:
—______ do you usually go to school, Mary?
—By bike.
（玛丽，你通常怎样去上学？——骑自行车。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:1.explanation: By bike 回答方式，用 How 提问。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:2.stem:
—______ do you like the Double Eleven Shopping Festival?
—I don’t like it because my mother often buys a lot of things we don’t need.
（你觉得「双十一」购物节怎么样？）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:2.explanation: How do you like ...? 意为「你觉得……怎么样？」，与答句的评价相呼应。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:3.stem:
Before you start reading, ask yourself ______ you are reading this book. Most people read for two main reasons, pleasure or knowledge.
（大多数人阅读有两个主要目的：获得乐趣或知识。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:3.explanation: 后句给出阅读的两个原因，宾语从句用 why。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:4.stem:
______ a clock on the desk. It wakes me up every day.
（桌上有一个钟，它每天把我叫醒。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:4.explanation: 单数主语 a clock 与 There is 搭配。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:5.stem:
—Jack is telling everyone he has bought a new car.
—Pay no attention to him. He is just ______.
（别理他，他只是在炫耀。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p5:5.explanation: show off 意为「炫耀」；take off 脱下／起飞，drive off 驾车离开，set off 出发／引爆。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:0.stem:
The headmaster wanted the new classroom building ______ as soon as possible.
（校长希望尽快把新教学楼建起来。）

options.text: C. to have been put up

zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:0.explanation: want + 宾语 + to do；building 与 put up 是被动关系，所以用 to be put up。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:1.stem:
At the shopping-center, he didn’t know what ______ and ______ with an empty bag.
（他不知道该买什么，最后空着袋子离开了。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:1.explanation: what to buy 是「疑问词 + 不定式」；第二空与主句谓语 didn’t know 并列叙述过去动作，用 left。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:2.stem:
The policeman put down the phone, ______ with a smile on his face.
（警察放下电话，脸上带着满意的微笑。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:2.explanation: satisfied 表示人的感受／状态，作伴随状语；此处意为「感到满意地」。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:3.stem:
______, your composition is full of mistakes.
（你的作文写得很粗心，因此满是错误。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:3.explanation: composition 与 write 是被动关系，用过去分词 Written carelessly 作条件／方式状语。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:4.stem:
She made a candle ______ us light.
（她做了一支蜡烛给我们照明。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:4.explanation: make + 宾语 + 动词原形，用 give 作宾补。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:5.stem:
The stranger you saw ______ with a big travelling-bag stayed in Room 104 yesterday.
（你看见的那个提着大旅行包进来的陌生人，昨天住在 104 房间。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p6:5.explanation: 主干是 The stranger ... stayed ...；you saw 和 who came in with ... 都修饰 stranger，后者需用关系代词 who 引导。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:0.stem:
The girl ______ long hair and wearing a red dress is my sister. She is very kind-hearted.
（那个留着长发、穿红裙子的女孩是我妹妹。她非常善良。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:0.explanation: with long hair 是介词短语作后置定语；句中已有谓语 is，不能再用 has。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:1.stem:
The novel ______ by the famous writer was published last year and soon became a best-seller.
（那位著名作家写的小说去年出版，很快成为畅销书。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:1.explanation: novel 与 write 为被动关系，用过去分词 written 作后置定语。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:2.stem:
I’d prefer to spend my holiday in the countryside ______ in a big city.
（我宁愿在乡村度假，而不愿在大城市。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:2.explanation: prefer to do A rather than do B 表示「宁愿做 A 而不做 B」。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:3.stem:
The house ______ we visited last week is very old but has a special charm.
（我们上周参观的房子很古老，却别具魅力。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:3.explanation: 定语从句缺宾语，先行词 house 指物，用 which。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:4.stem:
Most of the goods ______ at the market are from local factories and are of high quality.
（市场上出售的大多数商品来自当地工厂，而且质量很高。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:4.explanation: goods 与 sell 为被动关系，用过去分词 sold 作后置定语。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:5.stem:
He decided to work hard on his project ______ waste time on meaningless things.
（他决定努力做项目，而不是把时间浪费在无意义的事情上。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p7:5.explanation: 前后连接两个动词原形 work 与 waste，用 rather than。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:0.stem:
By the end of last week, they ______ the new project.
（到上周末，他们已经完成了新项目。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:0.explanation: by the end of last week 表示过去某时点之前已完成，用过去完成时。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:1.stem:
I ______ in the army for more than 5 years.
（我已经在军队里服役五年多了。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:1.explanation: for more than 5 years 且状态延续至今，用现在完成时。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:2.stem:
Our roof leaked yesterday, but my father managed ______.
（昨天屋顶漏水了，但父亲设法让人把它修好了。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:2.explanation: manage to do 与 get sth. done 结合为 manage to get it fixed。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:3.stem:
The poor children in the remote village are looking forward to ______ a big meal over the New Year.
（偏远村庄的贫困儿童期待着新年能得到一顿丰盛的饭。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:3.explanation: look forward to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词；孩子「被给予」饭食，用 being given。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:4.stem:
If you ______ the doctor’s orders last week, you ______ well now.
（如果你上周遵从了医嘱，现在身体就会好了。）

options.text: C. had followed; would have been

zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:4.explanation: 上周未遵医嘱是对过去的虚拟，用 had followed；结果影响现在，用 would be。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:5.stem:
If only you ______ him what I said! Everything would have been all right.
（要是你没有把我的话告诉他就好了！那样一切都会没事。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:5.explanation: 对过去的愿望用 if only + had done。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:6.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:6.stem:
I lost my key in the cinema ______ I watched this film.
（我在观看这部电影的那家电影院里丢了钥匙。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:6.explanation: 先行词 cinema 在从句中作地点状语，可用 in which。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:7.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:7.stem:
I saw a man shouting at a driver ______ car was blocking the street.
（我看见一个男人正冲一名司机叫喊，那名司机的车堵住了街道。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p8:7.explanation: whose car 表所属关系，whose 修饰 car。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:0.stem:
—I’m sure Andrew will win the first prize in the final.
—I think so. He ______ for it for months.
（我确信安德鲁会在决赛中获得一等奖。——我也这样认为，他已经为此准备好几个月了。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:0.explanation: for months 表示从过去持续到现在且仍在准备，用现在完成进行时。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:1.stem:
By the time he realizes he ______ into a trap, it’ll be too late for him to do anything about it.
（等他意识到自己已经走入陷阱时，再采取任何行动都太晚了。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:1.explanation: By the time 从句用一般现在时表将来；「意识到」时已经走入陷阱，用现在完成时。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:2.stem:
So far this year we ______ a fall in house prices by between 5 and 10 percent.
（今年到目前为止，我们已经看到房价下降了 5% 至 10%。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:2.explanation: so far this year 是现在完成时标志。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:3.stem:
Cathy is taking notes of the grammatical rules in class at Sunshine School, where she ______ English for a year.
（凯茜正在阳光学校的课堂上记语法规则；她已在那里学英语一年。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:3.explanation: for a year 表示学习延续至今，用现在完成进行时。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:4.stem:
Danny ______ hard for long to realize his dream and now he is popular.
（丹尼长期努力工作以实现梦想，如今他很受欢迎。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:4.explanation: 长期努力产生「如今很受欢迎」的结果，用现在完成时。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:5.stem:
The unemployment rate in this district ______ from 30% to 20% in the past two years.
（过去两年，这一地区的失业率从 30% 降至 20%。）（整理时已修正原题百分比的增减方向。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p9:5.explanation: in the past two years 与现在完成时搭配；失业率从 30% 降至 20%，所以选 has fallen。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:0.stem:
According to the schedule, the manager ______ the meeting at 8:00 next morning.
（按照日程，经理将在次日早上八点主持会议。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:0.explanation: 现在进行时可表示按计划安排的近期将来；according to the schedule 提示已安排。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:1.stem:
With so many beautiful dresses ______, the little girl didn’t know which one to buy.
（有这么多漂亮裙子可选，小女孩不知道该买哪一条。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:1.explanation: with + 名词 + to do 表示有待完成；裙子是供小女孩主动选择，保留介词 from。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:2.stem:
If you are walking away from a clock tower, you will hear the ticking of the clock fade to the point ______ it cannot be heard.
（如果你正远离钟楼，就会听见钟表滴答声逐渐减弱，直到无法听见的程度。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:2.explanation: 先行词 point 在定语从句中作抽象地点状语，用 where。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:3.stem:
He won’t go to sleep ______ you tell him a story.
（除非你给他讲故事，否则他不会睡觉。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:3.explanation: unless 表示「除非」，等于 if...not。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:4.stem:
It is reported ______ three people were badly injured in the traffic accident.
（据报道，三人在交通事故中受了重伤。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:4.explanation: It is reported that... 是固定主语从句句型。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:5.stem:
______ weight, those girls worked out every morning.
（为了减重，那些女孩每天早晨锻炼。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:5.explanation: 不定式置于句首作目的状语。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:6.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:6.stem:
Many a student ______ a walk on campus after dinner. But many students ______ computer games in the dormitory too.
（许多学生晚饭后会在校园散步，但也有许多学生在宿舍玩电脑游戏。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p10:6.explanation: many a + 单数名词 接单数谓语 takes；many + 复数名词 接复数谓语 play。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:0.stem:
The reason why he failed is ______ he was too careless.
（他失败的原因是他太粗心。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:0.explanation: The reason why... is that... 是固定结构，表语从句用 that。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:1.stem:
What I want to know is ______ he likes the gift given by us.
（我想知道的是，他是否喜欢我们送的礼物。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:1.explanation: 表语从句表示「是否」时用 whether，通常不用 if。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:2.stem:
The reason is ______ I missed the bus.
（原因是我错过了公共汽车。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:2.explanation: The reason is that... 用 that 引导表语从句。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:3.stem:
That is ______ we were late last time.
（那就是我们上次迟到的原因。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:3.explanation: That is why... 表示「那就是……的原因」。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:4.stem:
She looked ______ she were ten years younger.
（她看起来仿佛年轻了十岁。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:4.explanation: as though + 虚拟语气 表示「看起来仿佛……」。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:5.stem:
—I drove to Zhuhai for the air show last week.
—Is that ______ you had a few days off?
（——我上周开车去珠海看航展了。——那就是你请了几天假的原因吗？）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p11:5.explanation: 根据问句语义，询问「那是否是你请假的原因」，用 why。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:0.stem:
Not until I began to work ______ how much time I had wasted.
（直到开始工作，我才意识到自己浪费了多少时间。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:0.explanation: Not until 置于句首时，主句部分倒装；过去时用 did I realize。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:1.stem:
______ can you expect to get a pay rise.
（只有努力工作，你才有望加薪。）

options.text: D. Now that he works hard

zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:1.explanation: Only + 状语 置于句首，主句部分倒装，故 Only with hard work can you...。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:2.stem:
So carelessly ______ that he almost killed himself.
（他开车如此粗心，差点害死自己。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:2.explanation: So + 副词 置于句首，主句部分倒装；killed 提示过去时，用 did he drive。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:3.stem:
The number of people invited ______ fifty, but a number of them ______ absent for different reasons.
（受邀人数是五十人，但其中许多人因不同原因缺席。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:3.explanation: the number of + 复数名词 作主语时谓语单数；a number of + 复数名词 作主语时谓语复数。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:4.stem:
Each of the students, working hard at his or her lessons, ______ to go to university.
（每个努力学习的学生都希望上大学。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:4.explanation: 中心主语 Each 为单数，谓语用 hopes。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:5.stem:
A library with five thousand books ______ to the nation as a gift.
（一座藏有五千本书的图书馆被作为礼物赠予国家。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p12:5.explanation: 中心主语 A library 为单数，且与 offer 为被动关系，用 is offered。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:0.stem:
The conference ______ a full week by the time it ends.
（到会议结束时，它将已经持续整整一周。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:0.explanation: by the time + 一般现在时 表示将来截止点，主句用将来完成时。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:1.stem:
British people often avoid ______ to strangers until they have been introduced.
（英国人通常在经人介绍前避免与陌生人交谈。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:1.explanation: avoid doing sth. 表示「避免做某事」。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:2.stem:
At the time of economic crisis, he could only earn a ______ of $2,000 per month.
（经济危机时期，他每月只能挣 2,000 美元薪水。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:2.explanation: 按月支付的固定薪酬用 salary；fee 指服务费，wage 多指按时/日/周计酬。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:3.stem:
Oil is an important ______ material which can be processed into many different products.
（石油是一种重要原材料，可加工成许多不同产品。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:3.explanation: raw material 是固定搭配，意为「原材料」。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:4.stem:
Europe’s earlier industrial growth was ______ by the availability of key resources, abundant and cheap labor, coal, iron, ore, etc.
（欧洲早期工业增长得益于关键资源的可获得性，以及充足廉价的劳动力、煤、铁矿石等。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:4.explanation: sustain 表示「维持、支撑」，与工业增长及资源条件搭配。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:5.stem:
The book tells us about the author’s life ______ about his writings.
（这本书既讲述作者的生平，也讲述他的作品。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p13:5.explanation: as well as 连接 about his life 与 about his writings，表示「以及」。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:0.stem:
—Why, she is absent again!
—She was ______ badly in an accident.
（——咦，她又缺席了！——她在事故中受了重伤。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:0.explanation: 人在事故中「受伤」用 be injured。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:1.stem:
The book tells us about the author’s life ______ about his writings.
（这本书既讲作者生平，也讲他的作品。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:1.explanation: as well as 连接两个 about 短语。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:2.stem:
The old man ______ since he came into the hospital.
（这位老人入院以来一直受到悉心照顾。）

options.text: A. has taken good care of
B. has been taken good care of
D. has been taken good care

zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:2.explanation: take good care of 变被动时介词 of 不能丢，用现在完成时被动语态。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:3.stem:
If the little boy had been given the best medical care, he ______.
（如果那个小男孩得到最好的医疗救治，他就不会死。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:3.explanation: 从句 had been given 是对过去的虚拟，主句用 would have done。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:4.stem:
If he ______ me tomorrow, I would let him know.
（如果他明天真给我打电话，我会告诉他。）

options.text: B. should not have been called

zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:4.explanation: 对将来可能性较小的虚拟条件可用 if + 主语 + should do。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:5.stem:
If you asked your father, you ______ permission.
（如果你问父亲，也许会得到允许。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p14:5.explanation: asked 表示与现在事实相反，主句用 might get。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:0.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:0.stem:
The fact ______ he failed the exam again worried his parents.
（他又一次考试不及格这一事实使父母担忧。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:0.explanation: that 引导同位语从句，说明 the fact 的具体内容。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:1.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:1.stem:
I wonder ______ he will agree to this plan or not.
（我想知道他是否会同意这个计划。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:1.explanation: 与 or not 搭配时用 whether。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:2.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:2.stem:
______ he is young, he knows a lot about science.
（尽管他年轻，却很懂科学。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:2.explanation: 前后为让步关系，用 Although；As 表让步时需倒装为 Young as he is。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:3.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:3.stem:
Could you tell me ______ the nearest hospital is?
（你能告诉我最近的医院在哪里吗？）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:3.explanation: 宾语从句缺地点状语，用 where，并保持陈述语序。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:4.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:4.stem:
We have no idea ______ the problem can be solved in such a short time.
（我们不知道如何能在这么短的时间内解决问题。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:4.explanation: 从句结构完整但缺方式状语，用 how。

zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:5.title: 篇章阅读 Passage Reading
zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:5.stem:
______ hard it may be, I’ll carry it out.
（无论多困难，我都会完成它。）
zsb-english:20:quiz-p15:5.explanation: However + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语 表示「无论多么……」。

zsb-english:21:quiz-p1:0.title: 五选五 Five-blank Restoration
zsb-english:21:quiz-p1:0.stem: 【五选五】第 1 空：应填回原文的哪一句？

options.text: A. A little time planning ahead can save a lot of work later on.
B. Let cooking and living simply be a joy rather than a burden.
C. Make three or four instead.

zsb-english:21:quiz-p1:0.explanation: 前文列 ability、money、time 三种原因，后文先说钱留待以后，再谈时间，故先处理「能力容易提高」（Ability is easily improved）。

zsb-english:21:quiz-p1:1.title: 五选五 Five-blank Restoration
zsb-english:21:quiz-p1:1.stem: 【五选五】第 2 空：应填回原文的哪一句？

options.text: A. A little time planning ahead can save a lot of work later on.
B. Let cooking and living simply be a joy rather than a burden.
C. Make three or four instead.

zsb-english:21:quiz-p1:1.explanation: 承接 Think ahead，说明提前规划的收益（A little time planning ahead can save a lot of work later on）。

zsb-english:21:quiz-p1:2.title: 五选五 Five-blank Restoration
zsb-english:21:quiz-p1:2.stem: 【五选五】第 3 空：应填回原文的哪一句？

options.text: A. A little time planning ahead can save a lot of work later on.

zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:1.stem: 【练习二 · 无提示词】In the survey, 68 percent ____ the students said that their parents were at work in the school holidays.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：... percent of + 名词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:2.stem: 【练习二 · 提示词 say】73 percent ____ that they were bored during the school holidays and 35 percent said they were happy to go back to school!
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：调查发生在过去，与前文 did 一致。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:3.stem: 【练习二 · 提示词 go】...and 35 percent said they were happy to ____ back to school!
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：be happy to do sth.。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:4.stem: 【练习二 · 提示词 want】The results of the survey show that not everybody ____ to have many holidays.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：不定代词 everybody 作主语，谓语用第三人称单数。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:5.stem: 【练习二 · 提示词 interest】If you don’t want to stay at home and get bored, take part in some ____ activities.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：修饰事物 activities，表示「有趣的」。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:6.stem: 【练习二 · 提示词 especial】A lot of schools organize various trips during the holidays, ____ when they have a one-week holiday.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：副词强调后面的时间状语从句。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:7.stem: 【练习二 · 提示词 school】Many ____ take groups of students to some training centers.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：many 后接可数名词复数。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:8.stem: 【练习二 · 无提示词】____ example, students learn how to make a camp in the forest.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：固定搭配 for example，位于句首首字母大写。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:9.stem: 【练习二 · 提示词 teach】At the same time, they are ____ how to find their way back to the centre.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p2:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：学生「被教」，与 are 构成被动语态。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:0.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:0.stem: 【练习三 · 提示词 go】My relationship with my mother changed after I ____ to college.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：主句 changed 提示一般过去时。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:1.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:1.stem: 【练习三 · 提示词 talk】When I was at home, we argued about many things, for example, wearing makeup and ____ on the phone.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：与 wearing makeup 并列作 about 的宾语，用动名词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:2.stem: 【练习三 · 提示词 leave】One time, before a big party, she refused to let me ____ the house.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：let sb. do sth.。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:3.stem: 【练习三 · 提示词 I】She thought ____ makeup was too heavy.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：形容词性物主代词修饰 makeup。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:4.stem: 【练习三 · 无提示词】I was the only girl ____ makeup, and I was so mad.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：根据「不得不洗脸」和「很生气」可知，她是唯一没化妆的女孩。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:5.stem: 【练习三 · 提示词 behave】Her ____ always made me upset.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：形容词性物主代词 Her 后接名词（behavior/behaviour 均可）。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:6.stem: 【练习三 · 提示词 me】But after a few months at college, I changed ____ completely.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：主语和宾语同指一人，用反身代词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:7.stem: 【练习三 · 提示词 patient】I didn’t have the time or ____ for long phone conversations.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：与 time 并列作 have 的宾语，用名词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:8.stem: 【练习三 · 提示词 care】I stopped ____ so much about things like makeup.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：stop doing sth. 表示停止做某事。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:9.stem: 【练习三 · 提示词 close】My new way of thinking brought me ____ to my mother than before.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p3:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：than before 提示比较级。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:0.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:0.stem: 【练习四 · 无提示词】A survey of English schoolchildren shows boys and girls are worrying ____ the way they look.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：固定搭配 worry about。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:1.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:1.stem: 【练习四 · 提示词 lack】The study found that over half of male schoolchildren ____ confidence because of their body shape.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：调查结果发生在过去，与 found 一致。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:2.stem: 【练习四 · 无提示词】The study found that over half of male schoolchildren lacked confidence ____ their body shape.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：固定搭配 because of + 名词；because 后接从句。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:3.stem: 【练习四 · 提示词 question】Researchers ____ 693 teachers about how their students felt about their bodies.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：调查行为发生在过去。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:4.stem: 【练习四 · 提示词 anger】Teachers said many children were very ____ if others said bad things about their appearances.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：系动词 were 后用形容词作表语。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:5.stem: 【练习四 · 提示词 extreme】Around 55 percent of teachers reported that girls were ____ sensitive to comments about their looks.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：副词修饰形容词 sensitive。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:6.stem: 【练习四 · 提示词 reason】Teachers gave a number of ____ why children as young as four years old were stressing out about their shapes.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：a number of 后接可数名词复数。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:7.stem: 【练习四 · 提示词 attract】Many children are on diets to make themselves ____ to the opposite sex.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：make + 宾语 + 形容词 结构。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:8.stem: 【练习四 · 提示词 I】“I work with four- to five-year-olds and some say things like, ‘I can’t eat cheese; it will make ____ fat.’”
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：人称代词宾格作 make 的宾语。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:9.stem: 【练习四 · 提示词 try】A teachers’ spokeswoman warned that children ____ to look like “celebrities in the media only lead to misery”.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p4:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：现在分词短语修饰 children；主干为 children...lead to misery。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:0.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:0.stem: 【练习五 · 无提示词】Today I’m going to talk about rainforests. Are you familiar ____ them?
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：固定搭配 be familiar with。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:1.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:1.stem: 【练习五 · 提示词 excite】They’re interesting and ____ places!
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：修饰事物 places，表示「令人兴奋的」。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:2.stem: 【练习五 · 提示词 be】However, rainforests ____ in trouble now — they are disappearing very fast because they are cut down or burnt every day.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：主语 rainforests 为复数，且 now 表示当前状态。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:3.stem: 【练习五 · 无提示词】____ a result, various animals and plants are dying out.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：固定搭配 as a result，位于句首首字母大写。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:4.stem: 【练习五 · 提示词 protect】Maybe you have never been to a rainforest, so why should you ____ them with care?
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：情态动词 should 后接动词原形。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:5.stem: 【练习五 · 提示词 importance】Rainforests are ____ to everyone because the plants in the rainforests make oxygen.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：系动词 are 后用形容词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:6.stem: 【练习五 · 提示词 hot】When trees are cut down, it gets ____ than before.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：than before 提示比较级，hot 双写 t。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:7.stem: 【练习五 · 提示词 find】Many of these plants can be ____ only in rainforests.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：与 can be 构成被动语态。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:8.stem: 【练习五 · 无提示词】In my opinion, our future depends ____ saving the rainforests.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：固定搭配 depend on doing sth.。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:9.stem: 【练习五 · 提示词 act】We must take ____ to protect the rainforests now.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p5:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：固定搭配 take action to do sth.。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:0.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:0.stem: 【练习六 · 无提示词】The scientist was in ____ hurry.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：固定搭配 in a hurry。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:1.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:1.stem: 【练习六 · 提示词 dark】She had to get some water for her experiment before ____ fell.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：从句缺主语，名词 darkness 表示「黑暗降临」。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:2.stem: 【练习六 · 提示词 pollute】Her job was to find out the cause of ____ in the sea at nearby beaches.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：介词 of 后用名词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:3.stem: 【练习六 · 提示词 angry】She lifted out the water and looked ____ at the rubbish in it.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：副词修饰动词 looked，表示生气地看。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:4.stem: 【练习六 · 提示词 be】Old clothes, plastic bags and pieces of paper ____ in the dirty water.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：并列复数主语，叙述过去场景。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:5.stem: 【练习六 · 无提示词】She worried ____ the ocean animals as she walked back to the beach.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：固定搭配 worry about。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:6.stem: 【练习六 · 提示词 clean】They had spent their afternoon ____ the beach!
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：固定搭配 spend time doing sth.。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:7.stem: 【练习六 · 提示词 speak】As she ____ with the teacher, the students gathered around them.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：as 表示两个过去动作同时进行，持续动作使用过去进行时。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:8.stem: 【练习六 · 提示词 exact】“That’s ____ right,” agreed the scientist, as she smiled at their kindness.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：副词修饰形容词 right。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:9.stem: 【练习六 · 提示词 kind】“That’s exactly right,” agreed the scientist, as she smiled at their ____.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p6:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：物主代词 their 后用名词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:0.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:0.stem: 【练习七 · 提示词 healthy】Not taking a proper lunch break is ____.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：根据下文「使人生病」可知需要否定意义。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:1.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:1.stem: 【练习七 · 提示词 made】It can ____ people sick, so then they need time off work.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：情态动词 can 后接动词原形。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:2.stem: 【练习七 · 无提示词】It interviewed over 2,000 people about ____ they do for lunch at work.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：what 引导宾语从句并在从句中作 do 的宾语；that 引导宾语从句时不作成分。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:3.stem: 【练习七 · 提示词 surf】Half of the people took a break but ate their lunch at their desk and ____ the Internet, answered e-mails or went on Facebook.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：与 ate, answered, went 并列，使用一般过去时。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:4.stem: 【练习七 · 无提示词】One in five people left the workplace ____ lunch to go shopping or get some air, while three percent went to the gym.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：for lunch 表示为了吃午饭。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:5.stem: 【练习七 · 提示词 regulate】The CSP told companies they should encourage all staff to take a ____ lunch break.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：形容词修饰 lunch break。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:6.stem: 【练习七 · 提示词 work】“Full-time ____ spend a significant bulk of their week at work or travelling to and from it.”
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：作主语并与复数谓语 spend 一致，用名词复数。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:7.stem: 【练习七 · 提示词 travel】“Full-time workers spend a significant bulk of their week at work or ____ to and from it.”
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：与 at work 并列，介词语境下用动名词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:8.stem: 【练习七 · 提示词 warn】She ____ that when employees get sick because they do not take breaks, companies lose money.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：叙述研究发言，用一般过去时。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:9.stem: 【练习七 · 提示词 take】“...we would encourage people ____ responsibility for their own health.”
zsb-english:23:quiz-p7:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：固定搭配 encourage sb. to do sth.。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:0.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:0.stem: 【练习八 · 提示词 fish】Nowadays more and more people prefer to go ____ or hiking in the woods.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：固定搭配 go fishing，并与 hiking 并列。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:1.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:1.stem: 【练习八 · 提示词 you】Experiencing nature is exciting, but when you’re doing this, always keep ____ safe.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：keep oneself safe，与主语 you 呼应。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:2.stem: 【练习八 · 提示词 base】It’s important to remember several ____ rules if you don’t want to turn a pleasant outing into a disaster.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：形容词修饰 rules。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:3.stem: 【练习八 · 提示词 especial】This is ____ true in the situation of travelling in the mountain areas.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：副词修饰形容词 true。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:4.stem: 【练习八 · 提示词 travel】This is especially true in the situation of ____ in the mountain areas.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：介词 of 后接动名词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:5.stem: 【练习八 · 提示词 change】The weather is really ____ in high mountains.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：系动词 is 后用形容词，表示天气多变。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:6.stem: 【练习八 · 提示词 experience】Sometimes you can ____ two or three seasons in one day.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：情态动词 can 后接原形。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:7.stem: 【练习八 · 无提示词】Before you start your trip, study the map to get familiar ____ the area you are going to.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：固定搭配 be/get familiar with。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:8.stem: 【练习八 · 提示词 probable】Many trips that start out in daylight will ____ become nighttime adventures when people can’t find their way.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：副词修饰动词 become。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:9.stem: 【练习八 · 提示词 be】Small cuts can be more serious when there ____ no doctor nearby.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p8:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：there be 的主语是单数 no doctor。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:0.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:0.stem: 【练习九 · 无提示词】...what we didn’t know, until now, is that running too much could be ____ for us.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：与前文 good 形成转折，并与「缩短寿命」一致。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:1.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:1.stem: 【练习九 · 提示词 regular】New research suggests that running long distances ____ for many years could shorten our life instead of extending it.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：副词修饰 running。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:2.stem: 【练习九 · 提示词 extend】New research suggests that running long distances regularly for many years could shorten our life instead of ____ it.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：instead of 后接动名词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:3.stem: 【练习九 · 无提示词】This can lead ____ heart disease.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：固定搭配 lead to。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:4.stem: 【练习九 · 提示词 active】“...your risk of heart disease, of dying of coronary disease, is the same as an ____ person.”
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：过量运动者的风险与不运动者相同，需要否定前缀。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:5.stem: 【练习九 · 提示词 look】The researchers ____ at the health and training of 3,300 runners over the age of 35.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：研究发生在过去。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:6.stem: 【练习九 · 无提示词】The study found that men ____ were marathon runners for 25 years had 62 percent more plaque in their heart than men of the same age who did little or no exercise.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：限制性定语从句，先行词 men 指人，关系词作主语。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:7.stem: 【练习九 · 提示词 run】He has been ____ marathons and doing triathlons since 1967.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：与 has been 构成现在完成进行时，并与 doing 并列。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:8.stem: 【练习九 · 无提示词】He has been running marathons and doing triathlons ____ 1967.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：since + 过去时间点与完成时连用。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:9.stem: 【练习九 · 无提示词】“I thought I was out there exhausting myself, building ____ absolutely indestructible heart.”
zsb-english:23:quiz-p9:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：heart 为可数名词单数，absolutely 以元音音素开头。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:0.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:0.stem: 【练习十 · 无提示词】In particular, it increases the risk ____ several cancers, diabetes, mental illnesses, and various heart diseases.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：固定搭配 the risk of。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:1.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:1.stem: 【练习十 · 提示词 variety】...it increases the risk of several cancers, diabetes, mental illnesses, and ____ heart diseases.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：形容词修饰复数名词 heart diseases。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:2.stem: 【练习十 · 提示词 discover】Researchers from the Sleep Research Centre at the U.K.’s University of Surrey ____ that many genes in the body needed to follow a regular 24-hour cycle, during which the body sleeps at night.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：研究结论是过去发现的，与报道语境一致。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:3.stem: 【练习十 · 无提示词】____ this cycle is broken, up to 1,500 genes could get damaged, eventually resulting in potentially life-threatening diseases.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：引导条件状语从句，表示这一周期一旦被打破就可能产生后果。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:4.stem: 【练习十 · 提示词 implication】“The study has important ____ because we now need to discover why these rhythms exist and think about the consequences of that.”
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：implication 为可数名词，语境指多方面影响。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:5.stem: 【练习十 · 提示词 causes】This can ____ parts of the immune system to become less efficient, making us more susceptible to illnesses.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：情态动词 can 后用原形。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:6.stem: 【练习十 · 提示词 make】This can cause parts of the immune system to become less efficient, ____ us more susceptible to illnesses.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：现在分词作结果状语。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:7.stem: 【练习十 · 无提示词】“Over 97 percent of rhythmic genes become out-of-sync with mistimed sleep, ____ really explains why we feel so bad during jet lag or if we have to work irregular shifts.”
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：非限制性定语从句，指代前面整件事。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:8.stem: 【练习十 · 无提示词】Dr. Dijk said that despite the results of the research, it would be difficult ____ people to change their lifestyles.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：固定结构 It is difficult for sb. to do sth.。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:9.stem: 【练习十 · 提示词 explain】He ____ it was difficult for society to function without people working night shifts, but said people needed to understand the dangers and “mitigate the impact”.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p10:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：与前文 said 一致，用一般过去时。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:0.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:0.stem: 【练习十一 · 提示词 include】Everything went black! All the lights in our flat turned off, ____ the TV.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：介词 including 表示「包括」。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:1.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:1.stem: 【练习十一 · 提示词 take】Mum ____ out the candles and Dad went to see what was going on.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：与后面的 went 并列，使用一般过去时。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:2.stem: 【练习十一 · 无提示词】So I went to our next-door neighbor, Mr. Smith, ____ lived just next to us.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：非限制性定语从句，先行词 Mr. Smith 指人，关系词作主语；that 不能用于逗号后的非限制性定语从句。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:3.stem: 【练习十一 · 提示词 happen】I hoped he could offer some help, for it was dark everywhere and we had no idea what had ____.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：与 had 构成过去完成时。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:4.stem: 【练习十一 · 提示词 gentle】I knocked at his door ____, wondering whether he was at home.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：副词修饰 knocked。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:5.stem: 【练习十一 · 提示词 chat】Our neighbors went downstairs and began ____ outside.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：begin doing sth. 表示开始做某事。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:6.stem: 【练习十一 · 提示词 worry】They were not ____ at all.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：系动词后用形容词，表示人的感受。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:7.stem: 【练习十一 · 提示词 frighten】Then we heard a ____ sound after a bright flash of lightning.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：修饰事物 sound，表示「令人害怕的」。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:8.stem: 【练习十一 · 提示词 make】The weatherman said the storm caused all the problems: it hit a power station tower before the first lightning, ____ the lights go out suddenly before the rain.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：现在分词作结果状语。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:9.stem: 【练习十一 · 无提示词】The event made ____ possible for the neighbors to have a chance to be together.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p11:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：make it possible for sb. to do sth.，it 作形式宾语。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:0.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:0.stem: 【练习十二 · 提示词 important】Technology has great ____ in our daily life now.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：has 后缺名词作宾语。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:1.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:1.stem: 【练习十二 · 提示词 we】Yet not many of ____ will realize how much we rely on it until we compare our lives with those in the past.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：介词 of 后用人称代词宾格。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:2.stem: 【练习十二 · 提示词 be】There was no modern technology at that time, yet the items that people had ____ quite enough for them to live their lives.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：主语 the items 为复数，叙述过去。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:3.stem: 【练习十二 · 提示词 nice】Without necessary cooking tools, the people could still manage to make their food as ____ as our food today.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：as + 形容词原级 + as。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:4.stem: 【练习十二 · 提示词 Other】Animal parts were thrown away if they were not delicious. ____ were cooked over the fire.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：some...others... 表示「一些……另一些……」，位于句首首字母大写。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:5.stem: 【练习十二 · 提示词 take】However, everything they used was ____ from the forests around them.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：与 was 构成被动语态。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:6.stem: 【练习十二 · 提示词 some】Without the television set, the radio and the computer, we will seldom have ____ fun in our homes today.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：否定语境 seldom 中使用 any。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:7.stem: 【练习十二 · 提示词 them】However, the people in the past had their own clever methods of enjoying ____.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：固定搭配 enjoy oneself。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:8.stem: 【练习十二 · 提示词 make】For example, they made music without the use of computers but with tools ____ from wood and animal skin.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：过去分词作后置定语，工具由木头和兽皮制成。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:9.stem: 【练习十二 · 提示词 wise】We should not look down on the ____ of people long ago.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p12:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：冠词 the 后用名词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:0.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:0.stem: 【练习十三 · 提示词 it】A school had major problems with some of ____ buildings.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：形容词性物主代词修饰 buildings。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:1.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:1.stem: 【练习十三 · 无提示词】Susan, the head teacher, invited students to share their ideas about ____ to rebuild the school.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：how to do 表示「如何做」，作 about 的宾语。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:2.stem: 【练习十三 · 提示词 want】“We ____ our students to decide what kind of school buildings they like.”
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：引语内容叙述当时的愿望，并与下一句 wanted 一致。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:3.stem: 【练习十三 · 提示词 express】“We wanted them to think of ideas ____ their own interests and hopes,” she said.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：不定式作目的状语，说明提出想法的目的。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:4.stem: 【练习十三 · 提示词 wide】The news spread ____ after it was reported in a local newspaper.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：副词修饰 spread。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:5.stem: 【练习十三 · 无提示词】The news spread widely after it was reported ____ a local newspaper.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：in a newspaper 表示刊登在报纸上。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:6.stem: 【练习十三 · 提示词 excite】Students certainly seemed very ____.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：描述学生的感受，用 -ed 形容词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:7.stem: 【练习十三 · 提示词 locate】In the beginning, the school was asked to close and the buildings would have to be sold off, as the school is in a very good ____.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：形容词 good 后接名词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:8.stem: 【练习十三 · 无提示词】“This school is ____ important part of the community and it’s necessary that it should continue,” said one parent.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：part 为可数名词单数，important 以元音音素开头。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:9.stem: 【练习十三 · 提示词 succeed】“I really think the school will develop with ____.”
zsb-english:23:quiz-p13:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：介词 with 后用名词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:0.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:0.stem: 【练习十四 · 无提示词】I’ve been back at school ____ nearly four weeks.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：for + 时间段与现在完成时连用。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:1.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:1.stem: 【练习十四 · 无提示词】I’m very glad to tell you ____ great changes have taken place in our school this term.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：tell you that...，that 引导宾语从句且不作成分。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:2.stem: 【练习十四 · 提示词 ask】First of all, we’re ____ to “clear our plates” when having our meals and say no to wasting.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：学生「被要求」，与 are 构成被动语态。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:3.stem: 【练习十四 · 提示词 use】Some of us ____ to order more than what we could eat.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：固定结构 used to do sth.。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:4.stem: 【练习十四 · 提示词 waste】We should also stop ____ in some other ways.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：stop doing sth. 表示停止浪费。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:5.stem: 【练习十四 · 无提示词】For example, we should turn off the lights ____ we leave the classroom.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：when 引导时间状语从句，表示离开教室时关灯。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:6.stem: 【练习十四 · 无提示词】And our school has opened up some fields for us to learn how ____ grow vegetables.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：how to grow vegetables 是「疑问词 + 不定式」。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:7.stem: 【练习十四 · 提示词 tomato】Each class is given a small garden and our class has decided to grow some ____ and beans in our free time.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：some 后接可数名词复数；tomato 加 -es。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:8.stem: 【练习十四 · 提示词 we】Maybe I’ll be able to post you some beans we’ve grown by ____ next time!
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：固定搭配 by oneself，主语为 we。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:9.stem: 【练习十四 · 提示词 much】What’s more, we have only two classes in the afternoon so we have ____ time for after-school activities than before.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p14:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：than before 提示比较级。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:0.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:0.stem: 【练习十五 · 无提示词】I was in ____ most beautiful city in the world, yet I only wanted home.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为无提示词填空）：最高级 most beautiful 前用定冠词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:1.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:1.stem: 【练习十五 · 提示词 will】Months ago, when my husband told me that he ____ have a meeting in London, I expressed my wish to go to Europe together with him.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：主句为过去时，过去将来时用 would。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:2.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:2.stem: 【练习十五 · 提示词 child】Then we asked his mother to look after our two ____ and started off.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：two 后接可数名词复数，child 的复数是不规则形式。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:3.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:3.stem: 【练习十五 · 提示词 can】During the week’s time, we visited London and Paris — as much as we ____: Big Ben, the Louvre and so on.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：叙述过去一周内尽可能多地游览，用 can 的过去式。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:4.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:4.stem: 【练习十五 · 提示词 worry】His mother answered the phone. In a second, my husband’s face fell and he looked so ____.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：looked 为系动词，形容人的担忧感受。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:5.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:5.stem: 【练习十五 · 提示词 have】A few minutes later, he said sadly to me that Tony, our seven-year-old son, ____ fallen off his bike and broken his leg.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：与 fallen 构成过去完成时；摔倒发生在「他说」之前。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:6.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:6.stem: 【练习十五 · 提示词 sudden】At that moment, Paris ____ lost its charm.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：副词修饰 lost。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:7.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:7.stem: 【练习十五 · 提示词 see】____ our two children, I suddenly realized the truth: there is no sweeter sight in the world than your children’s faces that greet you at home.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：现在分词作时间状语，逻辑主语是 I，与 see 为主动关系。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:8.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:8.stem: 【练习十五 · 提示词 true】Seeing our two children, I suddenly realized the ____: there is no sweeter sight in the world than your children’s faces that greet you at home.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：定冠词 the 后用名词。

zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:9.title: 语法填空 Grammar Filling
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:9.stem: 【练习十五 · 提示词 sweet】Seeing our two children, I suddenly realized the truth: there is no ____ sight in the world than your children’s faces that greet you at home.
zsb-english:23:quiz-p15:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（原题为有提示词填空）：than 提示比较级；「否定词 + 比较级」表达最高级含义。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:0.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:0.stem: 广东专升本英语写作的考情要求是？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（考情分析，教材上册 P230）：100 词应用文 15 分，以课件考情页为准。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:1.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:1.stem: 【2024 年广东真题】考的是哪类应用文？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（历年真题汇总）：2024 为邀请信（邀请 Mark 参加「我眼中的中国」征文比赛）；2025 通知、2023 求职信、2017 投诉信。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:2.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:2.stem: 【2025 广东真题】考的是哪类应用文？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（历年真题汇总）：2025 为通知（茶话会改期）；2021 电子邮件回信、2016 简历。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:3.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:3.stem: 称呼写给机构时，该用哪个？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（应用文结构说明）：写给机构用 Dear sir or madam, / To Whom It May Concern,；Dear Mr. Wang, / Dear Bob, / Dear Editors, 属于写给个人。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:4.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:4.stem: 正文第一段应该写什么？

options.text: A. 直接罗列题目要点
B. 第 1 句自我介绍或打招呼，第 2 句写作目的（信的中心思想）

zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（应用文结构说明）：第一段第 1 句自我介绍或打招呼，第 2 句写作目的；第二段叙事/观点；第三段总结＋期待回信。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:5.title: 作文 Writing

options.text: A. 信的右下角，结尾客套＋签名
B. 信的左下角，只写姓名
D. 标题下方，只写姓名

zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（应用文结构说明）：落款一般写在信的右下角——（1）结尾客套 Yours sincerely, / Yours truly, / Yours,（2）签名如 Li Hua。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:6.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:6.stem: 下面哪一组落款格式完全正确？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（三段式书信结构表）：Yours sincerely,（注意后面有逗号）＋ Li Ming（注意姓名后没有逗号）。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:7.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:7.stem: 下列哪一项不属于审题六要素？

options.text: C. 用何时态、限制多少词
D. 选什么颜色的笔、什么字体

zsb-english:24:quiz-p1:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（审题六要素）：谁写、写给谁、为何写、写什么、用何时态、限制多少词。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:0.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:0.stem: 第一段第一句「表明身份」的万能句是哪句？

options.text: A. I am writing to do sth.
B. I am president of the Students’ Union.
D. Listed below is the relevant information.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（万能展开 · 表明身份）：基本结构 I am ...；万能身份 I am president of the Students’ Union.（我是学生会主席）。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:1.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:1.stem: 第一段第二句「表明主题」常用哪个句型？

options.text: A. I am writing to do sth.（可抄题干，也可自行表达）
C. It is my great pleasure to offer you some advice.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（万能展开 · 表明主题）：I am writing to do sth. 我写信是为了做某事；或 I am writing the letter to you for the purpose of doing sth.。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:2.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:2.stem: 写建议信开头，该选哪句？

options.text: A. May I take this opportunity to express my heartfelt thanks to you?
B. It is my great pleasure to offer you some advice on ...
C. I am most reluctant to complain, but I must say that ...
D. I offer you my warmest congratulations on ...

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（标志词与参考句式）：建议的标志词 suggest，同义替换 advice / suggestion / proposal / opinion / idea。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:3.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:3.stem: 写感谢信开头，该选哪句？

options.text: A. I am sincerely grateful to you for your timely help.
B. I have to draw your attention to the problem of ...
C. I would like to apply for the vacancy of ...
D. Please accept my sincere apology that ...

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（标志词与参考句式）：感谢的标志词 thank，同义替换 thanks / gratitude / appreciation。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:4.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:4.stem: 写投诉信开头，该选哪句？

options.text: A. Here are some suggestions about ...
B. I take great pleasure in recommending to you ...
C. I am most reluctant to complain, but I must say that ＋ 投诉事由.
D. We hereby extend our cordial invitation to you to ...

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（标志词与参考句式）：投诉的标志词 complain，同义替换 complaint / dissatisfaction / indignation。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:5.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:5.stem: 写推荐信开头，该选哪句？

options.text: A. When it comes to ..., I shall, without any hesitation, recommend ...
B. I am indeed very sorry for ...
C. The letter is to inquire about the details of ...
D. I am really annoyed at doing ...

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（标志词与参考句式）：推荐的标志词 recommend，同义替换 recommendation / introduction / introduce。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:6.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:6.stem: 写邀请信开头，该选哪句？

options.text: A. I would like to apply for the vacancy of ...
B. May I take this opportunity to express my heartfelt thanks?
C. I am writing to express my regret that ...
D. May I have the honor to invite you to ...?

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（标志词与参考句式）：邀请的标志词 invite，同义替换 invitation；另有 On behalf of ..., I would like to invite you to ... 等。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:7.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:7.stem: 写道歉信开头，该选哪句？

options.text: A. I am indeed very sorry for ... / that ＋ 从句.
C. Please consider me for your advertised position of ...
D. It is my great pleasure to offer you some advice.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（标志词与参考句式）：道歉的标志词 apology，同义替换 regret / sorry。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:8.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:8.stem: 写求职信开头，该选哪句？

options.text: A. Thank you so much for your generous hospitality.
B. I would like to apply for the vacancy of ...
C. I would be most grateful if you could send me information.
D. I wish you success and fulfillment in the future.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（标志词与参考句式）：求职的标志词 apply for，同义替换 qualified / candidate / submit / application / want to。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:9.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:9.stem: 写询问信开头，该选哪句？

options.text: A. I am looking forward to seeing you.
B. I offer you my warmest congratulations on ...
C. I would like to know whether you could provide me with information regarding ...
D. I am sorry for causing you inconvenience.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p2:9.explanation: 笔记补充解析（标志词与参考句式）：询问的标志词 inquire，同义替换 ask for / wonder / inquiry。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:0.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:0.stem: 下面哪句是笔记给出的第二段段首句？

options.text: A. Of all the points / suggestions / details concerned, I’d like to name some significant ones as follows.
B. I am president of the Students’ Union.
C. Thank you for your listening.
D. Please accept my profound apologies once more.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（第二段段首句四选一）：另有 The following reasons / proposals / details are worth mentioning. / ... cannot be neglected. / Listed below is the relevant information.。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:1.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:1.stem: plus / in addition / additionally / furthermore / moreover 属于第二段过渡词的哪一类？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（段内过渡词）：其次类为 plus / in the second place / in addition / additionally / furthermore / moreover。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:2.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:2.stem: first and foremost / in the first place / to start with / to begin with 属于哪一类过渡词？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（段内过渡词）：首先类为 first and foremost / in the first place / to start with / to begin with。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:3.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:3.stem: finally / lastly / more importantly / last but not least 属于哪一类过渡词？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（段内过渡词）：最后类为 finally / lastly / more importantly / last but not least。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:4.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:4.stem: Which sentence follows 句型一「最高级价值」？

options.text: A. Exercise is conducive to relieving physical and mental stress.
B. It is generally recognized that nothing is more important than AI for saving our precious time and money.
C. Technology exerts positive influence on the development of economy.
D. I am writing to do sth.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（四大理由必备句型）：句型一为 It is generally recognized that nothing is more important than（主题词）for ...，主题词为名词性内容。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:5.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:5.stem: Which sentence follows 句型二「有助于」？

options.text: A. Participating in activities is conducive to the growth of individuals.
B. Nothing is more important than reading for acquiring useful experience.
C. The Internet exerts positive influence on efficient learning.
D. Cooperation consciousness tends to be of great importance.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（四大理由必备句型）：句型二为（主题词）contributes to / is conducive to / is responsible for ...，主题词为名词性内容。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:6.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:6.stem: Which sentence follows 句型三「产生影响」？

options.text: A. It is generally recognized that nothing is more important than reading.
B. Exercise is conducive to relieving stress.
C. The Internet exerts positive influence on efficient learning / studying.
D. Listed below is the relevant information.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（四大理由必备句型）：句型三为（主题词）exerts a / an positive / profound / far-reaching influence / effect / impact on ...。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:7.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:7.stem: 笔记的「四大万能理由」不包括下列哪组？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:7.explanation: 笔记补充解析（四大万能理由）：成长成功发展 / 知识阅历机会 / 效率便利时间 / 健康压力愉悦。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:8.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:8.stem: relieve / moderate physical and mental stress（缓解身心压力）属于四大理由的哪个角度？

options.text: A. 角度一：成长、成功、发展
B. 角度二：知识、阅历、机会
C. 角度三：效率、便利、时间
D. 角度四：健康、压力、愉悦

zsb-english:24:quiz-p3:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（角度四）：健康、压力、愉悦——pressure / stress / strain 表压力，relieve / moderate 表缓解。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:0.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:0.stem: 建议信的结尾该用哪句？

options.text: A. I am looking forward to seeing you.
B. I hope you will take my suggestions into account.
C. I am sorry for causing you inconvenience.
D. We wish to share your honor and joy.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:0.explanation: 笔记补充解析（不同类型书信的结尾）：建议信结尾另有 It is my earnest hope that my suggestions can be accepted. / I sincerely hope that these proposals are useful for your decision-making.。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:1.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:1.stem: 邀请信的结尾该用哪句？

options.text: A. It is my earnest hope that my suggestions can be accepted.
B. Please confirm your participation at your earliest convenience.
C. I hope you will forgive my mistake which I terribly regret.
D. Should you give me a trial, I would do my utmost.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:1.explanation: 笔记补充解析（不同类型书信的结尾）：邀请信结尾为 I am looking forward to seeing you. / Please confirm your participation at your earliest convenience. / We would appreciate it if you could honor us with your presence.。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:2.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:2.stem: 道歉信的结尾该用哪句？

options.text: A. Your prompt attention to this letter would be highly appreciated.
B. I wish you success and fulfillment in the future.
C. I am sorry for causing you inconvenience.
D. Please consider me for your advertised position.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:2.explanation: 笔记补充解析（不同类型书信的结尾）：道歉信结尾为 I am sorry for causing you inconvenience. / I hope you will forgive my mistake which I terribly regret. / I sincerely hope that you will be able to think in my position and accept my apology.。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:3.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:3.stem: 求职信的结尾该用哪句？

options.text: A. I am looking forward to your prompt reply.
B. We wish to share your honor and joy.
C. I shall be much obliged if you accord me an opportunity for an interview.
D. Please accept my sincere apology.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:3.explanation: 笔记补充解析（不同类型书信的结尾）：求职信结尾「如蒙给予面试机会，我将不胜感激」；另有 Should you give me a trial, I would do my utmost to make your decision worthwhile.。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:4.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:4.stem: 询问信（期待回信）的结尾该用哪句？

options.text: A. Your prompt attention to this letter would be highly appreciated.
B. I am sorry for causing you inconvenience.
C. All my best wishes for an even more prosperous future.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:4.explanation: 笔记补充解析（不同类型书信的结尾）：询问信结尾为 Your prompt attention to this letter would be highly appreciated. / I am looking forward to your prompt reply to this letter. / ... your due attention and quick response.。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:5.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:5.stem: 祝贺信的结尾该用哪句？

options.text: A. I have to draw your attention to the problem.
B. I shall be much obliged if you accord me an interview.
D. I wish you success and fulfillment in the future.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:5.explanation: 笔记补充解析（不同类型书信的结尾）：祝贺信结尾为 We wish to share your honor and joy. / I wish you success and fulfillment in the future. / All my best wishes for an even more prosperous future.。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:6.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:6.stem: 第三段「重申主题与寒暄」的套话是哪句？

options.text: A. Please accept my sincere gratitude to you for reading the content above. If you need to know more about it, please contact me.
B. It is generally recognized that nothing is more important.
C. I am most reluctant to complain.
D. May I have the honor to invite you?

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（第三段）：本段为非重点段落，只需重申主题；若有必要，配上一两句寒暄套话即可。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:7.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:7.stem: 改错：课件原句 “Classmates help me make up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.” 有搭配问题，改成哪句最规范？

options.text: A. Classmates help me make up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.
B. My classmates helped me make up for the missed lessons, that meant a great deal to me.
C. My classmates help making up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.
D. My classmates’ help in making up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:7.explanation: 原文语言点（笔记补充解析）：课件原句以 Classmates help me... 开头，存在所有格/动名词搭配问题；正式写作可改为 My classmates’ help in making up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:8.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:8.stem: 保持联系／祝好类结尾该用哪句？

options.text: A. I am really annoyed at doing ...
B. Nothing is more important than time.
C. The following details cannot be neglected.
D. Should there be anything I can do for you, please contact me without hesitation.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（保持联系／祝好）：Should there be anything I can do for you, please contact me without hesitation. / If you need to know more about it, please contact me.。
